Mahallat platform specification

The requirements are the reference. Everything a programmer needs to build the platform: rules, fees and configurable values, interface pages, and requirements with their acceptance criteria.

4 interfaces 93 pages 5 diagrams 233 requirements

1Start here

Version 4.8 · October 6, 2026. Built from the updated requirements file (revision 2026-10-05-final). Owner decisions are written in the requirements themselves, and whatever remains open is in "Open questions". Full text version for reading with tools: prd.md.

Summary

A Saudi delivery platform with four interfaces running on one system: the customer app, the merchant app with its web dashboard, the driver app, and the admin dashboard. No delivery companies at launch; the companies section is built later ( FLT-001 ).

Services include restaurants, Mart, Shops, and pharmacies, and self-pickup for all but Mart. Taxi is deferred: a foundation only with no screens and no trips ( TAX-FND ). Payment is online via Moyasar: the platform holds the amount at order time and captures it when the order closes, then distributes it to the parties ( PAY-001 ). After the 60-second window, the order can be cancelled only through support ( ORD-004 ).

The document defines what the developer builds (the requirements with their rules and acceptance criteria), what each page shows, the configurable values, and the financial examples. Visual design and branding are not the developer's responsibility.

How to use the document

  1. Read "First release scope"To see what is being built now, what is deferred, and what is explicitly excluded.
  2. Then "Before launch"For the data and decisions that must be prepared before launch or before development.
  3. Then "Business rules"The order journey and its statuses, dispatch, calculations and fees, closing without delivery, configurable values, roles, integrations, and quality.
  4. Then "Interfaces"What each page shows and which requirements it governs. Previews are illustrative of the page layout only.
  5. Then "Requirements index"Build and test against the requirement ID and its acceptance criteria. Each requirement lists the pages that use it.

The reference when sources differ

The requirement with an ID is the only reference for the rule. If two sources differ, the higher one in the table is followed and the other is corrected; if the requirement itself is unclear, the issue is logged in "Questions for the owner" and the resolution is not guessed.

3Before launch

Data and values prepared before launch; they are operating settings that do not change product decisions.

CFG-01

Special operating values before launch

The default platform percentage for drivers and tier benefits, delivery fees per city, limits for small refunds, financial deductions, negative balance, and messages. They are filled in Settings; not hard-coded.

INT-SEL

Providers and the first integration batch

Approving the mobile OTP/WhatsApp channel, the payment methods actually tested with Moyasar, the first cashier systems, and the call center provider when it starts.

DATA-01

Migration inventory

Counting accounts, addresses, balances, contracts, dues and existing products and their match before and after migration; no count is assumed in the document.

4Glossary

Definitions taken from the requirements themselves, and each definition has its reference.

TermMeaningReference
Order, task and tripThe order is the purchase with its payments and invoice. The task is the driver's work, independent of it, and has pickup, delivery and return stops. The trip groups the driver's tasks with a configurable capacity, defaulting to 3.SYS-003 · DSP-003
Hold and captureThe system places a hold on the customer's payment method at payment and captures it when the order closes: on delivery, on no response, on medicine return, or on a support agent's decision. It releases the hold if the customer cancels within the grace period.PAY-001 · ORD-008
Credit typesRefund (does not expire), compensation (14 days) and promotional (14 days). The system spends the one nearest to expiry first, and refund last.PAY-002
RewardAny compensation reaches the customer as a notification; they tap it and then "Claim reward" and the amount arrives immediately, and it lapses if not claimed within 24 hours.PAY-002
Operating typeRestaurants, Mart, pharmacies, Shops. It determines the fee model, and the merchant does not change it themselves. The section and category determine only where it appears.MER-009 · MER-046
Menu and catalogThe menu is for restaurants and Shops, with shifts and availability times. The catalog is for Mart, built by the manager as primary, secondary and general, and groceries subscribe to it.MER-005 · MER-010 · CAT-001
Write-inA text and photos or prescription order with no menu, two payments: delivery first, then the products invoice uploaded by the merchant.ORD-013 · PHR-012
ShopsThe miscellaneous shops section, works with a menu or write-in, and the manager switches between them.CUS-009 · MER-046 · MER-053
ZoneDelivery boundaries: by default the boundaries of the city the store is in, and a zone can be drawn manually for a store or a driver.DSP-002 · MER-046
ZonesA hierarchy of three levels: country, region, city. Each level inherits the settings of the one above it, and a city-specific setting is optional.SYS-012 · PAY-013
Driver codeAppears to the driver and the merchant enters it at handover. No code for the customer or for operations.ORD-005
Merchant menu linkA link and QR code for each merchant; the manager decides whether the order coming from it is exempt from the contract fee.MER-007
Merchant contractA percentage on the selling price, or a fee per customer and branch with a 365-day cycle counter.PAY-009 · PAY-010
Reversal entryA ledger entry is not edited after it is recorded; it is corrected with a reversal entry.PAY-005
Manual penaltyA deduction decided by a support agent on a merchant or driver with a written reason and evidence, specifying who bears it, and the affected party can appeal. No automatic penalty.PAY-025
Role and permissionA permission is a single action, and a role is a bundle of permissions. The ready-made roles: admin, support supervisor, support agent, operations, finance, and sales, and admin edits them or creates a custom role.ADM-001 · ADM-043
Deposit and negative balanceThe driver's deposit of 100 SAR is held and separate from the wallet, and is refunded on closure. If the wallet reaches −50, the driver stops receiving tasks until they pay.PAY-024 · PAY-026
Priority pointsA number out of 100 ranks the drivers in distribution: score 50%, delivery volume 30%, and proximity 20%.DSP-001
Feature flagA toggle for each feature and each city: starts closed, then a pilot city, then rollout.SYS-006
LevelDriver classification by the score of the last 30 days (New, Under watch, Silver, Gold, Diamond); it determines capacity and percentage benefits, and the score itself enters the priority points.DRV-015 · DRV-017
Preferred captainA driver assigned by the manager to a store is offered that store's orders first if available.MER-038
Self-pickupThe customer orders and pays, and after a 60-second grace period the order reaches the merchant without a driver, then the customer goes to the store and picks up. For the menu outside Mart only.EXT-006
Deferred Taxi foundationSet up an extensible service unit, keys, and task type with no visible operation.TAX-FND

5Order journey

Five diagrams for the main flows. A diagram shows the order only; the windows, amounts, and exceptions are referenced to the requirements listed under each diagram.

Menu and Mart order

From choosing products to delivery and capture, with the support path when the driver is absent.

Schema text
  1. Choose products — single-store cart | order path
  2. Amount hold — 60-second cancellation window | Order flow
  3. Driver acceptance — offer to active nearby drivers | Order path
  4. Merchant preparation — Invoice optional | Order path
  5. Driver pickup — merchant enters the driver code | order path
  6. Customer handover — No code, then capture | Order path
  7. Support intervention — alert at 5 minutes; intervention at 15 | Support and exceptions
  8. Order handling — self-pickup or refund | Support and exceptions

Requirements: ORD-001 · ORD-002 · ORD-003 · ORD-004 · ORD-005 · ORD-006 · DSP-001 · DSP-005 · PAY-001

Write-in and pharmacy orders

Two payments: delivery first, then the products invoice that the merchant uploads and the customer pays within a window.

Schema text
  1. Write the order — text and photos or a prescription | Main path
  2. Pay for delivery — then a 60-second window | Main flow
  3. Driver acceptance — then order sent to the merchant | Main path
  4. Upload invoice — image and amount are mandatory | Main flow
  5. Customer payment — 5% service fee on products | Main flow
  6. Pickup and delivery — driver code only | main path
  7. Cancel order — delivery fee for the driver | exception

Requirements: ORD-013 · PHR-012 · MER-036 · PAY-007 · PAY-021 · PHR-010

Grocery catalogs

Setting up the grocery store from the Mart catalog: subscribe, activate, edit locally, then preview the selling price.

Schema text
  1. Add grocery — operation type: Mart | main path
  2. Choose catalog — primary, secondary or general | main path
  3. Activate products — includes catalog add-ons | Main path
  4. Local edit — Price, availability, and products | Main path
  5. Selling price preview — merchant price × 1.05 | main path
  6. Grocery page — its enabled products only | Main flow

Requirements: MER-010 · CAT-001 · PAY-012 · DSP-005 · MER-031

Offers and reviews

The merchant's own deal or campaign: cost preview, then admin review before any publishing or deduction.

Schema text
  1. Create order — special offer or campaign | main path
  2. Cost preview — financing or slot price | Main path
  3. Submit for review — no publishing or deduction | main path
  4. Admin decision — approve or reject with a reason | Main path
  5. Publishing — within scope and duration | main flow
  6. Results report — Cost, orders, and return | Main path

Requirements: MKT-007 · MKT-008 · MKT-003 · MKT-017 · MER-002

Manual deduction

No automatic penalty: the alert opens a case, and the support agent decides the penalty and who bears it with a written reason and evidence.

Schema text
  1. Operations alert — delay or report | Main flow
  2. Open the case — request, parties, and evidence | Main flow
  3. Reason review — identifying the responsible party | Main path
  4. Finance permission — limit and additional approval | Main flow
  5. Manual deduction — reason, amount, and reference | Main flow
  6. Statement and appeal — notification to the affected party | Main path

Requirements: PAY-025 · ADM-043 · ORD-007 · ORD-012 · SUP-003 · DRV-023

7Dispatch algorithm

How the system chooses the driver. Approved by the owner on October 5.

The timeline of a single order per DSP-001. The rules, weights, and the points example are in the requirement itself, and the values in "Configurable values"; this appendix adds no rule.

Timeline

TimeWhat happens
0:00Cancellation window expired. The 15-minute window starts.
0:00 to 0:30The preferred captain alone, if set. If none exists, the first attempt starts immediately.
0:30 to 1:00Attempt 1: 5 km range, top 3.
1:10 to 1:40Attempt 2: 6 km range, top 6.
1:50 to 2:20Attempt 3: 7 km range, all qualified.
From 2:30Rounds: +1 km per attempt up to 10 km, all eligible drivers.
5:00Alert for support.
15:00Automatic offering stops. For non-Mart: self-pickup within 5 minutes or a full refund. For Mart: manual assignment or cancellation.

9Closing an order without delivery

The fate of the money in every status that does not end in delivery.

When the held amount is captured, when it is refunded, and who takes what, when an order does not end in delivery. The general rule: the amount stays held until the order is closed (PAY-001).

The tip always follows the delivery fee: if delivery is paid out to the driver it is paid out with it, and if it is refunded to the customer it is refunded in full (CUS-010).
StatusWho decidesCustomerDriver (delivery and tip)MerchantReference
Customer cancellation within 60 secondsCustomerThe hold is released in fullNothingNothingORD-002 · PAY-001
No driver after 15 minutes, and the customer chose self-pickupCustomerDelivery and tip are refunded, and the remainder is collected on pickupNothingContinue the orderEXT-006 · ORD-004
No driver after 15 minutes, and the customer chose a refund or did not choose within 5 minutesCustomer or systemThe hold is released in fullNothingNothingORD-004 · PAY-001
No driver in MartSupportManual assignment, or cancel with a full refundAssigned to whom—ORD-004
Cancellation by support after the windowSupport agentThe amount is refundedWhat support decides if they picked up the orderPenalty if set by support; the bearing party may be the platformORD-004 · PAY-025
Item out of stock and "Cancel the order" chosenSystem then supportThe amount is refundedWhat support decidesPenalty if set by supportMER-032
Customer non-responseSupport agentNot refunded, and the amount is capturedFee and tipTheir due as usualORD-008 · DRV-005
A write-in order not paid within 10 minutesSystem then supportBears the share of delivery that support decides, and the rest is refundedWhat support decides, and the tip follows the deliveryNothingORD-013
Pharmacy without prescriptionSupport agentWhat support decides of the deliveryWhat support decidesNothingPHR-012
Medicine not delivered because of no responseOperationsDelivery is not refunded, and the medicine price is refunded after the pharmacy confirms it is safeFee and tipYou restore the medicinePHR-010
Self-pickup not collected by its ownerSupport agentWhat support decides—What support decidesEXT-006

Every support decision in these cases is logged with the actor, the written reason, and the bearing party, and the order is not closed before it. "What support decides" means the cancellation screen asks the employee for the amount for each party or "nothing".

10Configurable values

26 settings that the authorized administrator sets from the admin dashboard without a new release. Each value is a system-wide setting, and operations and fee settings can be adjusted per city. The values written here are launch defaults, and the order saves a copy of what it used of them when it is confirmed ( ADM-034 ). Anything related to the commercial agreement is stored in the merchant's contract.

13Quality and operations

Rules that apply to all interfaces. Their details and tests are in the "Build and operations" requirements.

#RuleRequirement
1Four interfaces with permissions and city and branch scope; a staff member does not exceed the role or their store's permissions.ADM-001 · MER-037 · ADM-043
2Arabic-first RTL, full English, central texts, named and keyboard-accessible buttons, and clear contrast.SYS-013 · CUS-001
3Every page has loading, empty, error, and weak network states; money and statuses are not updated from the customer interface alone.SYS-018 · SYS-004
4Riyadh time, amounts in whole halalas, half-up rounding applied once per fee; VAT and commercial accounting remain without separate compliance requirements.SYS-012 · PAY-029
5Prevents duplicate payment, acceptance, refund, reward and entries; a durable scheduler for timeouts that survives a server restart.SYS-010 · SYS-005
6Finance is shown only to the authorized; a log of who did what, when, and before and after; payouts are approved by a different person.ADM-002 · ADM-043 · PAY-006
7Home, sections, placements, values, and switches come from the server; the exception is store, then city, then global per the value's setting.SYS-006 · SYS-007 · SYS-002 · ADM-034
8Three separate environments; daily backups and a restore test; measurable performance targets; monitoring of payment, the scheduler, and integrations.SYS-014 · SYS-015 · SYS-017
9The release is an update to the same store apps; migrating accounts, balances, and contracts goes through a pilot phase and reconciliation, and the old app is read-only at cutover.SYS-020 · SYS-019
10Acceptance tests for each requirement, financial examples to the halala, and tests of the photo, permission, manual discount and customer non-response paths.SYS-014

14Shared page states

Five states are built into every page in the apps and dashboards. They are not repeated in the page descriptions.

  1. Clear loading with no made-up numbers
  2. An empty state that explains the next step
  3. Error with retry
  4. A network loss preserves the inputs
  5. An unavailable permission hides the action
  6. New user with no orders: "Suggestions for you" is replaced by "Most ordered in your city" and the in-progress order card does not appear; the page is never empty.
  7. Address outside coverage: the page moves to C24 (no driver or coverage) with a change-address button.
  8. Section disabled in the city: it disappears from the sections grid and the remaining sections move up in the city's order.
  9. A store closed now: appears with a "Closed · opens 4:00 PM" tag at the end of the row and is not shown as available.
  10. A store outside the customer's city: does not appear in any row, nor in "Suggestions for you".
  11. Pharmacy order in progress: the in-progress order card says "Your order from the pharmacy" without any medicine name.
  12. No offers or discounted products in the city: the whole row is hidden instead of being shown empty.

Special states for the cart and payment

Applies to page C09 Cart and payment in addition to the five states:

  • Empty cart (deleting the last item): return to the store page.
  • Disconnection after payment: the app queries the order without duplicating it.
  • Cart expired (CRT-004): on opening it, "Your cart has expired" and the app re-validates the items or starts a new cart.
  • Minimum not met: the pay button is disabled with the text "Add N SAR to reach the minimum".
  • Qualified for free delivery: the bar is green "Delivery is free for this order" and the delivery line is 0.00.
  • The saved payment method was disabled by admin (PAY-001): it disappears from the dialog, and choosing another method is required before payment.
  • Address outside the store's range: red alert above the summary and the pay button disabled until the address is changed.
  • Self-pickup order: no address, no delivery, no tip, and no free delivery bar (PAY-021).
  • Hold in progress: the button is disabled with an indicator and the text "Holding…" so the request is not repeated, and the page is not closed by going back.

15Customer app

Stores, cart, order, tracking and balance. It contains 26 pages, ordered as they are used. Under each page are an illustrative preview, its elements, its actions and the requirements that govern it. The five shared states in "Shared page states" are not repeated here.

C01 HomeAccess to the sections and stores available for the customer's address.

Page elements

  • Delivery address: the address name, its district and city in the header, not just "My address"
  • Notification bell: in the header
  • Unified search: one search field for all sections (CUS-004)
  • Active order: a card at the top of the page with the store name, status badge, arrival time in minutes and arrival clock time (ORD-011), and the four status steps (looking for a driver, preparing, on the way, delivered); with more than one active order, a single card "You have N active orders"
  • Restaurants, Mart, Shops, and pharmacies: the four sections with their visibility and order by the customer's city (CUS-009)
  • City banners: carry a visible "Ad" tag, as does any paid row (CUS-003)
  • Featured stores: a row of stores
  • Discounted products: a row of products with a discount
  • Suggestions: a "Suggestions for you" row with a reason line under it: the item the customer ordered before or their dietary preference (CUS-003); and for a new user an alternative row "Most ordered in your city"
  • Store card in rows: rating, arrival time as a single number, delivery fee, and quality badge (MKT-014)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Change addressOpens addresses (C13). After choosing another address, the sections, stores and fees are refreshed immediately (CUS-003) with a transient notification "We updated the stores for your address". An address outside coverage moves to C24. If the cart has items from a store that does not deliver to the new address, an alert appears inside the cart when opened.
SearchOpens search (C02) with the cursor in the field and the keyboard showing, with recent searches.
Open sectionOpens the section page: restaurants C03, Mart C04, Shops C05, pharmacies C06, for the current address's city.
Open storeOpens C07; a write-in Shops store and a pharmacy open C17 (CUS-009).
Open current orderOpens tracking (C11); for a self-pickup order C16; for an order awaiting the customer's reply on an out-of-stock item C12. With more than one active order it opens "My orders" (C10).
Open ad bannerOpens the linked store or offer; the offer's conditions appear before adding to the cart.
View allOpens the section list for the row, in the same order as the home page.
Open discounted productOpens C08 inside its store, with the pre-discount price struck through.
Open notificationsOpens the customer's notification list (open question: there is no notifications page in the current menu).

UX decisions

  • The active order card is above the sections because it is the first thing a returning user looks for during an open order, and the status is a badge and steps, not just text.
  • The full address in the header explains why these stores appear, and can be changed with one tap.
  • Store card numbers allow comparison without opening the store.
  • The suggestion reason line builds trust and explains the ordering.

Requirements that govern it

  • CUS-003 Home and ranking Important
  • CUS-004 Search and filters
  • CUS-009 Customer sections and navigation
  • MKT-014 Quality badge
  • ORD-011 Displayed arrival time

Navigates to

C02 Search and results · C03 Restaurants · C04 Mart and groceries · C05 Shops · C07 Store page · C10 My orders · C13 Addresses · C11 Order tracking · C16 Your order is ready for pickup · C12 Out-of-stock item and substitute · C24 No driver or coverage · C08 Product details · C17 Write-in order and delivery payment · C26 Notifications

C02 Search and resultsSearch across sections with alternatives when nothing matches.

Page elements

  • Search term: a field, and before typing the recent searches appear; spelling correction is visible, such as "Showing results for burger · Search for burgur as typed"
  • Results by section: chips All, Restaurants, Mart, Shops, Pharmacies, with the number of results in each chip
  • Filters: category, offers, delivery fee, self-pickup, rating (CUS-004)
  • Sorting: a chip with the name of the current sort (CUS-004)
  • Store card: rating, arrival time as a single number, delivery fee, offer tag if present, and quality badge (MKT-014)
  • Mart product result: the grocery name and the product's price in it
  • "Can't find your store? Suggest a store" card: below every set of results
  • Suggestion form: the shop name, and an optional neighborhood or note

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
FilterA bottom sheet with filters and an "Show N results" button whose count updates with each choice. On apply the results update and active filters appear as chips above the list with "Clear all".
Open storeOpens C07, or C17 for a write-in store or pharmacy. On return the keyword and filters stay.
Suggest a shopOpens the suggestion form inside the page with the shop name filled with the search keyword. On sending, it is recorded with the city and the search keyword (ADM-039), a transient notification "Your suggestion was received, thank you" appears, and the alternatives stay visible.
SortSingle-choice list (CUS-004); the order is rearranged immediately and its name appears on the chip.
Choose a sectionThe chip limits results to the section; "All" returns them grouped under the section headings.
Clear searchThe × button clears the field and shows the latest searches.
Search as I typed itCancels the correction and repeats the search with the original word.
Open productOpens C08 inside its grocery store or store.
Send suggestionAs in "Shop suggestion"; the button is disabled while sending, then becomes "Suggestion sent" and the two fields are cleared.

Special states for this page

  • No result: a message "There is no ... delivering to your address", then close alternatives from the same category, then the suggestion form; and the term is logged as a search with no result (ADM-039).
  • A result not available for the address does not appear (CUS-004) and is not counted in the chip counts.
  • A store closed now: at the end of the list with a "Closed · opens ..." tag.
  • Filters emptied the results: "No results with these filters" with a "Clear filters" button, and the substitutes and the suggestion form are shown.
  • A duplicate suggestion from the same customer for the same store: "You suggested this store before, we received your suggestion" with no new record.

Validation and error messages

  • Search term: the search starts from two characters.
  • The store name is mandatory: when sent empty, "Enter the store name" appears under it in red.
  • Neighborhood or note: 120 characters maximum with a counter.

UX decisions

  • The field border takes the brand color while typing, and an × button clears it with one tap.
  • The spelling correction is visible with an undo option, so what the customer typed is not lost.
  • The result count on the section chips shows where the results are before pressing.
  • A permanent "Suggest a store" card because the results may not include the store the customer wants.
  • In the no-result state, alternatives come before the suggestion form so the customer still has something to order now.

Requirements that govern it

  • CUS-004 Search and filters
  • ADM-039 Contracting targets list
  • MKT-014 Quality badge

Navigates to

C07 Store page · C21 Support and tickets · C08 Product details · C17 Write-in order and delivery payment

C03 RestaurantsBrowse restaurants with an active menu.

Page elements

  • Restaurant count: in the header, the number of restaurants that deliver to the address
  • Categories: category chips, including "All"
  • Current sort chip: visible and highlighted
  • Filters: categories, self-pickup, offers, rating, distance, arrival time
  • Restaurant card: quality badge on the image (MKT-014), delivery fee as a number, and arrival time as a single number, not a range (ORD-011)
  • Card tags: "Closes in N min" in red near closing (CUS-005); an offer tag (discount or free delivery) if the restaurant participates (CUS-005); "Self-pickup" for restaurants that offer it

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Open restaurantOpens C07 on the active shift's menu (CUS-005). With the self-pickup filter it opens in the pickup flow (C15).
SortSingle-choice list: nearest, fastest, highest rated, lowest delivery; the order is rearranged immediately.
FilterA bottom sheet with filters; the "Show N restaurants" button applies and closes, and active filters are removable chips.
Choose a categoryThe chip limits the list to the category, and "All" removes the restriction.
Enable self-pickupRestricts the list to restaurants that offer it, and the duration becomes "Ready in" and the delivery fee disappears from the cards.

Special states for this page

  • No restaurants with an active menu now: "Restaurants are closed now" with the nearest opening time and a "Browse Mart" button.
  • A restaurant with no active menu at this hour: does not appear in the list.
  • Self-pickup filter with no results: "No restaurants offer pickup near your address" with a "Clear filter" button.

UX decisions

  • The arrival time as a single number matches what the customer sees in the cart and tracking, so they are not surprised by a difference.
  • The delivery fee as a number, not a generic phrase, because it is part of the choice decision.
  • The red closing-soon tag protects the customer from a cart that will not complete.
  • Shorter images (92 pixels) show three restaurants above the fold instead of two.

Requirements that govern it

  • CUS-005 Store and product page
  • CUS-009 Customer sections and navigation
  • MKT-014 Quality badge
  • ORD-011 Displayed arrival time

C07 Store page · C15 Pick up yourself

C04 Mart and groceriesChoose a known grocery, then its products.

Page elements

  • Fixed alert at the top of the list: the cart is from a single grocery store, and the order is prepared from it only, with no self-pickup (DSP-005)
  • Available groceries: a card for each grocery with the Quality badge (MKT-014), closing time, and distance
  • Arrival time and delivery fee: two numbers on each grocery card
  • Offers: tag the grocery offer with its text
  • Sections inside the grocery: shortcuts inside its card to go straight to the section

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Open groceryOpens C07 in Mart style: the grocery sections and only their enabled products and local prices (MER-010).
Product searchOpens C02 restricted to Mart; each product result carries its grocery store's name and its price there, and opening it enters that grocery store.
Open section inside a groceryThe section chip in the grocery card opens C07 scrolled to that section.
Sort and filterSelection chips: Nearest, Open now, Deals, Lowest delivery; applied immediately.

Special states for this page

  • No grocery is open now: groceries are tagged "Closed · opens ..." and nothing can be added to the cart.
  • A centrally suspended product or an unapproved new merchant product: not shown (MER-010).
  • Adding a product from another grocery while the cart has a grocery: the "Start a new cart?" dialog as in C07.

UX decisions

  • The single-grocery alert at the top of the list prevents expecting a "unified order" from several groceries.
  • Shortcuts to sections inside the card save a step for those who know what they want.
  • Showing the grocery and the price together in product search lets the customer choose while seeing the difference.

Requirements that govern it

  • MER-010 Mart catalogs
  • DSP-005 Mart is an independent store
  • MKT-014 Quality badge

C05 ShopsManual categories at the top of the page and the stores below them.

Page elements

  • Categories: the manual categories grid with icons at the top of the page (CUS-009), and the selected one is shaded
  • Stores: a list under the grid, titled with the selected category name and the number of stores
  • Order type: products or write-in: a tag for each shop "Order from products" or "Write your order"
  • Explanation of "Write your order": a short line: delivery now, then the store's invoice
  • Time and fees: arrival time as a single number and the delivery fee as a number per store
  • Quality badge: on the shop (MKT-014)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Choose a categoryHighlights the category and restricts the list to it, and its title becomes "[Category] · N shops".
Open shopA products shop opens C07; a write-in shop opens C17 (CUS-009).

Special states for this page

  • A shop converted from write-in to menu: its tag becomes "Order from products" and it opens the menu; and while the conversion is not published it stays "Write your order" (MER-053).
  • A category with no stores in the customer's city: does not appear in the grid.
  • A closed shop: dimmed with a "Closed · opens ..." tag at the end of the list.

UX decisions

  • Categories are an icon grid, not horizontal chips, so all appear without side scrolling.
  • The order type tag in two different colors clarifies the difference between the two paths before tapping.
  • The explanation line for "Write your order" prevents the surprise of two-stage payment.

C06 PharmaciesChoose a pharmacy, then write the order.

Page elements

  • Privacy alert at the top of the page: the prescription is seen by the pharmacist only, not the driver, and the notifications "Your order from the pharmacy" carry no medicine name (PHR-012, PHR-008)
  • Pharmacies in range: each pharmacy shows its status (open, or closed with opening time) and a Quality badge (MKT-014), plus a "Write your order" button on open ones
  • Arrival time and delivery fee: for each pharmacy
  • Wasfaty tag when available: with the explanation "The medicine has no value and only delivery" (PHR-003)
  • "How your order works" card: four steps: write and attach the prescription, pay delivery, pharmacist review and invoice sending, payment within 10 minutes and then the driver picks up (PHR-012)
  • Prescription alert: if the medicine needs a prescription and none is attached, the order is cancelled (PHR-012)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Open pharmacyOpens C17 for this pharmacy; no menu for pharmacies (EXT-004).
Write-in orderThe "Write your order" button opens C17 directly with the cursor in the order text field.
Pharmacy searchOpens C02 restricted to pharmacies within the address range.

Special states for this page

  • Closed pharmacy: dimmed at the bottom with the tag "Closed · opens ..." and no write button.
  • No pharmacy in range: "No pharmacy delivers to your address now" with a change-address button.
  • No self-pickup for pharmacy orders at launch: the pickup option does not appear in this section.

UX decisions

  • The privacy alert is the first thing the customer sees because the prescription is sensitive information.
  • A "Write your order" button on every open pharmacy makes the primary action one tap.
  • The four steps arrange payment expectations in two stages and the grace period before starting.
  • A closed pharmacy stays visible instead of disappearing, so the customer knows when it opens.

Requirements that govern it

  • PHR-003 "Wasfaty" prescriptions Important
  • PHR-012 Pharmacy order
  • EXT-004 Pharmacies
  • PHR-008 Privacy in notifications
  • MKT-014 Quality badge

C07 Store pageShows the store details and its products, or its write-in path.

Page elements

  • Name, rating, and favorites: the store header (CUS-005), and next to the logo the Quality badge (MKT-014) and the active shift tag such as "Evening menu"
  • Preparation time: in the header
  • Offers during preparation: a card directly under the preparation time, containing subscription offers and approved special offers together (CUS-005)
  • Delivery and minimum: three numbers with their units: the minimum in SAR, arrival in minutes as a single number (ORD-011), the delivery fee in SAR
  • Closing-soon label: a countdown and the closing time (CUS-005)
  • Search: inside the store menu
  • Active menu or grocery sections: the active shift's menu (MER-005); in grocery mode its sections instead of menu categories, with its enabled products and local prices (MER-010)
  • Price and options: in each product's row (CUS-005); and the bundled meal with a "Bundled meal" tag and a description of its components
  • Cart bar: item count and amount, and the remainder to the minimum or to free delivery with a progress bar (CRT-002), and the cart expiry time (CRT-004)
  • "Start a new cart?" dialog: when adding while the cart belongs to another store (CRT-001), it names the store and the number of items that will be removed

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
FavoritesAdds the store to favorites immediately and the heart fills in red, with a transient notification "Added to favorites"; a second tap removes it.
ShareOpens the mobile share sheet with the store's link and name.
SearchShows this store's matching products on the same page; × restores the full menu.
Open productOpens C08.
Add to cartThe + button on a product with no mandatory options adds it once per tap and the bar updates immediately; a product with mandatory options (including a combo meal) opens C08. And a cart from another store: a "Start a new cart?" window before any change.
View cartOpens C09. The bar does not appear and the cart is empty.
Start a new cartDeletes the other store's items and adds the selected item; it cannot be undone, so the button is red and names the store whose cart will be deleted.
Keep my current cartCloses the window with no change.
Choose a menu sectionScrolls the list to the section, and the sections bar stays fixed at the top of the screen while scrolling.

Special states for this page

  • Near closing: the label is orange; at closing it becomes "Store closed · opens ...", adding is disabled, and the cart ends (CRT-004).
  • Store closed: the page is browse-only, buttons are disabled, and the opening time is shown.
  • A product outside its availability time or the active shift, or an offer outside the store's scope: not shown (CUS-005, MER-005).
  • Product unavailable now (a meal with an out-of-stock component and no substitute, MER-024): dimmed with no add button and a "Not available now" tag.
  • A store not participating in a free-delivery offer: no free-delivery bar (CRT-002), and only the remainder to the minimum shows if it has not been met.
  • Minimum not met: the bar "Add N SAR to reach the minimum".
  • Customer returns after the cart expired (CRT-004): the message "Your previous cart has expired" and the app re-validates the items or starts a new cart.
  • A write-in Shops store or pharmacy: opens C17 instead of this page.

UX decisions

  • The closing-soon label sits above the offers because it determines whether ordering is possible now.
  • The offers card has a distinct color.
  • The progress bar toward free delivery above the cart button encourages adding without pressure.
  • The bottom navigation bar is hidden here so the cart button stays the main action within thumb reach.

Requirements that govern it

  • CUS-005 Store and product page
  • MER-005 Shifts and product availability
  • MER-010 Mart catalogs
  • MKT-014 Quality badge

C08 Product details · C09 Cart and checkout · C17 Write-in order and delivery payment

C08 Product detailsChoose the size, add-ons, and quantity at the displayed price.

Page elements

  • Photo: product photo
  • Name and description: the product name and description; and for a bundled meal a "Bundled meal" label and a description of its components
  • Price: and the price before discount struck through when there is a discount
  • Sizes and add-ons: the price of each add-on beside it; and in a bundled meal each component with its options and a "Required" or "Optional" label (MER-024), and an out-of-stock option is dimmed with "Out today" and cannot be selected
  • Availability: the availability time such as "Available until [time]"
  • Quantity: + and − buttons
  • Add button: shows the total after options and quantity, such as "Add to cart · N SAR"

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Edit optionsChoosing an option in a required component (single choice) or an optional add-on (multiple) updates the price in the button immediately.
Add to cartValidates the required components, then adds the item with its options and returns to the store page with a notice "Added to cart" and an updated cart bar. If the cart belongs to another store: the "Start a new cart?" dialog (CRT-001).
Change quantity+ and − change the quantity by one per press and the amount on the button updates; − is disabled at 1.
Close× returns to the store page without adding.
Open similar mealIn the unavailable state: opens the details of a similar meal.

Special states for this page

  • Unavailable bundled meal (MER-024): a "Not available now" badge and a written reason, the add button disabled, and similar meals available.
  • An option in a component is out of stock and has a substitute: the option is dimmed and the meal stays available.
  • Product availability time ended while the page is open: "No longer available now" and adding is disabled.
  • Opening the page from the cart for editing: the saved options are selected, and the "Save edit" button replaces the item instead of adding it.
  • Price changed while the page is open: the price updates with a short alert "Price changed".

Validation and error messages

  • Required component with no selection on add: the page scrolls to it and shows "Choose the drink type" in red below it, and the item is not added.

UX decisions

  • Each component in a separate card with a "Required" tag so the customer knows what remains before adding.
  • Single-choice options are large, easy-to-tap cards instead of small radio buttons.
  • An out-of-stock option stays visible and dimmed so the customer doesn't look for it.

Requirements that govern it

  • CUS-005 Store and product page
  • CRT-001 Cart and notes Important
  • MER-024 Bundled meals Important

Navigates to

C09 Cart and checkout · C07 Store page

C09 Cart and paymentReview the amount, address, and out-of-stock policy before confirming payment.

Page elements

  • Arrival time: in the header as a single number (ORD-011)
  • Free delivery bar: the remaining amount in SAR and a progress bar (CRT-002)
  • Items: the cart items with their quantities and options
  • "Usually ordered with": suggestions from the same store with an add button (CRT-003)
  • Non-binding note: the note field with a "Not binding on the store" tag beside it (CRT-001)
  • Choosing out of stock: three cards: remove it and don't charge for it, call me, cancel the order; and with "Call me" the registered number or "Another number" (MER-032)
  • Address: delivery address
  • Tip: amount tiers, and an explanation: 15% is deducted from it and the rest reaches the driver (example: from 10 SAR he receives 8.50)
  • Coupon: a code field and an "Apply" button
  • Wallet: balance usage switch
  • Products, delivery and service: the payment summary with its items (CRT-005), and the service with its percentage (PAY-021)
  • Card and total: the chosen payment method, and a button with an action and amount "Pay N SAR" with the hold line above it "We hold the amount and deduct only what is due when the order closes"
  • Cart expiry time: shown when it approaches (CRT-004)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Edit quantity+ adds one per press; − at 1 asks "Remove [item] from the cart?". Every change instantly recalculates the bar, the service fee, and the total (CRT-002).
Choose out-of-stock handlingChoose one of three cards. "Call me" shows the registered number partially hidden and a link "Another number" opens a mobile field. The choice is saved on the order (MER-032).
Choose paymentOpens the payment methods window: only the enabled methods (PAY-001), and Tabby and Tamara when the installment threshold is reached (PAY-015). The selection is saved for upcoming orders.
Confirm paymentThe server re-validates the price, availability, minimum, address range and store status (CRT-001); if anything changed, a differences review appears and nothing is held. Then the amount is held (PAY-001). Success creates the order and moves to C11 with the cancel button with a counter (ORD-002). Failure creates no order and keeps the cart.
Add suggestionAdds it once per tap (CRT-003), the button temporarily becomes a checkmark, and the summary and bar update.
Edit optionsOpens C08 in edit mode with the saved options selected.
Change addressOpens C13; after selection the delivery fee, eligibility and arrival time are recalculated.
Choose a tipOne chip from None/3/5/10 SAR; added as a line in the summary and does not change the service fee (PAY-004).
Add couponOpens the field; a valid code adds a "Discounts" line and recalculates the service (PAY-021).
Use walletThe switch deducts from the balance up to the amount required and a "From wallet" line appears; the rest is held on the payment method (PAY-004).
Write a noteSaved with the order and shown to the merchant (CRT-001); they do not change the price.

Special states for this page

  • Empty cart (deleting the last item): return to the store page.
  • Disconnection after payment: the app queries the order without duplicating it.
  • Cart expired (CRT-004): on opening it, "Your cart has expired" and the app re-validates the items or starts a new cart.
  • Minimum not met: the pay button is disabled with the text "Add N SAR to reach the minimum".
  • Qualified for free delivery: the bar is green "Delivery is free for this order" and the delivery line is 0.00.
  • The saved payment method was disabled by admin (PAY-001): it disappears from the dialog, and choosing another method is required before payment.
  • Address outside the store's range: red alert above the summary and the pay button disabled until the address is changed.
  • Self-pickup order: no address, no delivery, no tip, and no free delivery bar (PAY-021).
  • Hold in progress: the button is disabled with an indicator and the text "Holding…" so the request is not repeated, and the page is not closed by going back.

Validation and error messages

  • Invalid or expired coupon: under the field in red "The code is invalid or has expired".
  • Coupon does not apply to this store or has a minimum: "This coupon does not apply to your order" with its condition.
  • The other number for "Call me": a Saudi mobile of 10 digits starting with 05, otherwise "Enter a valid mobile number starting with 05".
  • Note: 200 characters maximum with a counter.
  • The out-of-stock option is preselected to the customer's last choice, or "Remove it" if there is none (MER-032).

UX decisions

  • The hold line above the pay button reassures that the amount is not charged before closing.
  • The free delivery bar is at the top of the cart because it changes the decision to add.
  • The out-of-stock option as visible cards instead of a dropdown that hides the alternatives.
  • The arrival time before payment is the same one that appears in tracking.

Requirements that govern it

C10 My ordersCurrent and past orders with status, source, and pickup method.

Page elements

  • Current orders: the "Current" tab with the order count on it
  • Past orders: the "Past" tab, and the "Canceled" tab with the final statuses in text
  • Status and arrival time: a colored badge for each state (looking for a driver, being prepared, out for delivery, delivered, ready for pickup), and the arrival time as a single number for the ongoing order (ORD-011)
  • Money status for each order: "Amount held" for an ongoing one, "Paid" for a delivered one, "Hold released" or "Refunded" or "Under support decision" for a canceled one
  • Awaiting customer response alert inside the card: an out-of-stock item with a counter (MER-032), or a write-in invoice to pay with a 10-minute counter
  • Receiving method: delivery, or pick it up yourself at the end of the shift
  • Search and filters: in "Previous"
  • Purchase order and invoice if any: links "Purchase order" and "Store invoice", and the invoice only if uploaded (PAY-007)
  • Reorder dialog: price differences and unavailable items (CUS-006)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
TrackOpens C11 for delivery; for a self-pickup order the button becomes "Directions" and opens C16.
ReorderA cart is created from the same store (CUS-006) and the differences window appears: "Price changed" with both prices, "As is", "Unavailable today · Won't be added". "Review cart" opens C09. If a cart from another store exists: the customer is asked before replacing it. Closed store: "Store is closed now · Opens ..." and no cart is created.
SupportOpens C21 with the order linked to the ticket.
Open detailsOpens C19: the purchase order, the invoice and the rating.
Choose nowOn an order awaiting a reply on an out-of-stock item: opens C12.
Pay the invoiceOn a write-in order awaiting payment: opens C18.
Open purchase orderShows the purchase order with its items and payment source (PAY-007).
Open store invoiceShows the invoice photo the store uploaded (PAY-007).
Search and filtersSearch by store name or order number, with a type filter (delivery, self-pickup, write-in, pharmacy) and period.
Switch between tabsCurrent, previous, canceled; the scroll position is kept for each tab.

Special states for this page

  • No orders in progress: "No orders in progress now" and a "Start an order" button for the home page.
  • Canceled order: in "Canceled" with its final status text and reason (canceled within the grace period, canceled by support, canceled for out-of-stock item, canceled for non-payment, rejected before invoice) and the amount status.
  • An order awaiting a support decision: "Under review by support" with no final amounts until it is closed.
  • An old order from a shop that switched from write-in to menu: stays two-payment with its invoice.
  • Reordering an order none of whose items are available: "None of this order's items are available today" and no cart is created.
  • An order awaiting an out-of-stock reply: the alert is orange, and the "Choose now" button is the main button on the card.

UX decisions

  • "Choose now" is a primary button with a counter because the window is running out.
  • Money status is visible on every card so the customer does not think they were charged twice.
  • The reorder dialog shows the differences before payment so the customer is not surprised by a different price.

Requirements that govern it

  • CUS-006 Reorder, favorites and rating
  • ORD-001 Order statuses
  • PAY-007 Invoices and purchase orders
  • ORD-011 Displayed arrival time
  • PAY-001 Payment and hold
  • MER-032 Substitute for an out-of-stock product

C11 Order trackingMap, status, and an all-inclusive arrival time, with no code.

Page elements

  • Map: top of the page (CUS-007)
  • Time remaining: a single arrival time in minutes and the arrival clock time, without breaking down the components (CUS-007, ORD-011)
  • Status line: the customer's four status steps
  • Driver: first name, mode of transport and a "number hidden" tag
  • Call and chat: two buttons directly beside the driver
  • Address instructions: the address card and its instructions
  • Location correction: a button in the address card
  • Leave at the door: a "Leave it at the door" switch with the photo explanation (ORD-010), and after leaving it, a photo of the order in place
  • Order cancellation card: with a counter, within the window only (ORD-002), with its effect "The hold of N SAR is released in full"

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
CallCall through an intermediary number (CUS-008). It is disabled after the contact period ends.
ChatOpens C25. Disabled before a driver accepts with the text "Chat becomes available when a driver accepts".
Correct locationOpens the map to move the pin (C13) then "Confirm location". Same fee: the location updates immediately and the driver is notified. Farther location: a window "Delivery fee difference X SAR" with two buttons "Pay the difference" and "Continue with the first location", and the location does not change before payment. Rejection and out-of-zone follow (ORD-009); out of zone shows the message "Your request reached support and they will contact you".
TicketOpens C21 with a ticket linked to the order.
Leave it at the doorThe switch saves the choice immediately (ORD-010) with a transient notice "The driver will leave your order at the door and photograph it." It can be turned off before the driver arrives.
Cancel the orderWithin the window only (ORD-002). Confirmation "Cancel the order? The hold of N SAR is fully released" with two buttons "Yes, cancel the order" and "Go back". Confirming turns the page into "Order canceled". When the countdown ends the button disappears with no explanation, and "Ticket" remains.
View drop-off photoOpens the photo the driver took at full size.

Special states for this page

  • No driver after 15 minutes: the page moves to C24.
  • Driver approaching: a notification "Your driver is approaching" and the map updates (CUS-007).
  • Editing preparation, reassignment, or order batching: the number updates (ORD-011), and the driver card changes with a notification.
  • An order awaiting an out-of-stock reply: an orange top bar "Item out of stock · your reply is required" with a counter opens C12.
  • Awaiting payment of the location-correction difference: "Awaiting difference payment" badge and the driver heads to the first location.
  • Delivered: the leave-at-door photo appears if any, then the customer moves to C19.
  • Self-pickup order: opens C16 instead of this page.
  • Pharmacy order: notifications per (PHR-008).

Validation and error messages

  • Location correction without moving the pin: the confirm button is disabled with the text "Move the pin to the correct location".

UX decisions

  • The duration number is large with the arrival time by the clock, and it is the first information after the map.
  • Cancellation is a counter visible on the card instead of an explanatory sentence, and the confirmation states the financial impact.
  • A "Hidden number" tag beside the call reassures the customer.
  • A slightly shorter map so the four important cards appear above the fold.

Requirements that govern it

  • CUS-007 Tracking and order arrival time
  • ORD-009 Location correction Important
  • ORD-010 Leave at the door
  • CUS-008 Chat and calling
  • ORD-011 Displayed arrival time
  • PAY-001 Payment and hold
  • PHR-008 Privacy in notifications
  • ORD-002 Customer cancellation window

C25 Chat with the driver NewChat and call with the driver within the order using masked numbers, closed some time after the order is closed.

Page elements

  • Header: the driver's first name, the order number and its status, and a call button using a hidden intermediary number
  • Fixed alert at the top of the chat: numbers are hidden, and the chat closes 24 hours after the order ends (CUS-008)
  • Messages: with each message's time and status (sending, delivered, not sent)
  • System messages: when a number is hidden "We hid a mobile number from your message, and it did not reach the driver", and when "Leave it at the door" is enabled from the chat
  • Quick replies: leave it at the door, I'm at the door, call me when you arrive
  • Writing field and send button
  • Message removal request dialog: the message and an optional reason

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Send messageSends the text; any mobile number is replaced with "[number hidden]" (CUS-008) and the system message appears to the sender. The message appears immediately as "Sending" then "Delivered".
CallCall through an intermediary number (CUS-008); it is disabled after the contact is closed.
Quick replySends the text with one tap. "Leave it at the door" actually enables the same option in C11, not only as text (ORD-010), with a system message confirming it.
Message removal requestA long press on a message written by the customer opens the "Request removal of this message" window. Sending reaches admin and a "Removal requested" tag appears under the message until the decision; it is deleted only by an admin decision.
BackReturns to C11 and the draft stays in the field.

Special states for this page

  • New conversation with no messages: "Start the conversation with your driver" and the quick replies are visible.
  • Before a driver accepts: no chat; its button in C11 is disabled.
  • Driver changed (reassignment): a new conversation with the new driver, and the old one is read-only.
  • After the order is closed: the conversation stays open until the end of the period (CUS-008), then it is read-only and the call button is disabled.
  • Network loss: the message shows "Not sent · Try again" and its text is not lost.

Validation and error messages

  • Empty message: the send button is disabled.
  • Message length: 500 characters maximum with a counter when approaching it.

UX decisions

  • The masked-numbers alert at the top of the conversation answers the privacy question before it is asked.
  • The system message when a number is hidden explains to the sender why their message changed.
  • Quick replies above the field.
  • The call button in the header, and send is a large button within thumb reach.

Requirements that govern it

  • CUS-008 Chat and calling
  • ORD-010 Leave at the door

Navigates to

C11 Order tracking · C21 Support and tickets

C12 Out-of-stock item and substituteCustomer approval, or applying their pre-selected choice after 3 minutes.

Page elements

  • Response counter: a large circular counter at the top of the screen that starts the moment the merchant presses "Out of stock" (MER-032)
  • Out-of-stock item: by name
  • Preselection: the customer's preselection, and the number the store will call, partially hidden
  • Substitute and its price: the substitute proposed by the store with its name and price
  • Price and fee difference: the item price difference and the service fee difference, then the amount added to the hold
  • Timeout alert: with no response before it ends, the item is removed and its price is not counted (MER-032)
  • Automatic cancellation result screen: the reason "Item out of stock" and the amount whose hold was released

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Accept substituteMore expensive substitute: the button "Accept substitute and pay N SAR" holds the difference on the same payment method (PAY-028); success confirms the substitute and moves to tracking with a "The item was replaced" notification, and failure removes the item and the customer is informed with a message (MER-032). A cheaper or equal substitute: "Accept substitute" with no payment (PAY-028).
DeleteThe "Remove item" button asks "Remove [item] from your order? The amount drops N SAR". Confirming removes the item (PAY-028). If it is the last item: automatic cancellation and the result screen.
Call meConfirms to the store to wait for the call to the customer before acting, and shows the chosen number with "Another number" to change it for this item. Does not extend the window.
Cancel as selectedThe "Cancel the order" button asks "Cancel the whole order? The hold of N SAR is released". Confirming cancels the order automatically (MER-032); nothing is owed by the customer. The result screen appears.
Order from another groceryOn the cancellation screen: opens C04.
Contact supportOpens C21 linked to the order.

Special states for this page

  • The store has not proposed a substitute yet: "Awaiting store suggestion", and the accept-substitute button is hidden while delete and cancel remain.
  • Timeout expired with no response: the screen shows "We removed the item · New total N SAR" with a "Continue your order" button.
  • The merchant recorded the customer's reply after the call (replace, remove, cancel): the screen updates immediately with the result and the buttons are locked.
  • All items deleted, or the preselected "Cancel the order": automatic cancellation (MER-032) and the result screen appears.
  • Pre-selection "Delete it": this screen does not appear; a notification arrives "We removed the item and won't charge for it".
  • Cheaper substitute: a line "The amount decreases by X SAR" instead of payment.
  • Several out-of-stock items: a card for each item with its own counter.
  • Pharmacy order: the out-of-stock notification uses the phrase "Your order from the pharmacy" without the medicine name.

Validation and error messages

  • Another number for "Call me": a Saudi mobile of 10 digits starting with 05.
  • After the timeout expires: all buttons are disabled with the text "Timeout expired".

UX decisions

  • The counter is at the top because time is the most important thing on the screen.
  • The cancel button is red and goes through confirmation.
  • The result screen after automatic cancellation has a next step (another grocery) instead of a dead end.

Requirements that govern it

  • MER-032 Substitute for an out-of-stock product
  • PAY-028 Recalculation and partial refund
  • PAY-001 Payment and hold
  • ORD-004 Cancellation and alternative pickup

C13 AddressesManaging locations, entry instructions, and no-answer handling.

Page elements

  • Saved locations: the address list with an edit for each address, the default with a badge, and a "Driver adjusted entrance location · saved" badge on the address whose entrance the driver corrected
  • "Use my current location" button: in the address picker list
  • Distance warning: "Your current location is X km from the chosen address" when choosing the address (CUS-002)
  • Add steps: set location ← details ← save
  • Location confirmation: "Location confirmed" badge on the map (CUS-002)
  • Short national address (optional): when entered, the pin moves to its location, and the customer still has to confirm it
  • Address name: Home / Work / Other (free text)
  • Building, floor and apartment: three separate fields
  • Instructions: entry instructions
  • Entrance photo: an optional photo
  • Leave it at the door: under "What should the driver do if I don't answer": "Call me and wait" or "Leave it at the door"

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
AddOpens "New address" with the map on the device's location. On save the address is added and becomes the selected one for the current order if the customer came from C09, with the message "Address saved".
EditOpens the same form with the address values. Moving the pin cancels the confirmation and requires a new confirmation before saving. Editing does not change the address of an existing paid order.
Confirm locationPins the current pin as the address location, shows the neighborhood and street name below the map, and enables the save button. "Edit location" returns the map to dragging and cancels the confirmation.
Choose an addressMakes the address the delivery address for the current order and returns to the cart. If the device location is far away, a distance warning appears first with a "Deliver to (address name)" button to continue, without blocking.
Use my current locationNew: asks for location permission, then opens a new address form with the pin on the current location, and needs confirmation and saving like any address.
Entrance photoNew: opens the camera or gallery and attaches one photo that is shown to the driver during delivery only. It can be deleted or replaced.
Delete addressNew (from the edit window): confirmation "Delete home address? No existing order will be affected". The default address is deleted only after choosing another default.

Special states for this page

  • Location not confirmed: the save button is disabled and below it "Confirm the location on the map to save the address".
  • Address outside coverage: on confirmation "We don't deliver to this location yet" with a "Notify me" button (C24), and the address can be saved.
  • The driver corrected the entrance: the entrance location in the saved address updates (CUS-002) and the blue badge appears.
  • Location permission denied: the map opens on the city with the message "Turn on location or move the map manually".
  • No saved addresses: "Add your first address" with an add button.

Validation and error messages

  • Building is required: "Enter the building number or name."
  • Short national address in an invalid format: "Check the code, e.g. RRRD2929."
  • National address does not match a location: "We couldn't find this address, pick your location on the map."
  • Entry instructions: a maximum length with a counter under the field.
  • The "Other" name is required when it is chosen, and no two addresses repeat a name.

UX decisions

  • The map first, then the fields, because confirming the location is the condition for saving that prevents error.
  • Building, floor and apartment in one row of three short fields instead of a combined field.
  • The no-reply option is a single visible choice instead of a checkbox, so the driver clearly knows what to do.
  • A driver's correction of the entrance appears as a badge so the customer understands why the pin changed.

Requirements that govern it

  • CUS-002 Addresses and location accuracy
  • ORD-008 Customer unresponsiveness

C14 My accountAccess to balance, cards, addresses, tip, language, and support.

Page elements

  • Account data: the name and the mobile number masked
  • Wallet and cards: the balance card with a "Reward awaiting collection" alert if any, and the virtual card shortened to its last digits
  • Addresses: their count and the default address
  • Automatic tip: the amount and what reaches the driver after the deduction (CUS-010), with an on/off switch
  • Points and invites: the number of points available
  • Notifications: notification settings
  • Language: Arabic / English buttons directly in the row instead of a sub-page
  • Help: "Support" with two choices "Help with an order" or "Help with the app" (SUP-001)
  • Visitor card: "Browse freely, sign in when ordering" and a sign-in button

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
EditOpens the name edit window. The mobile number cannot be edited from here (see the questions). Saving updates the name immediately with "Your details were saved".
Open walletGoes to C20, and the pending reward, if any, is at the top of the page.
SupportBottom sheet: "Help with an order" (recent orders then C21 with order context) and "Help with the app" (C21 with no order number).
Sign outConfirmation: "Sign out of this device? Your cart and addresses stay saved in your account". After it, the page appears in visitor state and browsing continues without a verification code.
Auto tip (toggle)New: turning off is immediate with no confirmation, with "We turned off the automatic tip", so it is not added to the following orders. Turning on opens the amount or percentage picker (CUS-010).
LanguageNew: switches the app's language and direction immediately without signing in again, and saves the choice in the account.
NotificationsNew: turning off stops offer notifications only, after a confirmation explaining that order status and reward notifications remain because they concern your orders and their windows (24 hours for the reward).
Sign inNew (for a visitor): mobile number and code channel (SMS or WhatsApp) then the verification code (CUS-001).

Special states for this page

  • Visitor: a welcome card and a sign-in button, and the wallet, addresses, and points disappear.
  • Wrong or expired verification code: a message under the field with "Resend" after a countdown.
  • Automatic tip is paused: the line says "Paused" with no amount.

Validation and error messages

  • Name empty: "Enter your name".
  • Mobile number in a non-Saudi format: "Enter a mobile number starting with 5 and 9 digits long".
  • Automatic tip amount zero or negative: "Choose an amount or turn off the automatic tip".

Permissions

  • Visitor: any action that needs an account opens the sign-in window (CUS-001) then returns to the same action.

UX decisions

  • The balance card opens the wallet and alerts about the pending reward before it expires.
  • Each row shows its current value under its name so the customer does not need to open it to know.
  • Sign out in the danger color at the end of the menu with confirmation.

Requirements that govern it

  • CUS-001 Account and language
  • CUS-010 Tip Important
  • PAY-023 Customer cards
  • SUP-001 Reaching support

C26 Notifications NewAll of the customer's notifications about their orders and offers for the last 30 days in one place.

Page elements

  • Tabs: All, Orders, Offers (ADM-007)
  • Batching: today, this week, older
  • Notification: type icon, title, details line, time, unread mark, and status tag if any
  • Notification of adding the store the customer suggested (ADM-039)
  • Retention period line (INT-004) and a link to notification settings in "My account"

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Open notificationMarks it as read and opens its destination: an order opens C11 or, after delivery, C19; a reward opens C20; an offer opens C22 or the store.
Mark all as readUnread marks disappear and the bell counter on Home becomes zero.
Switch tabShows one type without reloading the page.
BackReturns to the previous page.

Special states for this page

  • No notifications: "No notifications in the last 30 days" with a "Browse stores" button.
  • Notifications turned off on the phone: a bar at the top of the page "Turn on notifications to get your order status" with a button to settings.

UX decisions

  • The unread counter on the home bell opens this page.
  • Unread is a colored dot beside the time, scannable at a glance.
  • Every notification opens its destination directly; no notification without a destination.

Requirements that govern it

  • INT-004 Notifications and messages
  • ADM-039 Contracting targets list
  • ADM-007 Alerts center

Navigates to

C11 Order tracking · C19 After delivery · C20 Wallet, cards and reward · C22 Offers and Hour Deal

C15 Pick it up yourselfStores eligible for self-pickup; Mart is excluded.

Page elements

  • List and map: a single segment to switch between them
  • Reference location for distance: "Near: Home" with the ability to change it
  • Sort: Nearest / Fastest ready / Has a pickup discount
  • Distance: per store
  • Ready time: per store
  • Pickup discount: if any (EXT-006)
  • Working hours: a branch status badge beside the name: open / closes in X minutes / closed and opens at X
  • Directions button: for each store
  • Explanation line below the list: you pay, then the order reaches the store and you pick it up yourself; does not include Mart, pharmacies, and write-in orders (EXT-006)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Choose a storeOpens C07 in "Pick up yourself" mode: no delivery fee and no tip, and the pickup discount, if any, in the cart. A closed store does not open for ordering and shows the opening time.
Open directionsOpens the maps app on the branch location without leaving or changing the order.
MapNew: switches the view to a map with pins for eligible stores; tapping a pin shows the store's card itself.
SortNew: reorders the list immediately by the selection.

Special states for this page

  • No eligible stores near you: "No stores for pickup near this address" with a change-address button.
  • A store closing soon: a warning badge; and an order whose readiness is after closing is not accepted (EXT-006).
  • A closed store: the card is faded with "Opens at X".
  • No location permission: the distance from the default address, shown under the address.

Validation and error messages

  • Entry from a Mart or pharmacy store link: no pickup option, and the message "Self-pickup is not available for this store".

UX decisions

  • The list is the default view because it is faster for comparison.
  • Branch status is a colored badge next to the name so the customer does not order from a branch that is closing.
  • The directions button is separate from opening the store to avoid mistaken taps.

Requirements that govern it

  • EXT-006 Self-pickup
  • ORD-002 Customer cancellation window

Navigates to

C07 Store page · C16 Your order is ready for pickup · C13 Addresses

C16 Your order is ready for pickupA persistent page with no code, with directions and pickup alerts.

Page elements

  • Store and branch: store name, and branch address and distance
  • Order number: in large type with "No code needed · The employee confirms pickup by order number" (EXT-006)
  • Ready status: a "Ready for X minutes" badge, and steps: you paid ← being prepared ← ready ← you picked up
  • Held amount: charged on pickup
  • Reminder, delay, and end of working hours: the alert "We will remind you if you do not pick up within 60 minutes, and if you do not pick up by the end of working hours the order is closed as "Not picked up" and referred to support" (EXT-006)
  • Directions: the primary button in the fixed bar, with support secondary next to it
  • Line for an order converted from delivery: "You converted your order to pickup · delivery fee and tip refunded"

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Open directionsOpens the maps app on the branch location. The page is saved in "My orders" and opens from the notification until pickup (EXT-006).
Contact supportOpens C21 with the order context and number automatically.
Pickup confirmation (from the merchant)New, no button for the customer: when the merchant enters the order number the page becomes "Received" and the amount is captured, then the C19 rating screen appears.

Special states for this page

  • Being prepared: before "Ready", the "Preparing" step and the expected time appear, without a big number.
  • During the cancellation window (EXT-006): a "Cancel order" button with a countdown, then it disappears.
  • Exceeding 60 minutes from Ready (EXT-006): a reminder notification and a yellow alert at the top of the page.
  • Not picked up by the end of the shift (EXT-006): it shows that the amount has not been deducted yet and that support will decide (second preview).
  • Picked up: a green badge and the pickup time then the rating.

UX decisions

  • The order number is the largest element because the customer reads it to the employee at the counter.
  • The held amount is shown with the time it is charged, so the customer does not worry about an early charge.
  • The end-of-shift rule is written in advance so the customer is not surprised by closure.

Requirements that govern it

  • EXT-006 Self-pickup
  • ORD-004 Cancellation and alternative pickup

Navigates to

C21 Support and tickets · C19 After delivery · C10 My orders

C17 Write-in order and delivery paymentA text order with photos or a prescription, then the delivery payment.

Page elements

  • Store: its name
  • Order steps: write and pay delivery ← the pharmacist reviews ← pay the invoice ← delivery
  • Order text: a field with a character counter
  • Photos or prescription: horizontal thumbnails of the attachments with a "Prescription" tag and a delete button for each attachment; and the text "Voice recording is not accepted" with no audio button (ORD-013)
  • Pharmacy alert before payment: "A medicine that needs a prescription has its order cancelled if you do not attach it. The prescription is seen by the pharmacist only, and the driver does not see it" (PHR-012)
  • The delivery fee, and an explanation that the invoice will arrive for payment: delivery now, then the products and service invoice is paid within the window (ORD-013)
  • Payment method: the default card first with "Change" (PAY-023)
  • Pay button: "Pay for delivery · N SAR"; and after payment a countdown on the cancel button only with no explanation (ORD-002)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
AttachOpens the camera or gallery (photos only). Each photo appears as a thumbnail and can be tagged "Prescription". A failed upload keeps the text and shows "Try again" on the thumbnail.
Pay for deliveryIn a pharmacy with no prescription attached, the "You didn't attach a prescription" window appears first (second preview). After payment, only delivery is held and the order page appears with a "Cancel" button with a counter, then the search for a driver and sending to the store (ORD-013). When the invoice arrives, a notification opens C18.
Attach the prescription nowNew (in the alert window): closes the window and opens the camera to attach the prescription.
My order does not need a prescriptionNew (in the alert window): continues payment; if the medicine needs a prescription, rejection and cancellation follow (PHR-012).
Cancel within 60 secondsNew: cancels the hold entirely and the order does not reach the store; after the window the button disappears and cancellation is through support only (ORD-002).

Special states for this page

  • A write-in store that is not a pharmacy: no prescription alert, and the attachment button is "Attach photos".
  • Store closed or outside coverage: payment disabled with the reason.
  • Pharmacist rejection for no prescription (PHR-012): the order page shows "Order rejected for no prescription · Support reviews the delivery fee".
  • Payment failure: the text and attachments remain, and the message "Payment was not completed, try another card".

Validation and error messages

  • Order text empty and no attachments: "Write your order or attach a photo".
  • Maximum character limit exceeded: input stops and the counter turns red.
  • Not an image, or too large: "Attach an image in JPG or PNG format".

Permissions

  • Visitor: sees the page in a "Sign in" state, and any action that needs an account opens the sign-in window with a mobile number (CUS-001) then returns to the same action.

UX decisions

  • The steps bar explains the two-stage payment before the customer pays.
  • The prescription alert is visible before payment, and repeats as a dialog only when nothing is attached at the pharmacy.
  • The prescription's privacy is stated explicitly to reassure the customer.

Requirements that govern it

  • ORD-013 Write-in orders
  • PHR-012 Pharmacy order
  • PAY-023 Customer cards
  • ORD-002 Customer cancellation window
