C18 Paying the write-in invoiceShows the original invoice and the 5% service fee separately.

Page elements

  • Total due: the amount due now in large type at the top of the screen
  • 10-minute counter: a circular grace-period counter next to the amount (ORD-013)
  • The required invoice photo: a thumbnail with its upload time and the ability to enlarge (ORD-013)
  • Products: the invoice amount line
  • 5% service: a line separate from the products (PAY-012)
  • Paid delivery: outside the total with a line "Delivery is prepaid · not added to this amount"
  • Default payment method: with "No payment fee on pharmacy" (PAY-012)
  • Pay button: "Pay · N SAR"
  • "Reject invoice" button: in danger color

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
PayAuthorizes a hold for the products + service (PAY-012) on the selected card. On success the counter stops, preparation starts and the customer returns to C11. On failure the counter stays with "Payment failed, try again or change the card".
RejectA confirmation dialog stating the effect: immediate cancellation with no undo, the invoice amount is not charged, and the delivery fee and tip are decided by support (ORD-013, CUS-010). After confirmation the order page becomes "Canceled · awaiting support decision".
SupportOpens C21 with the order context and number, and the counter keeps running visibly at the top of the chat.
Enlarge invoiceNew: shows the full invoice image with pinch zoom.

Special states for this page

  • Under two minutes: the counter turns red with "Less than two minutes left".
  • Timeout expired (ORD-013): "Payment window expired · Order cancelled and support will review the delivery fee", and the pay button disappears.
  • Payment done: both payments are held and captured at delivery.
  • The invoice has not arrived yet: the page is not opened, and tracking shows "The pharmacist is reviewing your order".

Validation and error messages

  • The invoice photo or its amount is missing (ORD-013): "The invoice is incomplete, we are contacting the store."

Permissions

  • Visitor: sees the page in a "Sign in" state, and any action that needs an account opens the sign-in window with a mobile number (CUS-001) then returns to the same action.

UX decisions

  • The amount and the counter are at the top of the screen because they are what the customer needs to decide.

Requirements that govern it

  • ORD-013 Write-in orders
  • PAY-012 Mart and pharmacy percentages
  • CUS-010 Tip Important
  • ORD-004 Cancellation and alternative pickup
  • PHR-012 Pharmacy order

C11 Order tracking · C21 Support and tickets · C10 My orders

C19 After deliveryA separate rating, help, tip, and purchase order.

Page elements

  • Delivery confirmation: delivery time, and "This order's points are on hold until the report window ends" (MKT-010)
  • Store rating and delivery rating: the food (store) rating and the delivery (driver) rating are separate, with quick reasons (CUS-006)
  • Tip: preset amounts or "Other", with what reaches the driver after the deduction (CUS-010)
  • Repeating the tip: the option "Use the same tip in my upcoming orders" (CUS-010)
  • Send button: fixed, sends the rating and tip together and states the tip amount if chosen
  • Complaint dialog: a report-window counter and its expiry time (SUP-005), "Report a shortage" and "I did not receive it" buttons, and for Mart "Damaged or expired item" with a photo
  • Driver chat button (C25): as long as the chat is open
  • Purchase order: link
  • Invoice if any: the store's invoice, or "Not available" when absent

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Submit ratingSaves both ratings linked to the order (CUS-006) and pays the selected tip if any, then "Thanks for your rating". One rating is enough.
TipChoosing a preset amount or "Other"; it is charged to the default card on sending. "Use the same tip" makes it automatic (CUS-010), and the customer stops it from C14.
Shortage reportOpens C21 on "Missing or wrong item" with this order's items, with a photo from the app camera (SUP-002). It disappears after the grace period ends (SUP-005).
Didn't arriveOpens C21 on "Did not arrive" without a photo, and the evidence file is attached automatically for support (SUP-002).
Damaged or expired itemNew (Mart): opens C21 with the "Damaged or expired" type with a mandatory photo; the reply comes after support review, not automatically (SUP-009).
Driver chatNew: opens C25 for the same order.
Purchase orderNew: shows the purchase order PDF with download and share.

Special states for this page

  • After the one-hour window (SUP-005): the report buttons remain, and the report reaches the support agent with an "After window" badge.
  • Previously rated: the stars are read-only with "Thanks for your rating".
  • Self-pickup order: delivery rating, tip, and "I didn't receive it" disappear.
  • Tip payment failure: the rating is saved and "The tip was not paid, try again" appears.

Validation and error messages

  • "Other" tip amount: a positive number with two decimal places, otherwise "Enter a valid amount".
  • Comment: a maximum character limit with a counter.

UX decisions

  • Rating first, then the tip, then the problem, in the order most customers act.
  • The net tip is visible so the customer trusts the amount.
  • The report window is a visible counter so the customer is not surprised when it ends.

Requirements that govern it

  • CUS-006 Reorder, favorites and rating
  • CUS-010 Tip Important
  • SUP-005 Complaint window
  • SUP-009 Mart quality assurance
  • MKT-010 Customer loyalty via OpenLoyalty Important
  • SUP-002 Shortage, damage and non-arrival

C21 Support and tickets · C25 Chat with the driver · C14 My account

C20 Wallet, cards, and rewardsBalances clear by type and expiry, and reward actions.

Page elements

  • Available balance: the total, with "We spend the nearest to expiry first and refund credit last", and under the heading "No top-up and no withdrawal" (PAY-002)
  • 24-hour reward: the pending reward with its amount, reason and a claim countdown, above the balances (PAY-002)
  • Refund, compensation and promotional: the credits by type, sorted by nearest expiry, and each credit's source and expiry date on one line
  • Card refund in progress: the amount, order, status and arrival time (PAY-003), with "Convert to wallet now"
  • Cards: "Saved with Moyasar; we do not store your full card number" (PAY-023), and "Default" and "Delete" buttons inside each card's row
  • Default: a badge on the default card
  • Balance activity: every addition, deduction, and return, including the return of promotional credit from a canceled order
  • Reward page (from the notification): amount, type, validity, and reason, and a large "Claim reward" button stating the amount

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Claim rewardAdds the amount immediately as compensation credit with its expiry date (PAY-002), the reward card disappears, and a line appears in the activity and the message "We added N SAR to your wallet". After the grace period the button is disabled and "Reward expired" appears.
Add cardOpens the secure Moyasar form for entering and verifying the card. Success adds it with the last 4 digits and asks "Make it the default?". Failure shows Moyasar's reason in simple language.
Delete cardConfirm "Delete [type] card •• [last 4 digits]? It will not appear at payment". Existing orders with a hold on it are not affected. Deleting the default asks you to choose another if one exists.
Change defaultMakes the card the default immediately with a short message (PAY-023).
Move it to the wallet nowNew: confirmation "Transfer N SAR to your wallet instead of the card? It becomes a non-expiring refund credit and does not return to the card"; after that it is added immediately (PAY-003).
Open movementNew: shows the type, reason, reference (order number or ticket), date, and expiry date.

Special states for this page

  • Reward expired: it appears in the activity in gray "Not claimed within 24 hours".
  • Credit expiring within 3 days: a warning badge beside it.
  • A canceled order used promotional credit: the credit returns (PAY-003, MKT-002) and "Refunded from order #..." appears.
  • Editing a support decision: a reversing entry in the transaction linked to the original "Edit ticket decision #...".
  • No cards: "Add a card to pay quickly" with the add button.
  • Wallet at zero: an empty state explaining the balance sources (refund, compensation, invite a friend, points).

Validation and error messages

  • Moyasar rejected the card: "We couldn't add the card, check its details or try another card".
  • Claiming an expired reward: the button is disabled and the request is rejected on the server.

Permissions

  • Visitor: sees the page in a "Sign in" state, and any action that needs an account opens the sign-in window with a mobile number (CUS-001) then returns to the same action.

UX decisions

  • The pending reward is above the balances because it is the only one that is lost if the customer does not act.
  • Delete card in danger color with confirmation.

Requirements that govern it

  • PAY-002 Wallet and rewards
  • PAY-003 Refunds
  • PAY-023 Customer cards
  • MKT-002 Consecutive-order rewards

C21 Support and ticketsHelp with an order or the app, with context and evidence.

Page elements

  • Order: a card with the number, store, status and amount, and "The order number is attached automatically" (SUP-001)
  • Report grace-period counter: next to the order (SUP-005)
  • Problem type: a grid of large cards with icons that change with the order status (SUP-001): before delivery "Where is my order" and "I want to cancel", after it "Missing or wrong item", "Damaged item", "I did not receive it" and "Payment or amount", and for Mart "Damaged or expired item"
  • Items: select the affected items from the order's items
  • Camera photo upon damage: from the app camera only and the button says so explicitly (SUP-002)
  • Chat: the ticket chat
  • Status: the ticket steps Received ← Review ← Resolved, and the "My tickets" list with each ticket's status
  • Resolution and satisfaction: a support decision card (the resolution, the amount and its destination wallet or card, the reason, executor, and time), then "Was your problem resolved?" Yes / No, and "Appeal the decision"
  • "Help in the app" entry: without an order number

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Open ticketSubmits the report with its type, items, photo and order number, and opens the chat with the message "We received your report". Sending is disabled until the conditions are complete (SUP-002). The ticket appears in "My tickets" with the status "Under review".
AttachOpens the app camera directly for the item report (no gallery), and accepts additional photos in the chat.
ReplySends the message in the ticket chat with the status "Sent". After the ticket is closed it becomes "Open a new ticket".
Rate the resolution"Yes" closes the ticket with a satisfaction rating. "No, I need help" reopens it and routes it to a staff member.
Where is my orderNew (before delivery): shows the status and expected time from C11 without opening a ticket, with "Not resolved? Talk to support".
I want to cancelNew: within the window, the order is canceled directly with confirmation. After it, "After 60 seconds, cancellation is through support only" appears and a chat opens with a cancellation request carrying the order context (ORD-004).
Payment or amountNew: opens a dispute ticket on this order's amount with the payment summary attached.
Appeal the decisionNew: asks for the reason for the appeal as text and returns the ticket to "Under review". If the decision is amended, the reversing entry appears in C20 linked to the ticket (SUP-003).

Special states for this page

  • Every report is reviewed by an employee and there is no automated reply (SUP-004): "The support team is reviewing your report and we will reply".
  • Repeated violation: an alert at the top of the page (SUP-007).
  • A restricted customer (SUP-007): the self-report buttons disappear and "Talk to support" remains.
  • After the one-hour window (SUP-005): the item report buttons remain, and the report reaches the support agent with an "After window" badge.
  • Mart report of a damaged or expired item: "The item price is refunded after support review" (SUP-009).
  • Decision escalated to a higher level (SUP-002): "Your order is with the support supervisor".
  • Smart reply enabled later: messages tagged "Automated assistant" with a "Talk to an agent" button.

Validation and error messages

  • Item report without choosing an item: "Choose the affected item".
  • Item report without a photo: the send button is disabled and below it "Take the photo to enable sending".
  • Duplicate report for the same item: "You have an open report for this item" with an option to open it.
  • Appeal without a reason: "Enter the reason for your appeal".

Permissions

  • Visitor: sees the page in a "Sign in" state, and any action that needs an account opens the sign-in window with a mobile number (CUS-001) then returns to the same action. App help is available to the visitor.

UX decisions

  • Problem buttons before any form.
  • A support decision is a clear card, not a message lost in the conversation.
  • Appeal is a secondary link so it isn't pressed by mistake, and satisfied is two large buttons.

Requirements that govern it

  • SUP-001 Reaching support
  • SUP-002 Shortage, damage and non-arrival
  • SUP-003 Cause and cost attribution
  • SUP-007 Trust thresholds in refunds
  • SUP-009 Mart quality assurance
  • SUP-005 Complaint window
  • ORD-004 Cancellation and alternative pickup

C22 Offers and Hour DealOffers available within the zone; a countdown to the end of the schedule.

Page elements

  • Address used for offers: in the header with "Change" (CUS-015)
  • Categories: All / Hour Deal / Free delivery / Restaurants / Mart
  • Sort "Most savings first" (CUS-015)
  • Active offers: for each offer the discount and prices (amount saved), the duration, offer terms (minimum and others), a primary button "Add product" and a secondary "Open store"
  • Hour Deal stock and the recurring schedule: one prominent card: the product, the price before and after and the discount percentage, a countdown to the end of the period such as "Ends [time] for everyone", the actual stock "X of Y left", and the schedule such as "Daily [from] – [to]" (MKT-017)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Open storeOpens C07 with the offer prominent at the top of the page and its conditions visible.
Add productAdds the product at the offer price and an "Added to cart · View cart" bar appears. If the offer stock runs out or the period ends before adding, "Offer ended" appears and it is added at the regular price only after the customer agrees.
Add to cart (Hour Deal)New: like adding a product, and the discounted price lasts until the end of the scheduled period (MKT-017); afterwards the regular price returns in the cart with an alert.
Change addressNew: opens C13, then the offers eligible for the new address are restored.

Special states for this page

  • Hour Deal stock ran out or its period ended: it disappears immediately (CUS-015).
  • Upcoming Hour Deal (recurring): "Starts tomorrow [time]" with no add button.
  • No offers for your address: "No offers reach your address now" with change address.
  • No address selected (visitor): the location is requested first (CUS-015).

Permissions

  • A visitor sees offers after setting their location, adding to the cart is available, and payment requires login.

UX decisions

  • The Hour Deal is a prominent card because the counter and stock drive the purchase decision.
  • "For everyone" beside the end time clarifies that the counter does not start when the customer enters.
  • The address is in the header so the customer understands why they see these offers.

Requirements that govern it

  • CUS-015 Offers page Important
  • MKT-017 Recurring Hour Deal

C24 No driver or coverageA clear action for the problem, without showing an unavailable store.

Page elements

  • Status reason: a timeline of what happened: search started, support notified, awaiting choice (ORD-004)
  • After 15 minutes: eligible pickup for 5 minutes or refund: two visible options, "Pick it up yourself from the branch" (distance, ready time, and "Your delivery fee is refunded") and "Cancel the order and get a full refund" (the amount and its destination), with a red choice-timeout counter above the fold (ORD-004)
  • Mart: support and refund: "Our support team is handling your order: assigning a driver or canceling with a full refund" (ORD-004)
  • Location: a map with the customer's location when outside coverage
  • Coverage interest: a one-step "Notify me when covered" button (ADM-033)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Notify meThe pin location sends a coverage request (ADM-033) and "We received your request, we will notify you when the service arrives" appears. The button becomes "We registered your interest" and does not repeat for the same location.
Self-pickup for non-MartConverts the order once (EXT-006, CUS-010), and C16 opens with the status "Being prepared". It does not appear in Mart.
RefundConfirm "Cancel the order and refund N SAR in full to your card?". After that the hold is released (PAY-001) and the order appears as "Cancelled · Full refund" in C10.
SupportOpens C21 with the order context. In Mart it is the primary action.

Special states for this page

  • Before 15 minutes: "Looking for a driver" with elapsed time, with no options.
  • Mart after 15 minutes: "Support is following up on your order" with a support button only.
  • Driver accepted while the options were showing: the screen disappears and the order returns to tracking with "We found a driver".
  • Outside coverage: the second preview, without showing any unavailable store.
  • Interest previously recorded: "We recorded your interest in this location" with a location edit.

Validation and error messages

  • Switching to pickup after the grace period ends or after a driver accepts: "This option is no longer available".

UX decisions

  • Choose one of two options with their financial consequences, and a primary button that follows the choice.
  • The timeline prevents the customer from feeling the order was neglected.

16Merchant app

Preparation, handover, menu, and team. It has 14 pages, ordered as they are used. Under each page are an illustrative preview, its elements, its actions, and the requirements that govern it. The five states shared in "Shared page states" are not repeated here.

M01 OrdersA work screen for the merchant according to their type and branches.

Page elements

  • New, preparing, and ready: tabs with the order count in each (MER-006)
  • Bell: a ringing line on the new card "Ringing on … devices until one of you opens it", then after interaction "Opened by … · … · …" (device, employee, and time) on all devices (MER-030)
  • A 3-minute duration: a circular timer for the duration-edit window, with the default duration and a −/+ control (ORD-003, MER-040)
  • Products and notes: the order items, and the customer note on a yellow background
  • Customer ID: their ID number only (MER-006)
  • Late alert with no deduction: in the Preparing tab a countdown timer of the remaining duration, which turns red and negative on overrun with "Support was informed of the times, and no automatic deduction from your balance" and a link "View order times" (ORD-007)
  • Branch status badge: top of the screen (open / busy +… until … / temporarily closed) with "Visible to customers" or "Not visible"
  • Not-visible bar: red "Your store is not visible to customers" with the reason as text (MER-028)
  • Driver arrival bar: green at the top of the list in all tabs "Driver arrived … for order #… · waiting since …" with a "Hand over order" button (MER-020, MER-019)
  • Order type badge: delivery · menu, or Mart, or write-in, or self-pickup, or "Converted to self-pickup"
  • Out-of-stock badge: "Out of stock" and the timeout timer on the order awaiting the customer's reply, with a "Record customer reply" button (MER-032)
  • Write-in badge: "Awaiting invoice" or "Awaiting customer payment …" instead of a ready button
  • Printer bar: on disconnection "Printer not connected — … awaiting printing and will print when it returns" (MER-042)
  • Order of preparation cards: late first, then the closest to the end of its duration

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Approve durationThe "Approve … minutes" button approves the displayed duration without confirmation: the ringing stops on all devices and the device and employee appear on them, and the order moves to "Preparing" and the −/+ control disappears (ORD-003)
DetailsOpens M02 for the order; preparation starts if it has not started (ORD-003) and the ringing stops on all devices
ReadyA single press without confirmation: the order moves to "Ready" and notifies the driver, or the customer in self-pickup, with a transient notification "Order #… ready" (MER-006). In write-in orders it is disabled with the text "Available after customer payment" (ORD-013)
Out of stockOpens the order's item list to select the out-of-stock item, then the same out-of-stock window in M02 (M02_2) (MER-032)
Hand over the orderFrom the driver arrival bar: opens M03 for the order with the code field ready for typing
−/+ prep timeChanges the suggested duration in 5-minute steps before approval; nothing is saved until "Approve duration"
View order timesOpens M02 on the "Order times" section (ORD-007)
Record the customer's replyOpens the active out-of-stock window (M02_2) with the number and the remaining timer
Branch status badgeOpens M09 to change the status or busy state
Not-visible barOpens the place of resolution by the reason: M09 for status and hours, M05 for out-of-stock, M12 to message admin when the city is paused
Printer barOpens M15

Special states for this page

  • A new order is ringing: the card has an orange border until a device interacts (MER-030)
  • Edit window expired without approval: the edit tool disappears and the order moves to "Preparing" with the default duration (ORD-003)
  • Late: the card has a red border and a negative timer (ORD-007)
  • Out of stock, pending: the card has an orange border and a timer; when it ends its text becomes "Item removed automatically" (MER-032)
  • Driver arrived: the green bar stays until the code is entered
  • Converted to self-pickup: the order badge changes and the driver disappears, and handover is by order number (EXT-006)
  • Cancelled during preparation (by support, for out of stock, or for non-payment of a write-in): a gray card "Cancelled — stop preparing" and an "Acknowledged" button that removes it
  • Store not visible: the red bar is fixed at the top of the screen until visibility returns
  • Device offline: a bar "No internet connection — orders reach the branch's other devices and print on the receiving device, and will appear here when you are back" (MER-042)
  • Mart account: the default duration is approved automatically and it has one optional edit (ORD-003), and "Details" opens M08 (MER-031)

Validation and error messages

  • Duration: the − button is disabled at 1 minute and the + button at the maximum (ORD-003), and no value outside them can be typed
  • Approval from another device after approval is rejected with the message "Another device approved it … minutes ago"

Permissions

  • Screen and ringing: the "Orders" permission at the branch (merchant manager, branch manager, authorized employee, prep account)
  • "Hand over the order" button: "Handover" permission only
  • No reject button for any role (MER-006), and no financial amounts on the cards

UX decisions

  • The approve button carries the duration and takes two thirds of the width, and "Details" is a secondary button.
  • A circular timer next to the −/+ control instead of a number pad, for kitchen speed.
  • The branch status badge is always visible because not appearing stops orders.

M02 Order detailsPreparation, driver, events, and invoice by type.

Page elements

  • Preparation: status steps at the top of the page (arrived → preparing → ready → picked up) with a large counter for the time remaining
  • Items and options: each item with its options and an "Out of stock" button next to it, and the components of the bundled meal with the customer's choice for each component under its name (MER-024)
  • The customer's out-of-stock choice: at the top of the item list (remove it / call me / cancel the order), without any number (MER-032)
  • Item status after going out of stock: struck through "Removed · Out of stock", or "Substitute: … · Awaiting customer approval / Approved"
  • Driver by ID: his ID number and status (on the way · arrives in … / arrived … ago) and his waiting time (MER-019)
  • Order times: arrival time, preparation start and its reason, approved duration, expected readiness, actual "Ready" time, driver arrival, pickup (ORD-007, ORD-003)
  • Invoice optional, or required for write-in: its status (no invoice / attached from the cashier / uploaded manually) with an archive link (MER-036)
  • Amounts: the product value, and the merchant's net per the contract
  • Customer chat button: in the top bar with the unread message count (MER-022)
  • Order log: every action with employee, device, and time (MER-037, MER-030)
  • Penalty line for delay or cancellation: "Any penalty is a manual support decision with a written reason, and appears in your statement" (ORD-007)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
PrintSends the order ticket (MER-021) with the duration, without the customer's name and number, and "Sent to print" appears. Without a printer: "No printer connected" and a button that opens M15
SubstituteFor an item recorded as "Substitute": opens the store's available products to choose the substitute and its quantity with the price difference. "Send the substitute to the customer" sends it to C12, and the item shows "Awaiting customer approval" then "Approved" or "Rejected" (MER-032)
InvoiceIn menu and Mart: photograph or upload a file, saved in the archive by order number. In write-in and pharmacy, opens M04 (MER-036)
ReadyAs in M01, then returns to M01 with a transient notification. Disabled for write-in before payment, and disabled with the text "Record the customer's reply on the out-of-stock item first" if an item is awaiting a reply
TicketOpens M12 with a new ticket linked to the order number
Out of stock (per item)Opens an "Out of stock" window per the customer's choice (MER-032): "Delete it": confirmation "The item will be deleted and the captured amount reduced ... SAR" then it is deleted and the customer sees the update; "Call me": the number the customer chose for this item, the grace-period timer, a "Call customer" button and "Substitute / Delete / Cancel" buttons; "Cancel the order": confirmation "The order will be cancelled automatically and the full amount refunded to the customer because of an out-of-stock item, and referred to support, which may set a penalty. This cannot be undone"
Substitute / remove / cancel (in the out-of-stock window)"Replace" opens the "Substitute" action; "Remove" deletes the item and updates the amount; "Cancel" asks for confirmation with the impact and then cancels the order (MER-032). After any button, or when the window ends, the number disappears and the timer stops
Call the customerOpens a phone call to the number; the number is not copied anywhere else
Customer chatOpens M13 for the order
Share PDFFrom the print menu: creates the order file or its invoice and opens mobile sharing (MER-021)

Special states for this page

  • Late: a red strip "You exceeded the preparation time by … min. Support has been informed of the times, and there is no automatic deduction from your balance" and the times section is open (ORD-007)
  • Item awaiting customer reply: an orange bar with the timer reopens the out-of-stock window
  • Deleted item: the amounts update
  • Substitute rejected: the item is removed
  • Canceled order: all buttons disappear and a bar appears with the reason (by support, item out of stock, non-payment) and "Do not continue preparing"
  • Closed order: the page is read-only, and the chat is closed
  • Self-pickup: the driver card is replaced by "The customer picks it up themselves · match the order number"
  • Driver changed after reassignment: the new ID and the line "Driver changed …"

Validation and error messages

  • Upload an invoice: image or PDF only; anything else is rejected with "Upload an image or a PDF file"
  • Substitute: cannot be sent without a product and quantity; the message "Choose the substitute product"

Permissions

  • View order, print, out of stock, and ready: "Orders" permission
  • Merchant net and amounts per contract: "Finance" permission only; others see the products value only
  • Order log: branch manager and merchant manager

UX decisions

  • Steps and the counter are at the top because they are what the kitchen needs most.
  • "Ready" alone is the primary button in the sticky bar, and the other four actions are a secondary row.
  • The out-of-stock sheet is a bottom sheet within thumb reach: the number large, then the call button, then three buttons in different colors, and Cancel in red with confirmation.

M13 Customer chat New ImportantA text chat between the merchant and the customer of an active order using masked numbers, such as getting their approval to remove an out-of-stock item or its substitute, closed when the order is closed.

Page elements

  • Chat header: the customer by their ID, the order number and its status, and an "Open order" button
  • Fixed alert in the header: "A chat for this order only. Numbers are hidden for both parties, and the chat closes when the order closes"
  • Messages: with the time, and the sending employee's name is shown to the merchant only
  • System lines: what was recorded in the order, such as "Recorded … "Replace" for item … · …"
  • Quick replies: "An item is out of stock, should we remove it?", "Do you accept a substitute?", "Your order will be ready soon"
  • Fixed write bar at the bottom of the screen: a text field, a photo button, and a send button

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
SendThe message appears immediately with the time, and a notification reaches the customer in their app
Quick replyPlaces the text in the field for the employee to edit and then send
PhotoOpens the camera or gallery to send a photo (such as the proposed substitute)
Open orderReturns to M02 or M04

Special states for this page

  • Empty conversation: "Start the conversation with the customer about this order" with the quick replies
  • New message from the customer: a count badge on the chat button in M02 and M04 and a short sound alert
  • Order closed (delivered or canceled): messages are read-only and the input field is hidden with the text "Order closed; messages cannot be sent" (MER-022)
  • Send failure: the message has a red mark and "Resend" without losing the text

Validation and error messages

  • Empty message: the send button is disabled
  • Sending after the order is closed is rejected on the server with the same message

Permissions

  • "Orders" permission in the order's branch; the chat appears on all authorized branch devices

UX decisions

  • The privacy alert in the header so the agent does not ask for the customer's number.
  • Quick replies cover common out-of-stock cases in one tap.
  • System lines link what was said in the chat to what was recorded in the order.

Requirements that govern it

  • MER-022 Merchant chat with the customer Important

M03 Order handoverDriver pickup by code; customer self-pickup by order number.

Page elements

  • Driver and ID: an arrival alert at the top of the page "Driver arrived … · within store range · waiting since …" (MER-020, MER-019)
  • Range badge: within or outside the range (ORD-005)
  • Driver code: one large numeric field with spaced digits and a direct numeric keypad (ORD-005)
  • Write-in payment status: for a write-in order (ORD-013)
  • Photo: the "Order photo at delivery" button, saved with the order (ORD-005)
  • Pickup type: in a checklist before handover with the order number, the number of items and bags (and the cooler in Mart)
  • Self-pickup matching: the order number large and a "Number the customer shows" field with a "Match" or "No match" badge (EXT-006)
  • Self-pickup payment: "Paid online · Captured on confirmation" and the readiness time and closing time
  • A "Driver doesn't have the code? Open a ticket" link

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Enter driver codeThe field is enabled when the driver reaches the store's area, and the server verifies the code and the area (ORD-005)
Confirm deliveryWith the driver: sends the code; on success the order becomes "Picked up by driver", the photo is saved and the customer sees "Delivering", then a short success page and a return to M01 with a "Order #… handed over" notification. In self-pickup: after matching, a confirmation "Hand over order #… to the customer? The amount is captured and cannot be undone" then the order is closed "Received" (EXT-006)
Order photo at deliveryOpens the camera and attaches the photo to the order
Open a ticketOpens M12 with a ticket linked to the order and the subject "Handover"

Special states for this page

  • Driver on the way: the field is disabled with the text "Available when the driver arrives · arrives in …"
  • Driver outside range: a red badge and the button disabled "Ask the driver to get closer to the store"
  • Unpaid write-in order: the button is disabled "No handover before customer payment" (ORD-013)
  • Self-pickup waiting for the customer: an alert "If they do not come by the end of working hours, the order is closed as "Not collected" and referred to support"; and after closing it is read-only with the status "Not collected · awaiting support decision" (EXT-006)

Validation and error messages

  • Wrong code: the field is red "The code is incorrect. Ask the driver for it again"
  • Driver outside range at send: "The driver is outside the store's range, delivery is not possible now"
  • Self-pickup number does not match: "The number does not match #…. Check that it's the right order" and the button is disabled

Permissions

  • The page and its actions: the "Handover" permission at the branch

UX decisions

  • One primary button at the bottom with a clear verb "Confirm handover to the driver" or "Hand over order #… to the customer".
  • Self-pickup is a standalone blue screen so it is not confused with handover to the driver.

M04 Write-in orders and invoiceAccept for processing or reject before the invoice, then upload it for payment.

Page elements

  • Write-in order steps: review ← invoice ← payment ← preparation ← ready
  • Text and photos: what the customer wrote and attached
  • The prescription is for the store only: with the note "The prescription is for the store only and does not appear in any report"
  • Invoice and its amount: the invoice photo and the products amount; the submitted photo is saved in the archive under the order number (MER-036)
  • Preview of what the customer pays: products and service fee shown separately, then the total; delivery was paid earlier and is not included; updates as the amount is entered (ORD-013)
  • Payment status: and who sent the invoice, from which device, and when
  • 10-minute counter: after sending, the screen turns into a large circular timer instead of the form (ORD-013)
  • Customer chat button: in the top bar to clarify items (MER-022)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Reject before invoiceOnly before the invoice is uploaded (ORD-004): a window to choose the reason (not available with us / no prescription / invalid prescription / other reason with text), then the confirmation "The order will be closed as "Rejected before invoice" and referred to support to decide what is refunded to the customer. This cannot be undone". After it, the customer and driver are notified and the order disappears from the list (PHR-012)
Upload and sendValidates the image and the amount, then the confirmation "After sending you cannot reject the order. The customer will be asked to pay … SAR within 10 minutes". After it the invoice is saved, the payment request reaches the customer (C18), the timer starts, and the reject button disappears (ORD-013, MER-036)
TicketOpens M12 with a ticket linked to the order
Customer chatOpens M13 for the order
ReadyWorks as in M01 after payment (ORD-013)

Special states for this page

  • Awaiting customer payment: "Ready" is disabled with the text "Available after customer payment", no rejection after the invoice is uploaded, and invoice correction is allowed once before payment (ORD-013)
  • Customer paid: a notification and a short ring "Customer paid order #… — start preparing", and the step becomes "Prepare"
  • Customer rejected or the window ended: "Canceled for non-payment — don't prepare. Referred to support" and the page is read-only (ORD-013)
  • Rejected before the invoice: read-only with the chosen reason
  • Pharmacy: preview with the service fee only (ORD-013)

Validation and error messages

  • No photo: "Attach the invoice photo before sending" and the button is disabled
  • No amount or a zero amount: "Enter the products amount as on the invoice"
  • Amount with at most two decimal places: "Enter the amount like 100.00"
  • Rejection with the reason "Other" without text: "Enter the reason for rejection"

Permissions

  • Rejecting and uploading the invoice: the "Orders" permission (MER-030)

UX decisions

  • The main button carries the amount "Upload and send · … SAR", and reject is a secondary red button.
  • A "No rejection after sending" warning directly above the button.

M05 Menu and availabilityManaging the restaurant or Shops menu according to permission.

Page elements

  • Shift: the menu active now and the time of the next ("Morning · active now", "Evening · from …") (MER-005)
  • Search and filters: search by name, and filters All, Not visible, Pending review, Suspended, with the count
  • Products: for each product the preparation time in minutes, and a "Bundled meal" badge with the number of its components (MER-040, MER-024)
  • Original price and customer price: merchant price → customer price in one line
  • Product availability time: the time or "Follows the menu period" (MER-005)
  • Availability: a visibility badge with the reason written under the product: visible, outside availability time, suspended until a time, pending review, unavailable due to an out-of-stock component (MER-028, MER-024)
  • Review: the product awaiting price review (MER-002)
  • Sizes and add-ons: shared option groups
  • Cashier sync: the status and the last sync time (MER-024)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
AddOpens M06 with a new product (or combo meal) in the selected menu
EditTapping the product opens M06
ActivateToggle: turning it on shows the product if the remaining conditions are met (MER-005); otherwise the badge shows the reason. Turning it off hides it immediately until it is turned on manually, with no confirmation, with a notice "… stopped" and an "Undo" button
Temporary suspensionBottom sheet: one or more products, and the duration (one hour, two hours, until end of day, until a specific time). After "Pause until …" a badge "Paused until … · returns automatically" appears (MER-004)
Sizes and add-onsOpens the shared option groups for editing
Switch menuThe menu chip shows morning or evening products; a menu that is not enabled does not appear (MER-005)

Special states for this page

  • Menu not active now: a bar "The evening menu starts …; its products do not appear to customers before then"
  • Product returned automatically: the badge disappears and "Returned automatically …" is logged (MER-004)
  • Unavailable meal: a red badge with the out-of-stock component, and it becomes available again automatically when it is back or a substitute is added (MER-024)
  • Product awaiting price review: the proposed price is shown (MER-002)
  • Cashier sync failure: a bar "Sync failed … — the menu works with the last version" with "Retry"
  • A Mart store: the screen does not appear, and the Products tab opens M07 (MER-005)

Validation and error messages

  • Temporary suspension until a time that has passed: "Choose a time after now"

Permissions

  • View the menu, activation, and temporary suspension: "Products" permission
  • Edit price: the "Prices" permission; others see the price as text only
  • The branch manager edits their branch's products only, within the permissions cap (MER-002)

UX decisions

  • The "Not visible" filter gathers everything needing intervention in one click.
  • Temporary suspension with ready-made durations and a clear return time instead of a permanent suspension the employee forgets.

M06 Product and price editA clear preview of the menu price, the selling price, and the approved price range.

Page elements

  • Name, description, and image: product fields
  • Edit limit: a badge for the price edit mode for your store (not allowed, needs review, within a percentage with the percentage, full) (MER-002)
  • Approved price: the last price approved by admin, and the allowed range without review in numbers ("from … to …")
  • Proposed price: what the merchant types, and the review status if any "Your proposal … awaiting review since …"
  • Customer price: now and after approval together, with the line "The selling price is set by the manager"
  • Preparation time: in minutes (MER-040)
  • Availability time: with the period of the menu the product belongs to for comparison ("Within the morning menu period …") (MER-005)
  • Options: the product options; for a combo meal, the component list, each component's options and the availability of each option, and the meal's status (available / unavailable) (MER-024)
  • Cashier: product link and sync status (MER-024)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Save allowedAvailable when the price is within the range or the mode is "Full" or without a price change: it saves immediately without confirmation and the customer price is updated, and returns to M05 with a "Saved" notification. Disabled when the edit needs review, or the mode is "Prohibited" (MER-002)
Submit for reviewAppears as primary when the price is outside the range or the pattern is "Needs review": confirmation "... remains the price for customers until admin approves ...". After it an "Awaiting review" badge appears in M05, the request reaches admin (A08), and non-price edits are saved immediately (MER-002)
PreviewProduct card as the customer sees it: image, name, current customer price, preparation time, and options
Temporary suspensionChoosing the return time; the product disappears until the time (MER-004)
Add ingredientFor a bundled meal: choose a product from the menu as a component and set its alternative options
Product photoOpens the camera or gallery; the new photo is saved with the product

Special states for this page

  • "Not allowed" mode: the price field is locked with the text "Price editing is not available for your store. To change, contact admin" and a button that opens M12
  • Pending review: the price field shows the proposed price, and below it "The customer sees … until approved"
  • Suggestion rejected: a bar "Admin rejected …: Reason…" and the field returns to the approved price
  • Unavailable meal: a red bar in the page header with the out-of-stock component's name (MER-024)
  • Product synced from the cashier: fields coming from it are shown with "From cashier"

Validation and error messages

  • Preparation time above the limit: "Maximum preparation time is 40 minutes" and it is not saved (MER-040)
  • Preparation time empty or zero: "Enter the preparation time in minutes"
  • Price out of range: the field is red "Outside the allowed range; it will be sent for review, and … stays for customers until approval" (MER-002)
  • Availability end before its start: "Availability end must be after its start"
  • Availability time outside the menu period: "The time is outside the morning menu period (…)"
  • Meal component without an option: "Add at least one option for each component"

Permissions

  • Name, description, image, availability, and prep time: the "Products" permission
  • Price field: the "Prices" permission within the merchant's cap (MER-002)

UX decisions

  • The main button switches automatically between "Save allowed" and "Send for review" depending on the entered price.
  • The range in numbers, not the percentage alone, so the merchant knows in advance whether it will be reviewed.

M07 Mart catalogs and productsChoose a full group, then customize it locally.

Page elements

  • Primary, secondary and general: the catalogs (MER-010)
  • Subscriptions: for each catalog the subscription status, the number of products, and the number added automatically this week
  • Products: search by name and a barcode search button, and filters: All, central, locally modified, centrally paused, drafts
  • Central and local: a source badge for each product and its status: central, locally edited, centrally suspended (locked), draft awaiting admin, rejected with the reason
  • Availability: the product's on/off switch in your grocery
  • Original price and customer price: the central original, your local price if you edited it, and the customer price, in one line (MER-010)
  • New product for review: an "Add product" button, and drafts in the "Drafts" filter (MER-010)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Catalog subscriptionTurning it on shows a confirmation "All catalog products … (…) and any product added to it later will be added". Turning it off shows "Its products will disappear from your store, and their sales record is not deleted" (CAT-001)
Activate productThe on/off toggle in your grocery. The toggle for a centrally suspended item is locked, and touching it shows "Admin suspended it for all groceries; it cannot be enabled locally" (CAT-001)
Edit priceOpens M06 in Mart style: your local price versus the original and the customer price (MER-010)
Add productA form (name, barcode, image, section, price) then "Send for approval": saved as a draft and sent to admin (MER-010)
Barcode searchOpens the camera and goes to the matching product, or shows "Not found in your catalogs" with "Add it for review"

Special states for this page

  • Centrally suspended: locked and hidden from customers (CAT-001)
  • Edited locally after a central update: a line "Admin updated the original to …; your price remains …" (MER-010)
  • No subscriptions yet: "Choose a catalog to start your grocery with ready products"

Validation and error messages

  • New product without a name, image or price: a message under the missing field
  • Barcode already exists: "This barcode belongs to an existing product: …"

Permissions

  • Subscribing, activating, and adding a product: the "Products" permission
  • Local price: the "Prices" permission
  • Mart account limits (MER-030)

UX decisions

  • The source badge is color-coded so the merchant is not surprised by a central suspension.
  • The barcode is next to search because groceries work by scanning.

M08 Mart preparationA list by barcode, section, and completion, then review and packing.

Page elements

  • Products and quantities: grouped by sections with the quantity of each product
  • Barcode: for each product, scanned to tick it off
  • Chilled: a badge on chilled products and their count in the header
  • Preparation progress: "Prepared … of …" and a bar, and the number remaining
  • Out of stock and substitute: the customer's choice on out-of-stock for this order, and the unavailable product's status "Removed per customer choice · −…" or "Awaiting customer reply …" or "Substitute awaiting approval" (MER-032)
  • Bags: their number in the final review
  • Final total: a final review with the order total, items removed for being out of stock, substitutes and their differences, and the final total
  • Optional invoice: photograph or upload (MER-036)
  • Driver: his ID number and expected arrival time (MER-019)
  • Line "No order rejection and no redirect to another grocery" (MER-031)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
ClearOpens the camera: the matching product is marked "Prepared" and progress increases with a confirmation sound; the scan is repeated by the quantity
PrepareManual flagging of a product with no barcode
UnavailableOpens the same out-of-stock window in M02 per the customer's choice (MER-032)
ReadyAfter processing all products: it opens the final review and the bag count, then "Ready · … SAR" moves the order to "Ready" and notifies the driver (MER-031, MER-036)
InvoiceCapture or upload, saved in the archive with the order number

Special states for this page

  • Remaining products: "Ready" is disabled with the text "… products left: prepare them or tap Unavailable"
  • Product awaiting customer reply: a timer beside it, and when it ends it is removed and the total updates (MER-032)
  • All products unavailable: the screen shows the cancellation and closes (MER-032)
  • Driver arrived during preparation: a green bar "Driver arrived … · waiting since …" (MER-020)

Validation and error messages

  • Barcode of another product: vibration and the message "This barcode is for "…", not "…""
  • Scanning more than the quantity: "This product's quantity is complete (…)"
  • Number of bags: an integer of 1 or more "Enter the number of bags"

Permissions

  • Preparing, product out of stock, and ready: the "Orders" permission, including the prep account within its limits (MER-030)

UX decisions

  • Scanning is the main button in the fixed bar, and "Ready" activates when complete.
  • Sections ordered by aisle reduce walking inside the grocery.
  • The cooler badge is blue.
  • The final total updates immediately after each deletion or substitute.

Requirements that govern it

  • MER-031 Mart order preparation
  • MER-032 Substitute for an out-of-stock product
  • MER-030 Merchant app and devices
  • MER-019 Driver details for the merchant
  • MER-020 Driver arrival at the store Important
  • MER-036 Invoice and its archive

Navigates to

M02 Order details · M03 Order handover

M09 Branch status and hoursOpen, busy, or temporarily closed, and special hours.

Page elements

  • Store visibility to customers now: visible / not visible, and the count of visible products and the active menu (MER-028)
  • Reason for not appearing: as text, with the list of monitored reasons with their status: branch status, working hours, menu and products, city (MER-028)
  • Status: open, busy, or temporarily closed
  • Busy duration up to 15 minutes: ready increments (+5 / +10 / +15 min) (MER-018)
  • Busy period up to an hour: 15 min / 30 min / 45 min / 1 hour (MER-018)
  • Preview of what the customer sees before ordering: "Preparation … min instead of … min", and the auto-expiry time
  • Temporary closure for a period: from time to time with the return time (MER-004)
  • Hours: daily and weekly hours and special days (MER-005)
  • Shifts: their periods for display (MER-005)
  • Product time (MER-005)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Change status"Open" is immediate. "Busy" opens the busy setup and then "Enable busy +… min until …" with no extra confirmation (MER-018). "Temporarily closed" asks for the return time and then confirms "You will not receive new orders until …. Current orders will be completed" (MER-004)
Downtime durationSet the start and end of the temporary closure or the busy duration, and the return time appears (MER-004)
Edit hours per permissionOpens the weekly schedule and special days, then "Save hours" with a summary of the change; shifts are view-only (MER-005)
End busy mode nowRestores the original duration for new orders immediately
Open nowEnds the temporary closure before its scheduled time after a simple confirmation
Message adminWhen not visible for an admin reason (suspended city or suspension): opens M12

Special states for this page

  • Busy: a "Busy +… min until …" badge in M01 and a countdown timer (MER-018)
  • Temporarily closed: a counter until it returns, and the reason for not appearing is "Temporary closure"
  • Outside working hours: "Closed now · Opens …" and the status is not changed to open outside the hours
  • A city or store suspended by admin: a red alert with the reason and the status buttons are disabled (MER-028)
  • All products of the active menu out of stock: "Not visible: no products available" with an M05 link

Validation and error messages

  • An increase above the cap: not offered, and any larger value is rejected "Maximum increase 15 minutes" (MER-018)
  • Busy duration above the cap: "Maximum busy duration is one hour"
  • Closure end before its start or in the past: "Choose a return time after now"
  • Overlapping hours on the same day: "The two periods overlap"

Permissions

  • Changing the status, busy state, and temporary closure: the merchant manager, the branch manager, and whoever has the "Orders" permission as granted by the manager (MER-004)
  • Edit hours: the merchant manager, and the branch manager for their branch only, within what admin allows

UX decisions

  • Visibility is in the first card because the merchant's first question is: do customers see me?
  • Busy comes with ready-made options that do not exceed the cap, so no error messages in normal use.
  • All times are written as Riyadh time.

Requirements that govern it

  • MER-004 Temporary suspension Important
  • MER-018 Busy mode Important
  • MER-005 Shifts and product availability
  • MER-028 Store disappearance alert Important

Navigates to

M01 Orders · M05 Menu and availability · M12 Support and call me

M10 Today's performanceA sales and operations summary with a custom range and links to reports.

Page elements

  • Period: the one selected in the filter, with each number compared to the previous period (vs yesterday / vs last week)
  • Branch: the one selected in the filter
  • Orders and sales: the period's numbers
  • Preparation: the period's numbers
  • Late: the number of late orders and their rate of delivered orders
  • Rating: the rating and number of ratings
  • Next payout: its amount and date, with a button next to it to share the statement as PDF (MER-021)
  • Store quality: a summary card with the number of indicators better and worse than the section average in the city and the names of the worst ones, with details in "Store quality" (MD14) in the merchant dashboard (MER-026)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
FilterBottom sheet: the period (today, last 7 days, last 30 days, custom), the branch and the comparison; "Show" updates the numbers immediately
Full reportOpens the full reports (MD06) with the same period and branch (MER-035)
Store qualityOpens "Store quality" MD14 in the merchant dashboard
Share statement PDFGenerates the period's account statement as a PDF file and opens mobile sharing (MER-021)

Special states for this page

  • No orders in the period: the numbers are zero with the text "No delivered orders in this period" without a comparison

Validation and error messages

  • Custom period: "Choose an end date after the start"

Permissions

  • The page: the "Reports" permission, and sales per it; the branch manager sees only their branch in the filter (MER-035)
  • Next payout and sharing the statement: the "Finance" permission only, and they do not appear to others (MER-037)

UX decisions

  • Four key numbers in a grid with the direction of change in green or red.
  • Late in red with its rate because the number alone is not enough to judge.
  • Store quality a prominent link with the count of what needs improvement instead of a separate hidden report.

Requirements that govern it

  • MER-035 Merchant reports Important
  • MER-026 Store quality
  • MER-021 Printing and sharing Important
  • MER-037 Staff and permissions

MD01 Overview · MD06 Reports · MD14 Store quality

M11 More and teamThe tools permitted to the user according to their role.

Page elements

  • User card: store name, employee name, their role, and their branch
  • Branch status and hours (M09): with visibility status
  • Store quality (MD14 in the merchant dashboard): the number of indicators that need improvement (MER-026)
  • Devices and printers (M15): the number of devices, and a red badge for any outage (MER-030, MER-042)
  • Support (M12): a badge for new admin replies
  • Finance: MD07
  • Marketing: MD04
  • Ratings (MD08): a badge for new ratings
  • Team: MD10
  • Printer and sound: test print
  • Notifications: this device's notification switches
  • Preferred captain: his ID number and the text "Your order is offered to him first if he is available, and the order is not delayed if he is not", display only (MER-038)
  • Sign out of this device

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Open toolOpens the selected tool with its destination in the elements; tools not permitted for the role do not appear at all
PrinterSends a test ticket to the connected printer; if it does not connect, M15 opens
Manage staff memberOpens the branch's employees (MD10): edit their branches and permissions, or suspend them with the confirmation "They will be signed out of all devices immediately, and the store keeps operating" (MER-037)
NotificationsA toggle for driver arrival, delay and admin reply notifications on this device; the new-order ring cannot be turned off from here
Sign out of this deviceConfirm "This device will not ring for new orders after you sign out", then the sign-in screen

Special states for this page

  • Limited role (such as a preparation account): only orders, devices, and support appear (MER-030)
  • No preferred captain: the line does not appear

Permissions

  • Finance: the "Finance" permission. Marketing: "Offers" and "Campaigns". Reviews: as granted by the manager. Team: "Staff". Devices: merchant manager and branch manager
  • The branch manager manages their branch's employees only (MER-037)

UX decisions

  • Tools are ordered with daily operations first (status, quality, devices, support), then administrative ones.
  • Each row carries its short status or a count badge, so the merchant does not need to open it to know.

Requirements that govern it

  • MER-037 Staff and permissions
  • MER-021 Printing and sharing Important
  • MER-030 Merchant app and devices
  • MER-038 Preferred captain
  • MER-042 Order-receiving devices
  • MER-026 Store quality

M15 Devices and printers NewManaging the branch's devices (phones, tablets, and order-receiving devices) and printers, and making sure the order rings and prints and is not lost when a device goes offline.

Page elements

  • Disconnection alert: the device or printer name, the time of the disconnection, the number of orders awaiting printing, and that orders reach the other devices (MER-042)
  • Branch devices: name, type (Android, iPhone, tablet, receiver device), the account registered on it, whether it rings, connection status and last seen (MER-030)
  • Printers: name, linked device, status, and number of orders waiting to print
  • Auto-print: an "Auto-print every new order" switch with the ticket content shown without customer data (MER-021)
  • Sound: bell volume, and that it repeats until the merchant interacts (MER-030)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Connect a device or printerPairing methods: a new device (the employee signs in with their account and it appears here), or a Bluetooth or network printer, or an order-receiving device; after pairing it appears in the list as "Connected"
Test printIt prints a test ticket; "Printed" or "Printing failed: make sure the printer is connected" appears
Test the bellThe bell rings once on this device
Auto printTurning it on prints every new order as it arrives (MER-042); turning it off asks for confirmation "Orders will not be printed automatically on this printer"
Sign out a deviceFrom the device menu: confirmation "This device will not ring or receive orders until you sign in again"
Remove printerConfirmation, then it is removed from the list; orders awaiting printing are moved to another printer if one exists

Special states for this page

  • Disconnected device: a red badge "Disconnected …", and orders appear on it when it comes back
  • Printer disconnected: orders are saved and printed automatically in order when it returns (MER-042)
  • No connected device rings at the branch: a red alert "No connected device to receive orders"
  • No devices yet: "Link your first device or printer to receive and print orders automatically"

Validation and error messages

  • No printer found while linking: "We couldn't find a printer. Make sure it is on and nearby"

Permissions

  • The merchant manager for all branches, and the branch manager for their branch
  • Other staff see only the device status and can run a test print

UX decisions

  • The disconnection alert first with an explicit reassurance that orders are not lost.
  • Each device shows who uses it and whether it rings, so the manager knows who will hear the order.
  • Test print and bell test next to the setting itself.
  • One primary button for linking at the bottom.

Requirements that govern it

  • MER-030 Merchant app and devices
  • MER-042 Order-receiving devices
M12 Support and call meAdmin tickets and the number the customer chose when an item is out of stock.

Page elements

  • Call-me number for this order: a card at the top of the page with the order number, the out-of-stock item, the number the customer chose, and the "Substitute / Remove / Cancel order" buttons (MER-032)
  • 3-minute window: a timer on the card (MER-032)
  • Two tabs: tickets, and the ongoing admin chat (MER-012)
  • Tickets list: number, subject, address, linked order, and status (open, awaiting your reply, closed)
  • Topic: accounts, menu, contract or support: in the new ticket form with the order number (optional), a problem description and attachments
  • Messages and attachments: inside the ticket and chat (MER-012)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Ticket"New ticket" opens the form; "Send" creates a ticket with a number and status "Open" that reaches admin support (A19), with a notification "Your ticket was sent"
ReplySends the message and attachments in the open ticket; they appear immediately with their time, and the status changes to "Awaiting admin"
Call when out of stockOpens a phone call to the number the customer chose for this order (MER-032)
Substitute / remove / cancelAs in the out-of-stock dialog in M02; after any button the card and the number disappear
AttachA photo or file added to the reply before sending

Special states for this page

  • No active out-of-stock: the card does not appear
  • Timeout expired: the card and the number disappear with a notification "Item automatically removed from order #…" (MER-032)
  • Closed ticket: read-only with an "Open a linked ticket" button
  • New reply from admin: a badge on the tab and on "Support" in M11

Validation and error messages

  • Ticket without a topic: "Choose the topic"
  • Ticket without a description: "Write the problem description"
  • Order number not in your branch: "No order with this number in your branch"

Permissions

  • Tickets and admin chat: the "Tickets" permission; accounts tickets also appear to anyone with "Finance"
  • "Call me" card: "Orders" permission and only for the order concerned

UX decisions

  • The "Call me" card is above everything in orange, because its time window is short.
  • The reply is in the fixed bottom bar within thumb reach, and the new ticket button is under it.
  • Each ticket's status as a colored badge, with "Awaiting your reply" first.

Requirements that govern it

  • MER-012 Communication with admin
  • MER-032 Substitute for an out-of-stock product
