M02 Order details

17Merchant dashboard

Reports, dues, branches, and permissions (web site). It has 15 pages, ordered as they are used. Under each page are an illustrative preview, its elements, its actions, and the requirements that govern it. The five states shared in "Shared page states" are not repeated here.

MD01 OverviewComparison of branches, totals, and operations.

Page elements

  • Period and custom: shortcuts (today, last 7 days, last 30 days, this week) and a custom option with a start and end date (REP-001)
  • Branch: a toggle for "All branches" or a single branch, and the choice persists when navigating between dashboard pages (MER-017)
  • Sales and orders: cards for sales, delivered orders, average basket, new customers, returning customers, cancellation rate, with the difference from the previous period; customer indicators are counts only (MER-029)
  • Best and slowest branch: a branch comparison table (sales, orders, average preparation, duration overrun rate, rating) with a Best and Slowest label
  • Peak times: for the selected branch, in place of the comparison table
  • Alerts: what needs action, sorted by severity, with a "View" button on each alert
  • Visible to customers now: a bar for each branch: visible, visible with busy mode, not visible with the reason (paused, out of stock, outside hours, city paused) and the return time if any
  • Store quality: the status of the Quality badge and the indicator that it lacks (MER-026, MKT-014)
  • Next payout: the amount, status, and period

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
FilterApplies the branch and period to all cards, the table and the chart together without reloading and without confirmation, and the selection is saved (REP-001).
Open reportOpens reports (MD06) on "Sales summary" with the same branch and period and the same numbers.
Switch branchChoosing a branch from the switcher or "Open" in the branch row shows only its data here and on every following page until you return to "All branches".
View (in the alert)Opens the relevant page filtered to the branch and item: branches for visibility, products for out of stock, store quality for exceeding the duration, ratings for the pending reply. The alert disappears when its cause is gone.
Open store qualityOpens store quality (MD14) on the selected branch and period.
Open statementOpens statement and payouts (MD07) on the real-time statement for the current period.
Manage branchesOpens branches (MD09).

Special states for this page

  • A store with a single branch: the branch switcher and the comparison table disappear
  • Branch not visible during its working hours: the visibility bar becomes a red alert at the top of the page with the reason and the return time
  • A period with no orders: cards are 0 and the chart is empty with "No delivered orders in this period" and a button to change the period

Validation and error messages

  • Start after end in custom: the filter is not applied, and below the field "Start date is after end date" (REP-001)
  • End in the future: trimmed to today, and under the field "Data is shown up to today"

Permissions

  • Merchant manager: all branches and all cards
  • Branch manager: their branch only, without a switcher or branch comparison (MER-017)
  • "Reports" permission: indicators within their branches; without it only alerts and visibility status
  • "Finance" permission: the upcoming payout card; it disappears entirely for others and does not appear locked (MER-037)

UX decisions

  • Visibility status is the first thing seen because a branch that is not visible loses orders now, then sales.
  • The branch and period switcher in a fixed place at the top of all dashboard pages.
  • Branch comparison is a table with side-by-side numbers, easy to scan, instead of separate bars.
  • The actual range in dates under the title so "Last 30 days" is not confused with the calendar month.

Requirements that govern it

  • MER-017 Branches in the merchant dashboard Important
  • MER-035 Merchant reports Important
  • MER-029 Customer indicators for the merchant Important
  • MER-026 Store quality
  • MKT-014 Quality badge
  • REP-001 Custom date range

Navigates to

MD06 Reports · MD07 Statement and payouts · MD09 Branches · MD03 Products, menu and catalog · MD08 Ratings and complaints · MD14 Store quality · MD15 Merchant registration and application tracking

MD02 Order logOrder search, its details, and its net.

Page elements

  • Order number: search by it, with status, method, source, and payment status filters, and the branch and period from the top of the dashboard
  • Status: with the order lifecycle names: at the merchant, ready, ready for pickup, picked up by the driver, delivered, received, and the closing states without delivery in their own wording (canceled by support, automatically canceled for an out-of-stock item, automatically canceled for non-payment...)
  • Payment status: a separate column: held, captured, hold released, partially refunded, refunded (ORD-001)
  • Method: column and filter
  • Source: app, menu link (exempt or not exempt), cashier, with the offer tag if applied
  • Time: a timeline for each transition with the time and who from the merchant's team performed it (ORD-001)
  • Amounts: the order net line by line with the name of each fee and how it is calculated: products, actual contract fee or exemption value, payment fee, platform fee tax 15% separately, net (PAY-010, PAY-011)
  • Mart and pharmacy: a "Merchant percentage" line instead of the contract fee, with no payment fee line (PAY-011)
  • Invoice if any: an icon in the table, and its absence is not colored as an error
  • Branch: a column when "All branches" is selected
  • Details panel: beside the table: the branch, method, source, items, and timeline
  • Cancellation: the written cancellation reason, the recorded cause, and the penalty if support set one

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
OpenOpens the details in the side panel (clicking the row does the same) and the row stays highlighted. The link is shareable within the merchant's team.
PrintPrint dialog with the order receipt: items, options, notes and the order number, without customer data.
ComplaintA chat form with the subject "Support" and the order number pre-filled, required text and an optional attachment. Sending creates it in Contact admin (MD12) assigned to the account manager, with a "Complaint sent" notice and its link.
InvoiceDownloads the products invoice if one exists; otherwise "Upload invoice" appears, and the file is then linked to the order and appears in the archive (ORD-001).
Open in statementOpens the statement (MD07) filtered to the order: its line, the payout it was included in, and the invoice.
SearchFilters the table as you type; a full order number opens its details.

Special states for this page

  • Open order (at the merchant, ready): payment is "On hold" and the net is "Estimated until delivery"
  • Closed without delivery: amounts 0.00 or as set by support; the penalty, if any, with its status, and an "Appeal" button that opens the statement
  • An item was deleted before capture: only the reduced captured amount with a "Edited before capture" tag, no reversing entry
  • Refunded after capture: a refund line linked to the original (PAY-010)
  • Write-in order: both payments appear, delivery then products (ORD-001)
  • No search result: "No order with this number in your branches" and a button to clear the filters

Validation and error messages

  • Search with a non-numeric character: the character is ignored
  • Complaint with no text: not sent, and under the field "Write what happened in the order"
  • Invoice in an unsupported format: "Upload an image or PDF file"

Permissions

  • "Orders" permission: log, details, and printing within their branches
  • "Finance" permission: net, fee breakdown, and the "Open in statement" button; without it only the products value
  • "Tickets" permission: the "Complaint" button
  • Branch manager: their branch's orders only, without the branch column

UX decisions

  • Details are in a side panel so the employee reviews consecutive orders without losing their place.
  • Order status and payment status as two separate colored badges, so "Delivered" is not understood as "Amount transferred".
  • The net breakdown explains the source of the number without opening the statement.

Requirements that govern it

  • MER-008 Financial statement Important
  • ORD-001 Order statuses
  • PAY-010 Contract fee per customer and branch — deducted from the merchant
  • PAY-011 Online payment fee

Navigates to

MD07 Statement and payouts · MD12 Contact admin

MD03 Products, menu, and catalogA management tool by store type.

Page elements

  • Products: for each product the shift, availability switch, availability time (MER-005), merchant price, customer price, completeness, and the customer-facing status in its own text (visible, outside shift now, paused until a time, centrally paused, price awaiting review, new product for review)
  • Shifts or catalogs: a "Shifts" tab for the restaurant and Shops with a menu, and "Catalogs" instead for Mart (MER-005, MER-010)
  • Availability: a switch for each product, and bulk selection: suspend until a time, enable, set availability hours
  • Merchant price and customer price: two columns; the pending price is shown next to the approved one with an arrow and "The customer sees the approved price until acceptance"
  • Review requests: the tab of new products sent for review
  • Pricing mode: a bar at the top of the page with the granted mode and its percentage, and that the selling price is set by admin (MER-002)
  • Menu completeness: the overall percentage and its breakdown and a percentage for each product in small bars (MER-047)
  • Improvement assistant: the draft image or description beside the current one with a "Draft" tag until the user chooses to use it (MER-047)
  • Integration and sync: a tab with the integration status, last sync and its result, the imported count, incoming prices awaiting review, and items hidden for being out of stock in the shop's system (MER-041)
  • Mart: the catalogs it is subscribed to, a "Local price" tag for a locally modified product, centrally paused products cannot be enabled locally, and the customer price preview (MER-010)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
AddProduct form: name, image, description, price, options, shift, availability time. Saving creates it with the status "New product for review" in "Review requests" (MER-002, MER-010).
EditEdit product dialog with a merchant price and customer price preview before saving; the price is applied or sent for review depending on the mode (MER-002).
Catalog subscriptionFor Mart only (disabled for others with a hint). A list of catalogs; choosing shows a confirmation: "All its current and future products will enter your store at their original prices, and you can edit the price, availability, and image of each product". After it the products appear in the table.
Improve with the assistantGenerates a draft image or description for the selected product or for the missing one; nothing is published until "Use draft" (MER-047).
Availability switchPauses or activates the product at the selected branch immediately. Pausing asks "Until when?" (until I activate it, or until a specific time) (MER-004). The centrally paused switch is disabled, with the reason shown.
Bulk actionsIt applies suspension, activation, or availability hours to the selection in one batch, with a message of how many changed and how many did not and why.
Sync nowIn the integration tab: requests the latest prices and stock from the shop's system (MER-041).

Special states for this page

  • "Forbidden" mode: the price field is locked with "Price editing is not available for your store; contact admin"
  • Price awaiting review: no second price change for the product until decided, with "Awaiting review since…"
  • Price or product rejected: a "Rejected" badge with the reason, and the approved one remains
  • Integration failure or sync delay: a yellow alert with the last successful sync and a "Sync now" button, and products at their last known state
  • Menu with no active shift now: the alert "Customers see no products now because the menu is outside its period"

Validation and error messages

  • Empty or zero price: "Enter a price greater than zero"
  • Price outside the limit: non-blocking; under the field "Outside the ±percentage limit (minimum – maximum) · will be sent for review" and the save button becomes "Send price for review"
  • Availability time whose end is before its start or outside the shift: "Availability time must fall within the shift period"
  • Empty name: "Enter the product name"

Permissions

  • "Products" permission: add and edit name, image, description, and availability
  • "Prices" permission: edit the price within the merchant's mode limits (MER-002)
  • Branch manager: availability and its hours in their branch
  • Shifts and their periods are shown here; they are operated from the merchant page in admin (MER-005)

UX decisions

  • Customer status in the last column answers: does the customer see the product now? And why not?
  • One assistant button turns a completeness gap into an action.

Requirements that govern it

  • MER-002 Menu, prices and permissions
  • MER-010 Mart catalogs
  • MER-005 Shifts and product availability
  • MER-047 Menu completeness and photo assistant Important
  • MER-041 Product linking via API Important
  • MER-004 Temporary suspension Important
MD04 OffersDirect subscription, a special offer for review, and a recurring Hour Deal.

Page elements

  • Tabs: available, my subscriptions, special offer, Hour Deal, results (MER-034)
  • Available: a card per offer: its type (admin offer or your own offer), discount, minimum, duration, eligible branches, funding per party, and whether it stacks with others (MKT-007)
  • My subscriptions: your subscriptions and scheduled Hour Deals with their status
  • Funding: two explicit percentages "The platform funds …% · you fund …%" before the subscribe button, and a note on the discount's effect on fees (MKT-007)
  • Special deal: form for scope, branches, products, duration, stock, minimum, budget, stacking rule; and its status (awaiting approval, approved, rejected with the reason)
  • Hour schedule 30%: the Hour Deal form: product, discount percentage, deal stock, once or recurring days, start and end hour, and a preview of what the customer sees and the price after discount (MKT-017)
  • Running Hour Deal: the product, price before and after, remaining stock, and a timer until the end of the period (MKT-017)
  • Results: one table per subscription: orders, discount value, your share, platform share, end date; matches the offers item in the statement (MER-034)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
SubscribeOn an admin deal: a confirmation with your share, branches, and duration: "The deal starts immediately after subscribing and you bear …% of each discount". After it, it becomes "Active" in my subscriptions (MKT-007).
CreateOpens the private offer form or Hour Deal form per the tab. A private offer is submitted with the status "Awaiting approval"; an Hour Deal is published automatically at its time (MKT-007, MKT-017).
End subscriptionA red button with confirmation: "The offer stops for new orders in all participating branches". Afterwards the status is "Ended" and its results remain in the results.
ContinueOpens your sent private offer: its status, the rejection reason, and an "Edit and resend" button for a rejected one.
Stop Hour DealConfirmation: "The usual price returns immediately, and the next repetition stops". After it, the status is "Suspended".
Publish Hour DealSaves the offer and schedules it; it appears in My subscriptions as "Scheduled" then "Running now" at its time. Disabled as long as the form has an error.

Special states for this page

  • Hour Deal stock ran out: "Offer stock ended" (MKT-017)
  • Special offer budget exhausted: it stops with a "Budget exhausted" badge
  • Rejected special deal: a red badge with the admin's reason
  • No offers available: "No offers are available for your branches now, create a special offer" and a "Create" button
  • A deal that does not stack with others: a sentence saying so on the card (MKT-007)

Validation and error messages

  • Hour Deal discount below 30%: "Discount below 30% · Hour Deal is not published" and publishing is disabled
  • End before start: "End time must be after start"
  • Stock zero or empty: "Enter stock for the offer"
  • Recurring days with no day: "Choose at least one day"
  • Special deal with no products or branches: "Choose the branches and products the deal covers"

Permissions

  • "Offers" permission: subscribe, create, and end within their branches; whoever lacks it does not see the page
  • Branch manager: their branch's offers and results only

UX decisions

  • The running Hour Deal is at the top of the page because it is the only thing changing now.
  • The discount error directly under its field.

Requirements that govern it

  • MKT-007 Offers and funding
  • MKT-017 Recurring Hour Deal
  • MER-034 Marketing in the merchant dashboard Important

MD07 Statement and payouts · MD05 Campaigns

MD05 CampaignsChoosing a banner or pin and the city price.

Page elements

  • Tabs: placement ads, your customers' campaigns, results (MER-034)
  • Placement: a card for each placement available in the store's city: its location, price per day, remaining capacity
  • Campaign form: placement, city, duration (from and to), the image at the placement size; no keywords (MKT-003)
  • Price: a cost summary beside the form: price × days, 15% platform fee tax, the total, and under it "No deduction before approval" in a reassuring color (MKT-003)
  • Suspension policy: its link for this slot is visible before sending (MKT-003)
  • Approval status: awaiting approval, active, rejected with the reason, paused, ended (MKT-008)
  • Results: one table with status: spend, impressions, clicks, orders, new customers, return on spend; and the spend matches the statement (MER-034, MKT-015)
  • Your customer campaigns: segments, city, scope, template, attached offer, send time, and the expected audience count in large type with the privacy explanation beside it (MKT-005)
  • Customer campaign results: audience, who opened, who ordered, sales; aggregated (MKT-005)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Cost previewCalculates the cost summary instantly next to the form. It does not place a hold or deduct.
SendConfirmation with the amount: "SAR … will be deducted from your dues only after admin approval". After it, the campaign is "Pending approval" with the notification "Campaign sent for approval" (MKT-008).
ContinueCampaign details: its status and the date of each change, the rejection reason, and its daily results.
Stop campaignA confirmation shows the placement suspension policy and what is and is not refunded (MKT-003). After it, it is "Suspended" and disappears from the app.
Duplicate campaignCopies an ended campaign's settings into a new form with empty dates.
Send a campaign to your customersSubmits the campaign for review (MKT-005). Disabled as long as the form has an error.

Special states for this page

  • Rejected campaign: a red badge with the admin's reason (MKT-008)
  • Suspended by the platform: a "Suspended by the platform" badge and the reply line in the statement (MKT-003)
  • Slot full: the card is disabled with "Capacity is full for this period"
  • Ended with no orders: results are zeros and the return is "—", not zero
  • Customer campaign with zero audience: sending is disabled with "There are no previous customers served in this scope"

Validation and error messages

  • Image of a non-matching size: under the upload area "The image size does not match this slot"
  • End before start or start in the past: "Choose a period starting tomorrow or later"
  • Customer campaign budget above the admin limit: "Higher than the admin limit for your store" and sending is disabled
  • No tier: "Choose at least one tier"

Permissions

  • "Campaigns" permission: create, send, and stop
  • "Finance" or "Campaigns" permission: see spend and return
  • Branch manager: their branch's campaigns only

UX decisions

  • Errors appear under the field itself.

Requirements that govern it

  • MKT-003 Ad placements
  • MKT-008 Merchant campaigns
  • MER-034 Marketing in the merchant dashboard Important

ActionWhat happens
ViewShows the report with the specified period, branch and comparison, and saves the last selection (REP-001).
ExcelDownloads an Excel file with the same figures as the screen (REP-001), and the file name carries the report name and the range.
PDFDownloads a PDF matching the screen, with the chart and the table.
ScheduleDialog: reports, the weekly send day, recipients (only those with the reports permission). After saving, a "Sent weekly" line appears and the reports arrive by email for the week that just ended.

Special states for this page

  • Exporting a long period: prepared in the background with "We are preparing the file, you will get a notification when it is ready"
  • No data for the period: an empty state and a "Try a longer period" button

Validation and error messages

  • Schedule with no recipient: "Choose at least one recipient"

Permissions

  • "Finance" permission: the "Finance" group; does not appear in the list for others
  • Branch manager: their branch's reports only (MER-035)
  • "Employees" permission: employee performance and action log

MD07 Statement and payoutsA breakdown of dues, exemption, and manual deductions.

Page elements

  • Tabs: live statement, payouts, monthly fee invoice, archive (MER-045)
  • Net: the period summary in the first line: sales, platform fees and their tax, offers, refunds and manual items, net so far, the next payout status
  • Sales: a waterfall under the summary explaining how sales drop to net, one item per type, and the tax as a separate item (MER-008, PAY-022)
  • The contract fee and payment fee in each order's details: the source, products, the actual contract fee with the reason for its value written ("Exempt" with the exemption value, or "Cap reached"), the payment fee, offers, VAT, net (PAY-010, PAY-011, MER-007)
  • Mart and pharmacy: a "Merchant percentage" column instead of the contract fee, with no payment fee column (PAY-011)
  • Offers (merchant share) and refunds: two items in the waterfall
  • Manual charges and their reason: charges on the merchant, each with type, amount, order or source, reason, status as a colored badge, appeal deadline, and an "Appeal" button beside it (MER-008)
  • Payouts: reference, period, amount, status, bank reference, date (PAY-006)
  • Monthly fee invoice: the total of each fee type, tax separate, the total, and an indicator of whether the month's lines match the invoice (PAY-022)
  • Archive: the order outcome as a single card with the product invoice, the statement line, and the linked payout (MER-045)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Order searchFilters the order details to the order and opens its card with the statement line, payout and invoice.
StatementDownloads the statement for the period and branch (Excel or PDF) with the same figures as the screen (MER-008).
AppealA dialog with the amount, the original reason and the deadline, a required "Reason for your appeal" field, and an optional attachment. After sending, the status is "Under appeal" and it appears in Ratings and complaints (Appeals); then "Accepted" with a reversal entry or "Rejected" with the reason (MER-008).
Download monthly invoiceDownloads the platform fees invoice for the month as a PDF.
Open payoutPayout details: the orders and charges included in it, the status, the bank reference, the date, and who approved it and when.
Archive searchSearches by order number or a date range and document type, and groups results by order or month.

Special states for this page

  • Failed payout: a red "Failed · Not paid" badge with the reason if it came from the bank (PAY-006)
  • Payout pending approval: the amount is an estimate that changes until approval
  • Appeal period ended: the button is disabled with "Appeal period ended on …" (SUP-006)
  • "Probable" charge: in a different color, and not counted in the net until it becomes "Charged"
  • Month not ended: "This month's invoice is issued after it ends"

Validation and error messages

  • Appeal with no reason: "Write the reason for your appeal"
  • A second appeal on a charge already under appeal: the button is unavailable with "Your appeal is under review"
  • Order number not in the user's branches: "No order with this number in your branches"
  • Start after end: "Start date is after end date"

MD02 Order history · MD08 Ratings and complaints · MD12 Contact admin

MD08 Ratings and complaintsReply, settlement, and appeal.

Page elements

  • Ratings: a summary at the top of the page: average rating, count, unanswered, open complaints, and the weekly rating trend for the last 8 weeks as a small line next to the numbers (MER-027)
  • List: unified for ratings, complaints, appeals and hide requests, with a status tag on each item, and what needs action first with a colored tag
  • Rating: the text, order, branch, and time, without the customer's name
  • Reply: its status (unanswered, awaiting admin review, published, rejected with the reason) and its three steps (write, admin review, shown to customers)
  • Complaints: the customer's report and evidence, the support decision, the deduction and its status (potential, charged, under appeal, accepted, rejected), and the payout it was included in
  • Reasons: the hide request with its reason (unrelated to the order, abusive), its status, and the admin decision reason (MER-027)
  • Appeals: the deadline with an explicit date before sending, and the decision status (SUP-006)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Reply for reviewSends the reply to admin; the status becomes "Your reply is awaiting review" and the reply field is locked (MER-027).
AppealOn a complaint deduction: a window with the last deadline and the amount, a required reason, and an optional attachment. After it, the deduction is "Under appeal" here and in the statement; acceptance shows a reversing entry, and rejection shows its reason.
Violating-content hide requestA dialog with reason selection and an optional explanation. The rating stays visible with the status "Hide requested · awaiting admin decision", then the decision and its reason (MER-027).
Open elementShows the item on the other side without leaving the page.
FilteringType filters (rating, complaint, appeal), stars, and status (no reply first) filter the list.

Special states for this page

  • Published reply: appears as customers see it, with no reply field
  • Rejected reply: a "Reply rejected" badge with the reason
  • Potential deduction: no appeal button until it becomes "charged"
  • Appeal period ended: the button is disabled with the end date
  • No ratings without a reply: "You've replied to all ratings"

Validation and error messages

  • Empty reply: "Write your reply before sending"
  • Appeal with no reason: "Write the reason for your appeal"
  • An appeal after the window: the system rejects it with the message "The appeal period ended on …" (SUP-006)
  • Hide request without a reason: "Choose a hiding reason"

Permissions

  • "Tickets" permission: reply, request hiding, and view complaints
  • "Finance" permission: appeal deductions and see their amounts
  • Branch manager: their branch's ratings and complaints only

Requirements that govern it

  • MER-027 Ratings and replies Important
  • SUP-006 Merchant appeal

ActionWhat happens

Products / branches (in the improvement card)Opens products (MD03) or branches (MD09) on the branch with the problem.

Page elements

  • Location and branch data: city, preparation time, minimum order, for display (MER-001)

ActionWhat happens
New branch requestForm: name, location on the map, city, hours, preparation time, minimum. After sending, the branch shows "Awaiting admin approval" and does not appear to customers, and a notification arrives with approval or a request for completion and its reason.
Allowed editHours and special days are saved immediately and shown to customers; admin's fields are locked with a "Request an edit" next to them that creates a chat in Contact admin.
Temporary suspensionA dialog with options: for a duration, until a specific time, or until the end of the day, and an optional reason. The confirm button writes the return time: "The branch will not appear to customers until …". After it, "Temporarily closed until…" (MER-004).
Copy linkCopies the branch link with the notification "Link copied".
Download QRDownloads a QR code image for the branch link, ready to print.
AdminOpens employees and permissions (MD10) filtered to the branch.

  • Pending approval or completion required: blue badge; with a completion request, the written reason and a "Complete" button
  • Deleted branch: its old link opens an alternative with the store's other branches or the store itself (INT-009)
  • Suspended city: a "Not visible · city suspended" badge and it cannot be opened from here

Validation and error messages

  • New branch location outside the selected city: "Location is outside … city"
  • Return time in the past: "Choose a time after now"

Page elements

ActionWhat happens

SuspendA red button with confirmation: the employee cannot sign in immediately, and the store works as usual (MER-037). Afterwards "Suspended" and a "Reactivate" button.
ReactivateA simple confirmation returns it to "Active" with its previous permissions.

MD15 Merchant registration and request tracking New ImportantThe merchant starts registering their store themselves, uploads their documents, and tracks their request status and the reason for a completion request until admin approval.

Page elements

  • Progress steps: business details, branches, documents and bank account, admin review, approval and login details
  • Order status: a badge at the top: draft, under review, completion required, approved
  • Completion reason: the admin employee's text, their name, and the date (MER-013)
  • Establishment data: trade name, store name, business type (MER-009), city, the person in charge and their mobile number
  • Branches: map location and branch data (MER-001), and the status of each branch (complete, needs editing)
  • Documents: logo, commercial registration, menu and others, each with an "Optional" tag and its status (MER-044)
  • Bank account: the IBAN is partially hidden
  • Order log: submission, completion requests, approval, with dates
  • Visibility note: the store does not appear to customers before approval (MER-013)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Next (at every step)Saves the step and moves to the next; the user can go back to any completed step.
Submit for review / resubmit for reviewOne primary button at the bottom of the page; it submits the request and the status becomes "Under review" and the fields are locked. After resubmission the completion alert disappears and a line is added to the order log.
Save and complete laterSaves the draft; the merchant returns to it with their mobile number and verification code.
Edit location / substituteOpens the required field directly, and "Needs editing" changes to "Edited" after saving.
UploadUploads an optional document, which appears with its name and the status "Uploaded".

Special states for this page

  • Draft: the missing steps are gray and "Send for review" is disabled until the basic data is complete
  • Under review: fields locked with "Your order has been under review since…"
  • Completion required: a yellow alert with the reason, and the required items tagged "Needs editing" in place
  • Approved: "Your store is approved" with a step to receive login details and go to the merchant dashboard

Validation and error messages

  • Invalid mobile: "Enter a Saudi mobile number starting with 05 and 10 digits long"
  • Branch location outside the selected city: "Location is outside the selected … city"
  • Invalid IBAN: "The IBAN starts with SA and consists of 24 characters"
  • Store name empty: "Enter the store name"
  • Unsupported file format: "Upload an image or a PDF file"

Permissions

  • Only the order owner (with their registered mobile) sees and edits their order
  • Admin (sales or admin) decides on the request from the Stores and onboarding page (MER-013)

UX decisions

  • Progress steps and a status badge tell the merchant where their request stands without calling.

Requirements that govern it

  • MER-013 Merchant self-registration Important
  • MER-001 Establishment and branches
  • MER-009 Operation type and section
  • MER-044 Files and attachments

Navigates to

MD01 Overview

18Driver app

Tasks, pickup, delivery, performance and earnings. It contains 15 pages, ordered as they are used. Under each page are an illustrative preview, its elements, its actions and the requirements that govern it. The five shared states in "Shared page states" are not repeated here.

D01 Start and mapStarting work and viewing the current status and earnings.

Page elements

  • Available or unavailable: the status card at the top of the screen ("You are available now" or "Unavailable") with the availability switch and a line "Your location is sent only while working"
  • Today's earnings
  • Tasks: the number of tasks available now on the main "Orders" button
  • City
  • Level
  • Account status
  • "Verified" badge: next to the name if admin granted it (DRV-007)
  • Wallet balance: appears when negative, with the suspension limit and the reason for each deduction (PAY-026)
  • Order map: the neighborhoods with orders now in a color gradient (high/medium) (DRV-030)
  • Best earning hours: hourly bars in the driver's city with the highest highlighted
  • Suspension reason bar: appears in any state that stops tasks (see the states)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Start workChanges the status to "Available" and starts location sending (DRV-003) and entry into dispatch (DSP-001); the card changes to "You are available now" and an "Orders" button appears. If there is a blocker, a bar with the reason and next step appears instead of activation.
Stop availabilityChanges the status to "Unavailable" immediately and location sending and new offers stop. With a task in progress, a confirmation appears: "You will not receive new offers, and complete your current task", and the task is not cancelled.
OrdersOpens D02 on "Live offer" if there is an offer directed at them, otherwise on "Task list".
Pay off the balanceAppears only when the suspension limit is reached (PAY-026): it opens payment of the full negative amount; after success the suspension is lifted and a notification "You are back to receiving tasks" appears.
Open order mapTapping a colored neighborhood shows only its name and demand level (high/medium), with no customer data (DRV-030).

Special states for this page

  • Account awaiting approval: the key is disabled, and a "Your request is under review" bar with a D13 link (DRV-001)
  • Onboarding not passed: a bar "Complete onboarding to receive your first task" with a link to D13 (DRV-012)
  • Negative balance before the suspension limit: work is normal with a yellow balance alert; when the limit is reached: "Task intake stopped" (PAY-026) (the second preview)
  • Suspected fake location or impossible jumps: "Your tasks are on hold pending review" with the reason, and the toggle is disabled until support lifts the hold (DRV-027)
  • Modified phone (root/jailbreak): "You can't work from this phone" with the reason (DRV-027)
  • Suspension from the penalty ladder: the bar states the step, reason, end time and appeal link in D11 (DRV-023)
  • Expired document: a yellow reminder only (DRV-006)
  • Active task: a "Current task" card at the top of the screen opens D03 instead of the "Orders" button
  • A city or service the manager suspended: "The service is temporarily suspended in your city"
  • Network loss while working: banner "No network: your events are saved and sent when you are back online"

Validation and error messages

  • "Start work" without location permission: the message "Enable location to receive tasks" and a button that opens the phone settings

Permissions

  • Someone not approved or who has not passed onboarding does not see the "Orders" button and cannot go available (DRV-001, DRV-012)

UX decisions

  • Status is the first card and large because the driver needs it at a glance while driving
  • One primary action in the bottom bar instead of two adjacent buttons
  • When tasks stop, the reason, the amount, and the next step appear in a single red bar instead of a generic message
  • Order map: colored neighborhoods, not dots, so customers' locations are not revealed
  • Best hours under the fold because they are for planning, not for the moment

Requirements that govern it

  • DRV-001 Driver account and activation
  • DRV-003 Location while working
  • DRV-030 Demand map and best times Important
  • PAY-026 Negative balance and driver deposit
  • DRV-027 Location spoofing detection
  • DRV-007 Optional verification badge
  • DRV-023 Penalty ladder and appeal
  • DRV-012 Onboarding before the first task Important

Navigates to

D02 Available tasks · D07 Earnings and payouts · D08 My performance · D03 Current task and route · D11 My tickets and appeals · D13 Registration and orientation

D02 Available tasksA live view for nearby drivers; the first acceptance wins.

Page elements

  • Service tag: with a "Chilled" tag for an order that needs a cooler bag
  • Net return: with the line "After tax and platform percentage · + tip if any" (DRV-002)
  • Store and customer
  • Distances
  • Duration
  • Acceptance counter
  • Current capacity
  • Toggle "Live view" / "Task list": the offer directed at you with its counter, and the tasks nobody has accepted (DSP-001, DRV-018)
  • Batching alert: in the extra offer during a task, the current order number and the expected extra delay to deliver it (DSP-003)
  • Eligibility line under the list: "Only tasks suitable for your vehicle, equipment, services, and city are shown"

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
AcceptSends the acceptance to the server (DSP-001). If first: the card is withdrawn from the others, a pickup code is created, and D03 opens. If someone else got there first: "Another driver accepted this task" and the card disappears. If eligibility no longer holds at acceptance (DRV-011): "This task is no longer suitable for you". The tier benefit is fixed on the task (DRV-015).
RejectHides the offer immediately without confirmation and counts it in the acceptance indicator; the effect of rejection and ignoring on later offers follows (DSP-001).
Open routeShows a preview of the route (store then customer) on the map without accepting; the counter continues in the background.
Accept from the listAn "Accept" button on every card in the list with the same behavior, and the card disappears from everyone's lists as soon as it is accepted (DRV-018).

Special states for this page

  • No offers now: "No nearby tasks now · stay available" with a link to the order map in D01
  • Timer ended: the card fades out with "Deal time ended"
  • Task withdrawn because someone else accepted: a transient notification and the card disappears (second preview)
  • Capacity full: no new offers appear and "Finish your current tasks to receive offers" is shown (DRV-015)
  • A service or city paused by the manager: its tasks do not appear (DRV-002)

Validation and error messages

  • A deal whose counter ended or was withdrawn: "This deal is no longer available"

Permissions

  • It appears only to the approved available driver (DRV-001, DRV-002)

UX decisions

  • Net and the counter in one line in large type because the decision is made in seconds
  • A wide "Accept" button carrying the amount, and a small "Reject" beside it to reduce mistaken taps
  • The task list is in a separate tab so it does not compete with the time-limited live offer
  • Under the card "If you reject it, it will not be shown to you again" so the driver knows the effect of rejection

Requirements that govern it

  • DSP-001 Order dispatch to drivers
  • DRV-002 Orders and services
  • DRV-018 Available tasks list Important
  • DRV-011 Vehicle type Important
  • DSP-003 Order batching
  • DRV-013 Equipment log
  • DRV-015 Driver levels

Navigates to

D03 Current task and route · D01 Home and map

D03 Current task and routeStops of batched orders, in order, with the expected time.

Page elements

  • Orders up to 3: orders of the batched task (DSP-003)
  • Stop order: the next stop card (its type, the store or the district, order numbers, distance, expected time) and then the remaining stops
  • Pickup and handover: the task's five-stage progress bar (DRV-004)
  • Time: an "On time" or "Late" badge (ORD-012)
  • Instructions
  • Help button: a window with ready reasons (DRV-020)
  • "Emergency" button: fixed red on the map
  • Apology dialog: ready-made reasons (ORD-014) with a text field for "Other"

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
NavigationOpens the current stop's location in the preferred navigation app set in D10 (DRV-021); if not set, it asks once and saves the choice.
Arrived at the storeBecomes active only within the store's range (DRV-004); logs the time and location, notifies the merchant "Driver arrived" (MER-020), starts the waiting counter, and opens D04.
ApologyOpens the reasons window; confirmation shows the effect: "The order will be returned to another driver with top priority, your code will be cancelled, and the apology will be recorded in your performance without a penalty" (ORD-014). After it the task closes for them and "Order returned to dispatch" appears and they return to D01.
HelpOpens the reasons window; "Send report" opens a report linked to the order, stage and location (DRV-020) and it appears in D11 with the status "Open". The reason "Customer not responding" opens D06.
EmergencyCalls the unified number and sends the location and the order to the operations room (DRV-024); no confirmation before the call so it is not delayed.
Open stationShows the stop's instructions and its orders; the order is set by the system and the driver does not change it (DSP-003).

Special states for this page

  • Outside the store's range: the "I arrived at the store" button is disabled with "Get closer to the store (… m away)"
  • Delay beyond the reference time (ORD-012): "Late" badge and an alert "No money is deducted from you, and it appears in the performance report"
  • A bundled order was added: a notification "Order [number] added · new stop order" and the arrival is re-estimated
  • Network loss: a "No network" banner at the top of the screen; events are saved and sent in order (DRV-004)
  • Pharmacy order "Returns to pharmacy": the next stop becomes the pharmacy and D15 opens (PHR-010)

Validation and error messages

  • An "Other" reason in the apology requires text: "Write the reason for the apology"
  • Help report: the button is disabled until a reason is chosen

UX decisions

  • The next stop in a large font, and the remaining stops smaller under it
  • "Emergency" is separate from "Help" so they are not confused
  • The main action changes with the stage (arrived at store → on the way → arrived) in the same place at the bottom of the screen
  • Decline is a neutral secondary button

Requirements that govern it

  • DSP-003 Order batching
  • ORD-014 Driver apology (decline)
  • DRV-004 Driver task stages
  • DRV-020 Help button Important
  • DRV-021 Switch to navigation Important
  • DRV-024 Emergency button Important
  • ORD-012 Driver delay detection
  • MER-020 Driver arrival at the store Important
  • DRV-003 Location while working

Navigates to

D04 Pick up order from store · D05 Arrival and delivery · D06 No response and help · D11 My tickets and appeals · D15 Return medicine to pharmacy

D04 Picking up the order from the storeThe driver's code to the merchant and pickup evidence, with no menu-invoice requirement.

Page elements

  • Pickup code: with its status "Awaiting merchant code entry" then a green "Verified" badge
  • Order number
  • 100 m range: a "Within 100 m of the store" badge
  • Pickup photo
  • Invoice if present: a badge by order type, "Not required" or "Attached by the pharmacy/store" (MER-036)
  • Contents
  • "Your wait" counter at the store: with a sentence that it is not counted against the driver (DRV-019, ORD-012)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Show the codeEnlarges the code to full screen and raises the brightness to make it easy for the merchant to read (ORD-005).
PhotoOpens the camera directly, not the photo gallery; the photo is saved with its time and location as pickup evidence.
ReceivedBecomes active after the code and the pickup photo are verified. On tap: the waiting counter stops (DRV-019), the task moves to "On the way", and D03 opens at the next delivery stop or D05.
Report: order does not matchA small link that opens the help window (D03) on the reason "Order doesn't match" tied to the pickup stage.

Special states for this page

  • Outside the range: the code is hidden and "Get closer to the store to show the code" appears
  • The merchant entered a wrong code: nothing changes for the driver; the message is shown to the merchant
  • Order not ready yet: "The store is preparing your order" with a wait counter, and a "Store is late" report can be opened
  • Orders grouped from the same store: a code per order, and a tab per order number
  • Code canceled after an apology: "This code is no longer valid" (ORD-014)

Validation and error messages

  • "Received" without a photo: "Photograph the order first"

UX decisions

  • The code in the largest font on the screen because it is what the merchant needs
  • The main button is disabled with the condition to enable it written under it instead of an error message after pressing
  • The wait counter is visible so the driver feels their time is recorded

Requirements that govern it

  • ORD-005 Driver pickup and customer handover
  • MER-036 Invoice and its archive
  • DRV-004 Driver task stages
  • DRV-019 Driver waiting at the store Important
  • MER-020 Driver arrival at the store Important
  • ORD-012 Driver delay detection

Navigates to

D05 Arrival and delivery · D03 Current task and route

D05 Arrival and deliveryDelivery within 100 m with no customer code entry.

Page elements

  • Arrived: the stages bar and the current stage "Arrived at the customer"
  • Location
  • Entry instructions: with the entrance photo and the corrected pin if present (DRV-028)
  • Call and chat
  • Leave at the door with permission: a "Leaving at the door allowed" badge when permission exists (ORD-010, DRV-004)
  • Photo
  • Task status
  • Alert "Do not ask the customer for any code"
  • Banner "No network: the handover will be saved and sent when back online"
  • A "Customer not answering?" link to D06

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
ArrivedBecomes active only within the customer's range (DRV-004); logs the time and location, the order status changes to "Driver arrived" and the customer receives a notification of it, route measurement stops (ORD-012), and the no-response counter starts (D06).
CallA call from inside the app; it is logged with its time as evidence of non-response (ORD-008).
ChatOpens D14.
PhotoOpens the camera; the photo is the delivery evidence with its time and location, and the entrance photo for the address is saved (DRV-028).
DeliveredBecomes active within range after the evidence (ORD-005); the order is closed "Delivered", the amount is captured and the pay is added to the driver's wallet, and it returns to D01 or the next stop in bundled tasks. With no network it is saved and sent on return (DRV-004).
Leave it at the doorAppears only with permission (ORD-010); it opens a window asking for a photo of the order in place, then "Delivered at the door" saves the photo on the order and sends it to the customer.

Special states for this page

  • Before arrival: "Arrived" is disabled with the distance
  • Leaving not allowed: the option does not appear at all
  • The customer asked to leave it in the chat: the option appears automatically with a "Requested in chat" marker and its time
  • No previous entrance photo: the card shows only the address instructions
  • Handover saved offline: a "Pending upload" badge on the order until it syncs
  • Pharmacy order: no leaving at the door except with support permission

Validation and error messages

  • Leaving without a photo: "You can't leave it without a photo"
  • "Delivered" out of range: "Get closer to the customer's location to confirm delivery"

UX decisions

  • One large line "Hand the order to the customer in person" reminds of the original
  • The entrance photo is next to the instructions because it is quicker than reading an address description
  • Call and chat are two equal large buttons within thumb reach

Requirements that govern it

  • ORD-005 Driver pickup and customer handover
  • ORD-010 Leave at the door
  • DRV-004 Driver task stages
  • DRV-028 Entrance photo memory
  • DRV-021 Switch to navigation Important
  • DRV-029 Chat translation and quick replies
  • DRV-003 Location while working

D06 No response and help · D01 Home and map · D14 Customer chat

D14 Customer chat NewAn auto-translated chat between the driver and the customer, with quick replies logged as evidence.

Page elements

  • Messages: translated into the recipient's language (DRV-029)
  • "Translated from…" line: under the message with "Show original"
  • Ready replies: I arrived at the door, I'm on my way, I'm at the store, I can't find the address
  • Leave-at-door request notification: when the customer requests it
  • Call button
  • Writing field and send button

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
SendSends the message translated into the customer's language (DRV-029), and it is saved with its original, translation and time as evidence.
Ready replySends the text immediately with one tap, translated into the customer's language.
View originalToggles the message between the translation and the original text.
CallA call from the app to the customer, and it is logged.

Special states for this page

  • No messages yet: quick replies only
  • Translation failure: the message is sent in its original with "Translation failed"
  • Order ended: the conversation is read-only
  • No network: the message "Awaiting sending"

Validation and error messages

  • An empty message is not sent

UX decisions

  • Ready replies above the typing field to send with a tap while driving
  • The request to leave at the door is a prominent notification, not an ordinary message
  • State each message's language so the driver trusts the translation

Requirements that govern it

  • DRV-029 Chat translation and quick replies
  • ORD-010 Leave at the door
  • ORD-008 Customer unresponsiveness

D05 Arrival and delivery

D06 No answer and help5-minute and 30-minute steps, then a support decision, with no operations code.

Page elements

  • Call and message
  • Time since arrival
  • Documented conditions: a timeline with step times: arrived, called, sent a message, customer alert, support alert (ORD-008)
  • Customer alert
  • Support conversation
  • Returning the medicine if needed (PHR-010)
  • The sentence "Do not leave or end the order yourself; support decides"
  • Pay note on termination for non-responsiveness (DRV-005)
  • Support decision card: with its outcome (ORD-008)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Customer alertBecomes active after the window if a call and a message are documented (ORD-008); sends the customer a prominent alert and a notification, and is logged in the timeline.
Open issue reportOpens a "Customer not responding" report in the operations room linked to the order with the recorded evidence (location, time stayed, calls, messages), and it appears in D11.
Read support decisionOpens the decision window: the result, the amounts due to the driver, the executor's name and the time, and the next step: leave, or D05 to retry or leave with evidence, or D15 to return the medicine.

Special states for this page

  • Before the alert timeout: the button is disabled with an "Available after …" counter
  • On support timeout: "An alert reached support" automatically, and the order is not closed automatically (ORD-008)
  • Decision to end for non-response (second preview): wage and tip (DRV-005) and leaving is allowed
  • The driver left the range before the decision: an alert "Stay near the customer until support decides" and the exit is logged

UX decisions

  • The large counter and the timeline answer the driver's question "How much is left and when does support step in?"
  • Every step is documented with a checkmark so the driver is reassured that their wage is saved
  • The decision in a clear dialog with the amounts instead of a text message in the chat

Requirements that govern it

  • ORD-008 Customer unresponsiveness
  • PHR-010 Customer non-response on a medicine order
  • DRV-005 Earnings Important
  • DRV-004 Driver task stages

D15 Returning medicine to the pharmacy NewReturning a medicine order that was not delivered to the pharmacy, using a return code entered by the pharmacy.

Page elements

  • "Returning to the pharmacy" state
  • Return code (ORD-005, PHR-010)
  • Reorder window (PHR-010)
  • Steps: support decision, on the way, the pharmacy enters the code

ActionWhat happens
NavigationOpens the pharmacy location in the preferred navigation app (DRV-021).
Arrived at the pharmacyBecomes active within range; logs the arrival, notifies the pharmacy and shows the return code.
Pharmacy closed? Notify operationsOpens a report linked to the order in the operations room; the order stays "Returning to the pharmacy" until operations decide (PHR-010).

Special states for this page

  • Outside the range: the code is hidden
  • Timeout expired: "An alert reached operations to decide" and the order is not closed (PHR-010)
  • Entering the code: "Returned", and the order is closed and the driver returns to D01

UX decisions

  • The screen resembles the pickup screen (D04) so the driver knows what to do without learning anything new

D07 Earnings and payoutsNet, incentives, manual deductions, and their reasons.

Page elements

  • Delivery and tip after tax: two separate lines, delivery after tax and the platform percentage, and the tip after its deduction (PAY-014)
  • Platform percentage
  • Incentives
  • Manual penalties: each amount with its reason and order number beside it (PAY-025)
  • Net
  • Payout date
  • Payments log: each transfer with its status and bank reference (PAY-006), including "Awaiting approval"
  • Wallet balance: does not include the deposit, with the held deposit line shown separately (PAY-024)
  • Task list: with the badges "Later tip" and "Ended for non-response · full pay"
  • Negative balance deducted from the next payout: a visible line (PAY-026)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Open taskOpens the task statement (the second preview): delivery fee, tax, platform percentage, wage, tip and the time it was added if it came later, waiting time at the store, and any delivery offer (PAY-014).
StatementOpens the real-time statement for the selected period with all transactions (wages, tips, incentives, penalties, reversing entries, payouts) with a PDF export button.
AppealOpens D11_2 filled in with the selected deduction; after the appeal grace period (DRV-023) "Appeal period ended" appears.
Switch periodToday/week/month changes only the figures and the list, not the balance.

Special states for this page

  • Later tip: a notification "The customer added a tip of [amount] to order [number]" and it appears in the same task's statement (DRV-005)
  • Negative balance: the number is red with "Deducted from your next payout", and at the suspension limit a "Task intake stopped" bar and a payment link (PAY-026)
  • Failed payout: "Failed · Not paid" with a link to update bank details in D10 (PAY-006)
  • A deduction not yet approved: does not appear in the balance (PAY-026)
  • Reversal entry after an appeal is accepted: a green line "Refunded: your appeal on [number] was accepted"
  • Task whose driver was replaced: per (PAY-014), and any compensation to the first driver is a manual line with its reason

UX decisions

  • One large number (the balance) on top, and its breakdown under it as a sum that equals the number
  • Visually separating the deposit from the balance so the driver does not think it is withdrawable money
  • Transfer status as a clear word and color, and a failed one in red that is not confused with paid

Requirements that govern it

  • PAY-014 Driver dues
  • PAY-025 Manual penalties
  • PAY-006 Settlements and payouts
  • DRV-005 Earnings Important
  • PAY-026 Negative balance and driver deposit
  • PAY-024 Driver deposit

  • Notes: delays (ORD-012) and apologies (ORD-014)

Change periodSwitches the numbers between periods (DRV-017), and custom opens a two-date picker; the displayed score changes, while the tier and its badge do not and "Your tier is from the last 30 days" is written beneath it.

AppealFrom a specific note, opens D11_2 linked to the order and the note.

ActionWhat happens
EditOpens the item for editing. Changing the vehicle, equipment or bank is sent for review and the old one stays in effect until approval; changing navigation and language is immediate.
Upload fileOpens the camera or files; the optional file is sent for verification review, and its status appears (under review, accepted, rejected with the reason).
Close-via-support requestOpens a window (the second preview) showing the settlement: the balance, the deposit, and the net amount refunded. Confirming opens a closure ticket in D11 and stops receiving tasks immediately (PAY-026).
HRDF (Hadaf) deliveriesOpens D12 (DRV-022).

Special states for this page

  • Edit under review: an "Under review" badge on the item
  • Verification rejected: the reason and a "Upload another file" button
  • Closure request open: a "Closure request under settlement" bar and the close button is disabled
  • Resident driver: the "HRDF deliveries" link does not appear

Validation and error messages

  • IBAN: 24 characters starting with SA; message "Check the IBAN number"
  • File: image or PDF only; message "File type is not supported"

Permissions

  • The driver edits his data; changing the type (Saudi freelancer/resident) is through support only

UX decisions

  • Status (active, verified) in the page header as badges
  • The close button is red at the bottom

Requirements that govern it

  • DRV-001 Driver account and activation
  • DRV-013 Equipment log
  • PAY-024 Driver deposit
  • DRV-007 Optional verification badge
  • DRV-011 Vehicle type Important
  • PAY-026 Negative balance and driver deposit
  • DRV-021 Switch to navigation Important
  • DRV-029 Chat translation and quick replies
  • DRV-006 Incentives

D11 My tickets and appealsA ticket linked to a task or a manual deduction.

Page elements

  • Task
  • Reason
  • Evidence
  • Amount if any
  • Messages
  • Appeal decision: accepted (reversal entry) or rejected with the reason (PAY-025)
  • Tabs: All, My appeals, Actions (penalty ladder)
  • Penalty-ladder step notification: the reason, the next step and the last date to appeal (DRV-023)
  • Appeal response counter (DRV-023)
  • Help reports: linked to the order and the stage (DRV-020)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
TicketOpens the new ticket form: the subject (help with a task, financial inquiry, appeal of a deduction, appeal of an action, closure request), the task, the description, the attachments; after sending it appears in the list with the status "Open".
ReplySends a message in the ticket; it is saved offline and sent on reconnection.
AttachAttaches a photo or document to the ticket or the appeal.
AppealOpens D11_2 for the deduction or action specified within the appeal grace period (DRV-023); its acceptance on a deduction appears as a reversing entry in D07.

Special states for this page

  • Immediate suspension: a red card with the reason and an appeal link (DRV-023)
  • Appeal period ended: the button is disabled with "Appeal period ended"
  • Response timeout exceeded with no response: "Late response" badge
  • No tickets: "No messages · if you face a problem in a task, use the help button"

Validation and error messages

  • Appeal reason at least 10 characters: "Write the reason for your appeal in at least 10 characters"
  • Subject is required

UX decisions

  • Penalty-ladder actions at the top of the screen because they directly affect the driver's work
  • Each item shows its status with a colored badge and the time remaining to respond
  • The appeal form shows the amount, the reason and the final deadline before the text field

Requirements that govern it

  • DRV-020 Help button Important
  • DRV-023 Penalty ladder and appeal
  • PAY-025 Manual penalties
  • DRV-004 Driver task stages

ActionWhat happens
ExportGenerates a PDF report (DRV-022) with the count and the list of completed orders (number and date), and saves it to the phone.
ShareOpens mobile sharing with the same report file.
Change monthToggles the count and the list; custom opens a two-date picker.

Special states for this page

D13 Registration and onboardingRegistration, then approval and operational onboarding before the first task.

Page elements

  • Communication
  • Vehicle: type car or motorcycle (DRV-011)
  • Photos
  • Bank
  • City
  • Deposit: paying it before activation (PAY-024)
  • Short onboarding: lessons then a test (DRV-012)

  • The six registration steps: contact, vehicle, bank, insurance, review, orientation
  • Driver type: Saudi freelancer or resident freelancer (DRV-001)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
SubmitAfter the steps are completed and the deposit is paid, the request is sent to admin; the status changes to "Under review" and a notification arrives with the decision.
CompleteSaves the current step and moves to the next; the user can leave and come back without losing inputs.
Pass the orientationSubmits the quiz answers; on passing (DRV-012) D01 opens with "You can now receive your first task". On failing, the wrong questions appear with their explanation and a "Retake the quiz" button.
Pay the 100 SAR depositOpens payment; after success "The deposit is held and separate from your wallet and is refunded when the account is closed after settlement" appears (PAY-024).

Special states for this page

  • Rejected or incomplete: the reason and the item that needs editing
  • Approved but failed onboarding: the second preview
  • Quiz failure: repeat the lessons tied to the wrong questions

Validation and error messages

  • The three vehicle photos are required: "Add the rear photo"
  • IBAN: 24 characters starting with SA

  • Short steps with a progress bar at the top of the screen instead of a long form
  • Type and vehicle options as large cards instead of a dropdown
  • The quiz is one question per screen with large answers

D01 Home and map

19Admin dashboard

Operations, merchant profile, accounts, support, and settings. It has 23 pages, ordered as they are used. Under each page are an illustrative preview, its elements, its actions, and the requirements that govern it. The five states shared in "Shared page states" are not repeated here.

A01 HomeGrowth, issues, and what needs intervention.

Page elements

  • Period and custom: the period filter, and "Custom" shows the two date fields and an "Apply" button
  • City and section: two filters in the title bar that apply with the period across the whole page
  • Orders and revenue: unified indicators (ADM-030): delivered orders, total sales, platform revenue, average order value, lateness rate, cancellation rate; with the difference from the previous period and a tooltip defining each number
  • Order map
  • Top stores: a table with a "Delay" column
  • Alerts: a "Needs attention now" bar at the top of the page with four cards: orders without a driver for more than 15 minutes, unclaimed operational alerts, open anomalous patterns, merchant onboarding requests
  • Last updated: Riyadh-time stamp under the title
  • Anomalies (ADM-012): spike type, level and source, current value versus usual in one sentence instead of a chart, detection time, and an "Open source" button
  • Accuracy of the announced time (ADM-011): the average difference per city, the store with the largest deviation, and a "Report for each store" link
  • Cancellation by cause: customer, no driver, item out of stock, merchant, driver, non-payment; their total equals the cancellation rate

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Open metricOpens the list the number was calculated from with the same filters (ADM-030): orders → A03, stores and join requests → A05, alerts and orders without a driver → A02, anomalous patterns → the jump source. No confirmation.
FilterApplies the period, city and section to the whole page and saves them for the session. During recalculation the old numbers stay dimmed until the new ones arrive.
Open source (anomalous pattern)Opens the list of operations that created the jump, filtered by its source and time. Changes nothing.
Mark pattern as reviewedA dialog with a mandatory note (what was found and what action was taken). On saving, the pattern disappears from the intervention bar and stays in the alert log under the employee's name and time, and returns if a new spike is detected from the same source.
Per-store report (time accuracy)Opens the stated-time accuracy report (A21) filtered by city and period (ADM-011).
Open store rowA row in "Top stores" opens the merchant page (A06).

Special states for this page

  • Nothing needs intervention: the strip cards are zero in a neutral color with the text "Nothing needs your attention now".
  • An incomplete "Today" period: a "Partial until [time]" badge next to each number, and comparison with the same period of the previous day.
  • An employee with a limited city scope: numbers and the city list for their cities only, and under the title "Your cities: [cities]".
  • A role without the financial reports permission: "Total sales" and "Platform revenue" are hidden, and the other cards expand.
  • No previous period (new city): "—" instead of the change percentage with the hint "No previous period".

Validation and error messages

  • Custom range: end before start → "The end date must be after the start date" and "Apply" stays disabled.
  • Date in the future → "Choose a date up to today".

Permissions

  • The page is for all roles within their cities: admin, support supervisor, support agent, operations, finance, sales.
  • Total sales and platform revenue: admin and finance only.
  • Intervention banner: the join-requests card for admin and sales, and the rest for admin, support supervisor, support agent, and operations.
  • "Mark pattern as reviewed": admin, finance and support supervisor.

UX decisions

  • The intervention banner is the first thing seen before the growth numbers, and its cards are colored by severity.

Requirements that govern it

  • ADM-030 Analytics for every page in the admin dashboard Important
  • ADM-011 Declared time accuracy Important
  • ADM-012 Anomaly detection Important

A02 Operations room · A03 Orders and order file · A05 Stores and onboarding · A06 Merchant page · A21 Reports

A02 Operations roomThe order, the alert, its owner, and the parties map.

Page elements

  • Services without Taxi: the service filter: restaurants, Mart, pharmacies, Shops, write-in, self-pickup
  • City: filter
  • Status: filter
  • Map: the parties of the selected order and its route
  • Nearby drivers: a table for the unassigned order: name and number, distance (DSP-001), score, 30-day deliveries, priority points and their breakdown, level, status (free, has a batchable task, rejected this order, preferred captain)
  • Stage times: for the selected order, preparation versus the announced duration and the route versus the reference (ORD-012)
  • Alerts: for each alert a timer with its age, the type, the order, the owner ("Unclaimed" or the employee's name, also shown on the order), the priority by color, the next grace period (such as "Intervene at [time]"), and the handling guide and required action
  • Room tabs (ADM-003)
  • Shift badge in the title bar: pickup time, the employee's cities and services, the count of items under their name, and a "Hand over shift" button
  • Indicators bar for the selected city and service (ADM-014)
  • "Alert and shift rules" tab (second preview): the rules list, the rule editor (ADM-005) with the handling guide, and the "On shift now" table
  • "Immediate suspension" dialog (ADM-004): type, item, written reason, and an impact summary

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Claim an alertClaims the alert for the employee immediately in a single server operation, so their name appears on the alert and the order for everyone and the "Mine" button disappears for them; it opens the order, its evidence and the handling guide. If a colleague got there at the same moment: "[Name] took it moments ago" and nothing changes. No confirmation.
AssignDialog: a driver from the eligible table or by their number, and a written reason (DSP-002). Confirmation "Assign order #[number] to [driver]" withdraws the offer card from the others, logs the performer, reason and time in the order events, and closes the "No driver" alert. If another driver accepts before saving: "The order was just accepted by [driver]" and the manual assignment is canceled.
Transfer employeeDialog: an employee currently on shift covering the order's city, and a mandatory note. Confirmation moves the alert and the order to their name, logs the transfer under both parties' names with the time, and the new employee receives a notification (ADM-042).
CallList: customer, merchant, driver. The call starts from the dashboard and is recorded in order events "Call from [employee] to [party] [time]" with the duration. The call center is later (ADM-003).
EscalateA dialog with a mandatory note; it raises the alert to the support supervisor (or whoever the rule specifies) and it appears with an "Escalated" badge at the top of the list, and its owner keeps it until the supervisor decides to move it. The escalator and the time are logged.
MineThe short name for "Alert acknowledgment" inside the alert row; the same outcome.
Take over the shiftOpens the previous handover notes for everything that will come under their name; "I have read and taken over" starts the shift, records the time and the items move to them (ADM-042).
Shift handoverA dialog with each open order and alert by name, each with a mandatory note (ADM-042). "Hand over and end my shift" is disabled until the notes are complete. Confirmation moves the items to the next shift's employee (or to automatic distribution) and logs the handover (ADM-042).
RedistributeFor the supervisor: a window to distribute cities and services among those present, and to transfer one employee's alerts to another in one batch. Every transfer is logged.
View self-pickup or refundAppears for a non-Mart order that reached the intervention grace period (ORD-004). A confirmation states the effect, then the customer receives the two options (ORD-004, EXT-006). The alert follows the customer's choice and closes with it.
Cancel and refund (Mart after 15 minutes)Opens the cancellation window in the order file (A03) with the party at fault "No driver" and the reason suggested (ORD-004).
Immediate suspensionShows the effect before confirmation such as "[Store] will not receive any new orders". The confirm button is red "Stop now". It takes effect immediately without an app update (ADM-004), and the item appears with a "Stopped immediately" badge with the reason and the executor, and resumes with a "Resume" button with a written reason.
MessageOpens a chat with the customer, merchant or driver linked to the order (ADM-010).
New rule / save and apply nowSaving takes effect immediately on new events (ADM-005) and records the editor and the values before and after. "Stop the rule" has a confirmation stating that new alerts of this type will not appear.

Special states for this page

  • Alert reserved for a colleague: the row carries their name, "Mine" is hidden, and order actions are disabled with the hint "[Name] is working on it · Ask the supervisor to transfer it".
  • Shift not started: the room is read-only with a "Start your shift" bar, and all buttons are disabled except "Take over the shift."
  • An order reached the intervention deadline (ORD-004): automatic offering stops, the row is red with an "Intervene now" badge, and intervention options appear by type.
  • No eligible driver: the nearby table is empty with the text "No eligible driver within 10 km" and an "Assign by driver number" field.
  • Driver suspended for location spoofing (DRV-027): does not appear among nearby drivers, and their alert has a "Spoofing" badge.
  • Live update delayed: a yellow badge "Last updated [number] seconds ago" next to the title until the connection returns.
  • A rule with no configured duration: "Suspended" with a "Duration not configured" badge and it does not work until configured.

Validation and error messages

  • Assigning by a non-existent number ← "No driver with this number".
  • Ineligible driver then the exact reason: "Outside the order city", "Blocked from this store", "Has no cooler bag", "Has a private zone that does not include the store", "Stopped from tasks: balance −50", "Suspended for review".
  • The reason for assignment, escalation, transfer, and suspension is empty ← "Write the reason".
  • Incomplete handover → "Write a note for each open item ([count] remaining)" and the button is disabled.
  • Transfer: a staff member outside his shift or cities does not appear in the list.
  • Rule editor: "Intervene after" is not greater than "Alert after" → "The intervention duration must be after the alert duration".

Permissions

  • View the room: admin, support supervisor, support agent, operations; finance view only; sales does not see it.
  • Assignment, reassignment, calling, escalation, and alert acknowledgment: admin, support supervisor, support agent, operations, within their cities.
  • Cancellation, refund, and offering a refund to the customer: admin, support supervisor, support agent; not shown to operations.
  • Redistribution and moving another's alerts: support supervisor and admin.
  • Alert rules: the admin edits; everyone else is read-only.
  • Immediate suspension: the city and payment method for admin; the store for admin, support supervisor, and operations; the campaign for admin and sales.

UX decisions

  • Alerts are ordered by severity, then age.
  • The selected row opens the map and the table of those near the same order without leaving the room.

Requirements that govern it

  • ADM-003 Unified operations room
  • ADM-042 Shift and handover
  • ADM-004 Instant suspension
  • ADM-005 Operational alerts
  • ADM-014 Operations room indicators
  • DSP-001 Order dispatch to drivers
  • ORD-004 Cancellation and alternative pickup
  • ORD-007 Merchant delay detection
  • ORD-012 Driver delay detection
  • ORD-008 Customer unresponsiveness
  • DRV-027 Location spoofing detection
  • EXT-006 Self-pickup
  • MER-038 Preferred captain
