A03 Orders and order fileA complete reference for the order, events, money, and evidence.

Page elements

  • Status: four independent statuses in cards at the top of the file (ORD-001): the internal order status and what the customer sees, payment (held, captured, hold released, refunded) and its amount, the driver task, the invoice; with the order progress steps by its type and the current step highlighted
  • Source: in the file header with the order number, city and the staff member working on it
  • Service: the track type in the file header (menu, Mart, write-in, pharmacy, self-pickup)
  • Events: with the executor and time, including the dispatch attempt number, its range and the assignment time; and the times against the reference: preparation (ORD-007), the road and the driver's waiting (ORD-012)
  • Amounts per party: what the customer paid and its status, the tip and its net for the driver after the 15% deduction, the merchant's due after the contract percentage and payment fee (2.5% + 1 on products after discount)
  • Invoice by type: for write-in and pharmacy, the invoice photo and its amount, with the service fee separate, and the payment timer (ORD-013)
  • Photos: evidence: pickup and delivery photo, driver route, "Arrived" location, call and message log; and the pharmacy prescription
  • Chats: with customer, merchant and driver tabs and a send field, linked to the order (ADM-010)
  • "All orders" tab: search by order number, customer, store, or driver, and filters for city, service, status, period, and cause; columns: number, store, service, status, payment, age, owner agent
  • "Awaiting support decision" tab with a count: automatic cancellation for an out-of-stock item, unpaid write-in, pharmacy without a prescription, self-pickup "Not picked up", unresponsive customer
  • Intervention banner at the top of the file: its reason (ticket, delay, no response) and what needs to be done
  • Financial decisions log (SUP-003): reason, responsible party, evidence, executor, time, values before and after, appeal, and the reversing entry if any
  • "Cancel with reason" dialog (second preview): responsible party, reason, bearer (ORD-004), penalty amount and its destination, evidence, refund to the customer, what is paid to the driver and their tip, an impact summary for each party, and the role limit

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
RefundAvailable after capture; before it, disabled with the hint "The amount is still on hold". Dialog: items or an amount, the reason, the bearing party (merchant, driver, or platform), the evidence. The confirm button "Refund [amount] SAR to the customer" and it states the effect on the bearing party. It is refunded to the same payment method, and the entry is logged (ADM-043) and appears in the bearing party's statement with the right to appeal (PAY-025). Above the role limit it goes to "Awaiting approval" in A04.
CompensationDialog: an amount to the customer's wallet, the reason, the source (the platform or a penalty on a party) (PAY-025). The confirm button "Add [amount] SAR to the customer's wallet". The customer receives a notification and the entry is logged. Subject to the role limit.
Cancel because ofAppears only after the customer grace period and to whoever has the permission, and opens the cancellation window; saving conditions (ORD-004). The confirm button is red "Cancel the order and refund [amount] SAR". After it: the status is "Cancelled by support", the full amount hold is released, the task is withdrawn from the driver, the customer, merchant and driver are notified, the penalty is recorded in A04 as effective (or awaiting approval above the role limit) with the right to appeal, and the party at fault is counted in the cancellation rate.
ReassignDialog: a table of eligible drivers with priority points or a driver number, and a mandatory reason. Confirmation pulls the task from the current driver and notifies them of the reason, sends it to the new one, and logs the event. After the driver has picked up the order, a warning "The order is with the current driver" appears (see the question).
Message / sendSends to the selected party in the chat tab, so it appears for them in the app linked to the order, and is saved in the record with the employee's name and time.
Customer unresponsiveness decisionAppears after the support grace period from "Arrived" (ORD-008). A window shows the evidence (staying near the customer and for how long, calls, messages) and the three decision options with a written reason; the effect of each option follows ORD-008.
Amounts decision after automatic cancellationFor an order canceled automatically (ORD-004): a dialog with fields for what the customer bears of the delivery, what is refunded to them, what is paid to the driver, the merchant's penalty for item out of stock if any, and a written reason (ORD-013). The order is closed only after saving.
No-prescription pharmacy decisionFields for the delivery fee refunded and what is paid to the driver and a written reason (PHR-012). Saving sends the customer the cancellation notice and its reason and closes the order.
"Not received" decision (self-pickup)Fields for what is collected from the customer and what is refunded, the merchant's share, and a written reason (EXT-006).
View self-pickup or refundAs in the operations room A02 (ORD-004).
Manual penaltyOpens "Manual add" in A04 with the order pre-filled (PAY-025).

Special states for this page

  • Within the customer's window: "Cancel because" is hidden, and a "The customer can cancel by themselves until [timer]" bar.
  • Awaiting the support decision: an orange bar states the status (such as "Cancelled automatically for non-payment") and the appropriate decision button.
  • Write-in awaiting payment: the payment timer next to the payment status, and the first payment (delivery) is held.
  • Final order (delivered or closed): only refund, compensation, and messaging are available.
  • Another employee is working on it: actions are disabled with "[Name] is working on it · Request transfer".
  • Mart order: no self-pickup option in any window (ORD-004).
  • The customer cancelled it within the window: the status is "Cancelled within the window", the payment hold is cancelled, and it never reached the merchant.
  • Disputed financial decision: an "Open appeal" badge in the decision log with a link to A04.

Validation and error messages

  • Cancellation reason empty ← "Write the cancellation reason" under the field, and the confirm button is disabled.
  • Bearing party not chosen → "Choose who bears the penalty or "No penalty"".
  • Merchant or driver without an amount → "Enter the penalty amount"; zero or negative → "The amount must be greater than zero".
  • The driver received the order and what is paid to him has not been set → "Set what is paid to the driver or enter 0."
  • Refund greater than the captured amount not yet refunded → "Maximum [amount] SAR".
  • Amount above the role limit → a yellow alert "Exceeds your limit ([limit] SAR); it will be sent for approval" and the button becomes "Send for approval".
  • Reassigning to an ineligible driver ← the same exact reason as in A02.

Permissions

  • View the file and the list: admin, support supervisor, support agent, operations (within their cities); finance view only.
  • Cancel with reason, refund, compensation and closing decisions: admin, support supervisor, support agent; they do not appear to operations or finance.
  • Reassignment: admin, support supervisor, support agent, operations.
  • Reverse a previous financial decision (from A04): support supervisor, finance, and admin.
  • Prescription photo: admin, support supervisor, and support agent only.
  • Amount limit per role (ADM-043).

Requirements that govern it

  • ORD-001 Order statuses
  • ADM-043 Operations and support permissions

  • ORD-007 Merchant delay detection
  • ORD-012 Driver delay detection
  • ORD-008 Customer unresponsiveness
  • ORD-013 Write-in orders
  • PHR-012 Pharmacy order
  • EXT-006 Self-pickup

A04 Manual penalties and deductionsImposing, reviewing, and appealing, by authorized decision only.

Page elements

  • Order: order number or status
  • Party: merchant or driver
  • Reason: written
  • The amount and its destination (PAY-025)
  • Evidence
  • Executor: with the date and execution time for each entry
  • Approval: the executor's role limit and the text "Within your limit, so it is executed without approval" or "Above your limit, so it is sent for approval"; and what awaits approval in a separate card beside the form with "Approve" and "Reject" buttons in the same row
  • Appeal: its status in the log
  • Summary at the top of the page: awaiting approval (count and amount), open appeals, effective this month, reversal entries; each number opens its list
  • Filters: period, city, party, approval status, appeal status
  • Impact before saving: for a driver, their wallet balance after the deduction, the task-stop limit, and that the deposit is untouched (PAY-026); for a merchant, that the amount is deducted from their dues and appears in their statement
  • The reversing entry in the log under its original, linked to it (↳), with its reason and executor
  • Entry detail when opened: evidence, the appeal text and the support reply, the values before and after (SUP-003)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Add manuallyForm: the order or case, the party bearing it, the amount, the destination, the reason, the evidence. The save button "Save and deduct [amount] SAR" is disabled until the reason and evidence are complete. Within the role limit it is recorded as effective immediately, deducted and the party is notified (PAY-025); above it, it is recorded as "Awaiting approval" (PAY-026). If the deduction brings the driver to the task-stop limit (PAY-026), this is stated in the confirmation.
ApproveFor the higher role only, and the executor does not approve their own entry. Confirmation "[amount] SAR will be deducted from [party]'s dues". After it the entry takes effect, the approver and time are recorded, and the party is notified.
ReverseA dialog with a mandatory reason and the confirmation "Reverse [amount] SAR for [party]". It creates a reversal entry for the same amount linked to the original without deleting it; the amount returns to the party and they are notified. If the original's month is closed, the reversal is recorded in the open month.
CompensationDirects an effective penalty amount (all or part) to the wallet of the same order's customer; a confirmation states the amount and the customer. The destination becomes "Customer compensation" and the entry is recorded (PAY-025).
RejectFor the approver: rejects an entry awaiting approval with a mandatory reason; it touches no balance, and the actor is notified of the reason.
Accept appealOpens "Reverse" pre-filled with the reason "Appeal accepted", and notifies the party of the acceptance.
Reject appealA written reply is mandatory and reaches the party; the entry remains in force and the appeal status is "Rejected".
Open orderThe order number opens its file in A03.

Special states for this page

  • Pending approval: yellow badge, and the executor sees "Pending approval by [name]".
  • Reversed entry: the original with a "Reversed" badge.
  • Open appeal: an "Open" badge and "Accept appeal" and "Reject appeal" buttons for whoever has permission.
  • Month closed: a hint "The original is in a closed month; the reversal will be recorded in [the open month]".
  • Nothing awaiting approval: "No entries awaiting your approval".

Validation and error messages

  • Order or status is required and must be within the staff member's cities → "No order with this number in your cities."
  • Amount greater than zero with two decimal places → "Enter a valid amount."
  • Reason empty → "Enter the reason"; evidence missing → "Attach at least one piece of evidence; a penalty is not saved without evidence".
  • The bearing party is merchant or driver only (PAY-025).
  • The reason for rejection, reversal, and appeal rejection is mandatory.

Permissions

  • Manual add: admin, support supervisor, support agent.
  • Approval above the role's limit: the higher role (ADM-043).
  • Reversal with a reversing entry and accepting the appeal: admin, support supervisor, finance.
  • Compensation: admin, support supervisor, support agent.
  • Operations and sales do not see the page; anyone without the penalties permission sees no add button and the server does not execute it.

Requirements that govern it

  • PAY-025 Manual penalties
  • ADM-043 Operations and support permissions
  • SUP-003 Cause and cost attribution
  • PAY-026 Negative balance and driver deposit
  • ORD-007 Merchant delay detection

A05 Stores and onboardingEstablishments, branches, contracts, and requests.

Page elements

  • City: filter
  • Type: a "Type · order method" column (MER-046)
  • Status: a colored badge and counters: active, awaiting approval (including those with incomplete data), immediately suspended, draft; and under the suspended one its reason, executor, and time
  • Join requests: tab: establishment, type, city, request date, account manager, what is missing
  • Account manager: a column and a filter
  • Branches
  • Contract: its type: percentage, or a fee per customer and branch
  • Data completeness (X/9) and exactly what is missing: location, city, hours, duration, minimum, bank account (approved by finance), contract, users, a menu or catalog with priced products (MER-001)
  • Search by establishment or branch name
  • Bulk selection with an action bar: assign an account manager, export

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
AddDialog: establishment name, operating type, city, first branch, account manager. Saving creates the store as a "Draft" with its city's boundaries (MER-046) and opens its page (A06) to complete the data.
ImportUpload Excel with the template then check: the number of valid rows, and errors by row number and reason. The "Add [count] stores as drafts · Ignore [count]" button adds the valid ones only; a store is not approved by import.
ApproveA dialog with a completeness checklist; the button is disabled if an operational statement is missing, with a hint naming what is missing (MER-001). The confirmation "Approve [store]" makes it active and receiving orders, notifies the merchant, and logs the approver and the time.
Open fileOpens the merchant page (A06) on the "Overview" tab.
Immediate suspensionFrom the store page or the actions menu: a mandatory reason and the confirmation "[Store] will not receive any new orders". Takes effect immediately (ADM-004) and shows "Immediately suspended" with the reason.
ResumeFor a store suspended immediately: a written reason, then it receives orders immediately and the actor is logged.
Reject join requestA mandatory reason reaches the requester, and the request moves to "Rejected" without deletion.
Assign account managerFor the bulk selection: choose a sales employee then confirm with the number of stores; the change is logged.
ExportDownloads Excel with the current list and its filters.

Special states for this page

  • Incomplete data: a red "Data completeness" with what is missing.
  • Immediately suspended: a red badge, and "Resume" instead of "Open file".
  • No stores in the selected city: "No stores in [city] yet" and "Add" and "Import" buttons.
  • Import with errors only: nothing is added, and the error file is shown for download.

Validation and error messages

  • Name, type, and city are required in "Add" → "Choose the city".
  • Duplicate name in the same city ← "A store with this name exists in [city]; open it instead of creating a new one?".
  • Import rows: "Row [number]: unknown city", "Row [number]: type must be restaurants, Mart, pharmacy, or Shops".
  • The reason for suspension, resumption, and rejection is mandatory.

Permissions

  • Adding, importing, approving, and rejecting: admin and sales.
  • Finance: view only.
  • Immediately pausing a store and resuming it: admin, support supervisor, operations.
  • Each employee sees only their cities' stores.

UX decisions

  • The row's main action changes with its status: open file, approve, or resume.

Requirements that govern it

  • MER-001 Establishment and branches
  • MER-046 Store type and its admin page
  • ADM-004 Instant suspension
  • ADM-032 City page

A06 Merchant pageA unified profile containing all store settings without scatter.

Page elements

  • Overview
  • Operations and scope: the delivery scope on a map: city boundaries or a manual zone (MER-046); and for each branch the hours, prep time, and minimum
  • Products: the price edit permission mode (MER-002) and the percentage, and each product's two prices side by side entered by the manager: menu price and selling price
  • Contract: its type (PAY-009), value and effective date, and the exempted menu link
  • Offers and campaigns
  • Dues
  • Team
  • Support and log: admin's chats with the merchant (ADM-010), the edit log with the executor and values before and after, and bank account changes
  • A fixed header visible in all tabs: name, type and ordering method, city, number of branches, account manager, status (active, suspended immediately), and the "Message merchant" and "Suspend immediately" buttons
  • Preferred captain (MER-038): preferred drivers with their live status (online, offline), their level and equipment, and an add field by driver number
  • Self-pickup: enabled or not, its discount, scope, and who funds the discount (EXT-006)
  • Shops conversion: menu readiness (number of valid products)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Edit settingMakes the current tab's fields editable. "Save" shows a before-and-after difference summary and asks for confirmation; applies to new orders only and is logged in "Support and log".
Shops payoutA dialog that checks menu readiness; with no valid products the button stays disabled "Cannot publish: 0 valid products". The confirmation "Switch to menu for new orders" (MER-053).
Menu permissionsDialog: choose the mode, and the percentage for "Within percentage" (MER-002).
PercentageDialog: the contract type (a percentage agreed with the merchant, or a fee per new customer in each branch), its value and the effective date. The confirmation gives an example: "Selling price 110 and percentage 10% = 11 for the platform" (PAY-009). No confirmed order changes.
RangeChoosing "City boundaries" or "Manual zone" and drawing on the map. Saving applies it to new orders, offers and campaigns (MER-046); a customer outside the store's city cannot order from it.
LinkCreates an exempt menu link and copies it, and it can be stopped. What is deducted from its orders (PAY-009).
Add preferred captainNumber of an approved driver in the store's city; it is added to the list and the store's order is offered to them first for 30 seconds (MER-038).
RemoveRemoves the driver from favorites with a simple confirmation; applies to new orders.
Message the merchantOpens a chat with the merchant linked to the store (or to an order if selected), appearing in their dashboard and app.
Immediate suspensionWritten reason and confirmation "[Store] will not receive any new orders"; takes effect immediately and the button becomes "Resume".
Enable self-pickupA toggle in "Ordering and pickup method"; disabled for Mart with the hint "Mart has no self-pickup".

Special states for this page

  • A Mart store: the ordering method is "Catalog" and self-pickup is disabled.
  • Shops write-in: "Convert Shops" is active; otherwise disabled with the hint "Available to Shops stores only".
  • Preferred captain offline: a "Offline · does not delay the order" badge.
  • Immediately suspended: a red bar at the top of the page with the reason, the performer and the time.
  • Edit with a future effective date: a "Scheduled from [date]" badge beside the value.

Validation and error messages

  • Preferred captain: number does not exist → "No driver with this number"; from another city → "The driver is not in [store city]"; not approved → "The driver is not approved."
  • A manual zone is a closed polygon → "Close the boundary before saving".
  • Percentages between 0 and 100 → "Percentage between 0 and 100."
  • The effective date cannot be in the past.

Permissions

  • Contract, percentage, link, payout and menu permissions: admin and sales; finance view.
  • Scope: admin; preferred captain: admin, operations; immediately pausing the store: admin, support supervisor, operations.
  • Message the merchant: admin, support supervisor, support agent, sales.
  • The employee sees only their cities' stores.

UX decisions

  • Settings not available for the store type stay visible but disabled with a tooltip giving the reason.

A07 Mart catalogsPrimary, secondary, and general, plus review of merchant products.

Page elements

  • Catalogs: each catalog with its status and the number of groceries subscribed to it
  • Central products: search by name or barcode and a catalog and status filter
  • Original prices: with a "Preview +5%" column next to them
  • Subscriptions
  • Local customization: a column with the number of groceries that edited the price, availability, or image, and it opens their detail
  • Products for review: beside the table, for each product the image, the sending grocery, the proposed original price, the request age, and approve and reject buttons in the row
  • Tabs: Central products, Products for review (with count), Subscriptions, Import log
  • Import log: result of the last Excel check: valid, errors
  • Bulk selection for central suspension

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
AddDialog: a new catalog (primary, secondary, general) or a central product (name, category, original price, image, catalog). The product enters the shared groceries (MER-010).
Excel and checkUpload the file then a report: new rows, update rows, errors by row number. "Apply [count] rows" after confirmation. It does not touch a locally edited price (MER-010).
Central suspensionA red confirmation stating the effect and the number of groceries: "[Product] will disappear from [count] groceries and new purchases will be blocked; confirmed orders keep their copy". It takes effect immediately (CAT-001).
Approve productAdds it to the global catalog so it appears in the sender's grocery store and the groceries sharing the global catalog, and notifies the merchant. A transient notification with an "Undo" button for a few seconds.
Reject becauseA written or chosen reason reaches the merchant; the product stays a draft (MER-010).
Central reactivationFor a product suspended centrally: confirmation, then it returns to where it was locally enabled.
Open customization detailList of groceries that customized the product: local price, availability, and photo per grocery; view only.

Special states for this page

  • Centrally suspended: a red badge, and the customization column shows the affected groceries.
  • No products to review: "No products awaiting review".
  • Import in progress: a progress bar, and the list remains usable.
  • Removing a grocery from its subscription: the products disappear from it (CAT-001).

Validation and error messages

  • Original price greater than zero → "Enter a valid price".
  • File errors: "Row [number]: original price is empty", "Row [number]: catalog not found", "Row [number]: duplicate product".
  • The rejection reason is mandatory.

Permissions

  • Catalog management, central suspension and product approval: admin and sales by default (catalogs, price review and enabling the link), and admin grants them to any role from the role editor.
  • Other roles: view only if granted.

Requirements that govern it

  • MER-010 Mart catalogs
  • CAT-001 Mart product inheritance

A08 Merchant reviewsOnly the required review, according to permission and request type.

Page elements

  • Before and after: in two colors, with the customer price shown in both cases
  • Order reason
  • Customer price: to edit the price, it shows the approved original and the percentage change from it, the store's own permission mode, the menu price and selling price, and what the customer sees until the decision (MER-002)
  • Special offers: offer terms and funding per party (MKT-007)
  • Campaigns: the placement, city, duration, price, and remaining capacity (MKT-003)
  • New product: a review type that opens in A07
  • Review-type chips with their counters: prices, special offers, campaigns, new products; and the city filter and sorting (oldest first by default)
  • The age of each order in the list
  • Rejection reason with ready templates and free text
  • Decision log: reviewer, time, and reason

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
ApprovalThe button states the outcome by type: a price "Becomes the customer price [price]" takes effect on new orders immediately; a special offer is published with its terms; a campaign is published and its amount is deducted (MKT-003). The merchant is notified, the decision is recorded, and the list moves to the next item.
Reject becauseThe reason is mandatory (a template or text); the previously approved one remains and nothing is deducted (MER-002, MKT-003), and the merchant receives the reason. Moves to the next item.
Open storeOpens the merchant page (A06) on the related tab (products or offers and campaigns).
Open new productOpens the review in the Mart catalogs (A07).

Special states for this page

  • The merchant withdrew the request before the decision: the item is gray "Withdrawn by merchant" with no buttons.
  • Slot capacity was filled before approval: "Approve" is disabled with the hint "No capacity in this slot for the requested duration".
  • Two orders on the same product: only the latest appears with the note "Replaces a previous order".
  • Nothing to review: "No orders awaiting review".

Validation and error messages

  • Rejection without a reason → "Choose a reason or write one".
  • The funding share is greater than the offer cost ← "The funding share must not exceed the offer cost" and approval is disabled.

Permissions

  • Special offers and campaigns: admin and sales.
  • Price edits: admin and sales by default (catalogs, price review, and enabling the integration).
  • Only the reviews required are shown, according to the employee's permission and the order type.

UX decisions

  • The list is on the right and the detail on the left, and the decision does not require going back to the list.

Requirements that govern it

  • MKT-007 Offers and funding

A09 Cities and zonesBoundaries, coverage, fees, and exceptions.

Page elements

  • Boundaries: the city boundaries on the map (the default zone), with the drivers' private zones (DSP-002) and out-of-boundary coverage requests
  • Sections: those enabled in the city
  • Stores and drivers: city page numbers (ADM-032): stores (by section), drivers (and those online now), active customers, delivered orders; each number opens its list filtered by the city
  • Delivery fee (PAY-013): the base fee and its kilometers, the extra kilometer price, the minimum and maximum, the fee for restaurants and miscellaneous stores and the fee for Mart and pharmacies, the distance measurement method, the effective date, and rule priority
  • Driver percentage: in the "Fees and driver percentage" tab
  • Batching: a setting per city
  • Coverage requests: on the map outside the boundaries and in the readiness indicator
  • Cities list beside the city page: name, region, status (open, candidate, suspended), readiness for candidates (X/6 with a bar), and whether it has a custom setting
  • City tabs: overview and boundaries, fees and driver percentage, dispatch and driver cap, seasons, readiness and opening
  • Source of each setting: "Follows global" or "City-specific" with an "Exception" badge and a revert button
  • A "Global setting / [City]" switcher in the header shows which level is being edited
  • Dispatch settings (DSP-001) with the global value and the city value: starting range, increase, maximum, who is offered to, acceptance time, interval, preferred captain, support alert, search timeout, new-driver score, prioritizing those who stayed online with no order; and priority-point weights with a calculation preview using the three examples that updates as the weights change
  • Driver cap and queue count (DSP-004); empty = no cap
  • Seasons (ADM-015): name, cities, from and to, and what is linked to it
  • Readiness and opening (ADM-037): the candidate city indicator, the checklist, and the number who registered interest
  • An "Immediate pause" button for the city and a badge for the active season

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Draw boundariesDraw a shape on the map using polygon points. "Save boundaries" shows the effect before confirmation: "[count] stores with no manual zone will take the new boundaries · [count] customer addresses became out of range". Applies to new orders.
PricingDialog: "Follows the global setting" or "Custom setting" with PAY-013 fields and an effective date, with a fee preview for an example distance.
City settingsOpens the settings tab (dispatch, driver percentage, batching, cap, enabled sections); each item either "Follows global" or has a specific value with an "Exception" badge. "Save [city] settings" applies to orders whose dispatch starts after it, and the editor and the values before and after are recorded.
Open cityFor a candidate city: shows the checklist and the button is disabled until it is complete (ADM-037). The confirmation states the effect "[City] will open for ordering and [count] registered users will receive a notification with the opening coupon". It becomes "Open" and the notification is sent once.
Global settingSwitches the editor to the global setting (distribution, fees and cap). The save confirmation states the number of cities that follow the global setting and will be affected.
Exception / customizeConverts an item from "Follows global" to a city-specific value with an "Exception" badge.
Revert to globalDeletes the city value for the item so it goes back to following the global one; a simple confirmation states the value that will apply.
Immediate suspensionA written reason and confirmation "Customers in [city] won't be able to order until resumption". It takes effect immediately, and the city appears as "Paused" in the list, and the button becomes "Resume".
Add seasonA dialog with season fields (ADM-015).
Private driver zoneChoosing a driver and drawing a zone inside the city (DSP-002). It is removed with the "Remove zone" button.
Open menuCity page numbers and coverage requests open their lists filtered by city (ADM-032): stores A05, drivers A10, customers A13.
Add candidate cityName and region (country → region → city); created as "Candidate" with readiness 0/6.

Special states for this page

  • A city that fully follows the global setting: all items "Follows global" with no exception badge.
  • Scheduled fee rule: a "Scheduled from [date]" badge and the current value beside it.
  • Candidate city: the default tab is "Readiness and opening".
  • Suspended city: a red strip with the reason, actor, and time and a "Resume" button.
  • Active season: a badge in the city header, and season-dependent values with a season icon.
  • Driver cap reached: "Queue now: [count]" in a warning color.

Validation and error messages

  • Boundaries: an unclosed or self-intersecting polygon → "Close the boundary without intersections".
  • Fees: minimum greater than the maximum → "The minimum must not exceed the maximum"; negative value → "The value cannot be negative"; effective in the past → "Choose a date from today onward".
  • Dispatch: starting radius greater than the maximum → "The starting radius must not exceed the maximum"; weights not equal to 100 → "Weights total [total]; must be 100".
  • The cap is a positive integer or empty.
  • Season: end before start → "End date must be after the start date."

Permissions

  • City page and its numbers: all roles within their cities (view).
  • Drawing boundaries, pricing, settings, general setup, seasons, opening a city and pausing it immediately: admin.

Requirements that govern it

A10 DriversAccounts, activation, restrictions, and equipment.

Page elements

  • Account: status chips with their counters: awaiting approval, active, stopped from tasks (PAY-026), held for review, suspended with a reason, banned
  • Vehicle: driver type and vehicle under the name (DRV-001)
  • City and zone: city boundaries or a special zone (DSP-002)
  • Performance: link to A11
  • Bank and deposit: wallet and deposit are two columns and two separate cards (PAY-024, PAY-026): the wallet balance is yellow near the suspension limit and red at it, and the deposit held or "Not paid" with a dotted border and a lock
  • Equipment: thermal bag, cooling bag, uniform (DRV-013)
  • Ban
  • Payouts: link
  • Search by name, ID, or mobile number, with type and equipment filters
  • The selected driver's panel beside the table: a suspension status alert and its reason with a sentence explaining when it returns, the wallet and deposit cards, and the latest wallet movements
  • Documents and their expiry dates (reminder only)
  • Fraud detection (DRV-027): the type, time, and evidence

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
ApproveA checklist dialog (DRV-001) and the deposit is paid. The button is disabled if the deposit is not paid, with the hint "Deposit not paid". Confirmation activates the account, notifies the driver and logs the approver.
Suspend because ofDialog: a mandatory reason and the duration (until manually lifted or until a date). Confirmation "[Driver] will not receive new tasks". Takes effect immediately, notifies the driver of the reason, and shows "Suspended for reason" and a "Lift suspension" button (PAY-026).
BlockDialog: the scope (the whole platform, a specific store, a specific customer) and a reason. A red confirmation states the effect. A block from a store or customer excludes them only from distribution of that store's or customer's orders; from the platform it prevents entering tasks, and account closure goes through support (DRV-001).
Edit cityThe new city and a reason; confirm "[Driver] will receive [city] orders only, and his own zone is canceled." It applies to new offers and is logged.
Lift suspensionWritten reason; resumes receiving tasks immediately unless paused by balance (PAY-026) or suspended for review.
Forgery detection reviewEvidence dialog (route, jumps, device type) and two options with a mandatory note: "Lift suspension" (false detection) or "Keep suspension and stop with reason" (DRV-027).
Edit equipmentThe three equipment toggles; the change is logged and applies to assignment immediately (DRV-013).
Define private zoneDraw a zone inside the city (DSP-002).
MessageOpens a chat with the driver linked to their account or to an order the employee selects (ADM-010).
PerformanceOpens the "Driver file" tab in A11.
Close accountVia support: a settlement window showing the wallet balance and deposit (PAY-024, PAY-026). The button "Close the account and refund [amount] SAR" does not work before settlement. The account becomes "Closed" and the final payout is sent for payout approval.

Special states for this page

  • Near the suspension limit: active with a yellow "Near limit" badge.
  • At the suspension limit (PAY-026): red "Suspended".
  • Deposit not paid: "Not paid" in the deposit column.
  • Suspended for review (spoofing): "Suspended" and a "Review spoofing detection" button (DRV-027).
  • Expired or near-expiry document: a "Reminder only" badge and no suspension.
  • Closed account: read-only with the closing date and the settlement amount.

Validation and error messages

  • A written reason is mandatory for suspension, banning, editing the city, and lifting a suspension.
  • Editing the city during an active task → "The driver has an active task; the change takes effect after it ends".
  • Suspension end in the past ← "Choose a later date".
  • Closing an account with an ongoing task or a pending payout ← "Finish the ongoing task and the pending payout first".

Permissions

  • Approval, suspension, banning, editing the city, equipment, and forgery review: admin, support supervisor, operations (within their cities).
  • Wallet and deposit: everyone sees the status; movement details are for admin, finance and support.
  • Closing and settling the account: admin, support supervisor, support agent; the final payout is approved by whoever has payout approval (admin, finance).
  • Messaging: admin, support supervisor, support agent, operations.

Requirements that govern it

A11 Driver performance and incentivesMetrics, levels, filters, and incentives.

Page elements

  • Period and custom: performance filters (DRV-017), and "Last 30 days" is tagged "Level score"
  • 30-day score: the performance table with indicator columns and each indicator's weight in its column header (DRV-017); "—" for an indicator with no data
  • Indicator breakdown: driver analytics (ADM-009)
  • Levels: with their names and default thresholds in the drawing (DRV-015), and beside them the review alerts (ADM-009), each alert with a "Review" button and the phrase "No automatic deduction"
  • Incentives: a tab; for each incentive the type (the DRV-006 types or instant), city, days, hours, levels, reward, budget, expiry, cost, extra orders, and status
  • Budget: in the incentives card with the spend and its percentage and the extra orders it brought
  • Percentage: the ranking of the driver's platform percentage in the incentives card
  • The four tabs (ADM-035)
  • A "Daily update" stamp and the time of the last update
  • Targeted instant incentive dialog (second preview): ADM-044 fields and the number of matching drivers
  • System settings tab: score weights and converting the indicator to points (DRV-017), tier thresholds and benefits per city and period (DRV-015), the report alert ratio (ADM-009), and the priority point weights in dispatch (DSP-001)
  • Driver profile tab: their score and pinned tier, a breakdown of their indicators, previous reviews and alerts, the incentives they received

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
SettingOpens "System settings". Saving shows the confirmation "Scores will be recalculated in the next daily update; the benefit fixed on accepted tasks does not change". The editor and the values before and after are recorded.
IncentiveCreate dialog: one of the four types with DRV-006 fields and a cost preview, or "Instant" which opens the targeted incentive dialog. Its visibility and stopping follow DRV-006 and ADM-044.
AlertA written message reaches the driver in the app about their performance; no financial effect. It is logged in their profile.
ReviewOpens a review: the relevant reports, orders and ratings. The decision: close with no action, or alert, or refer to a manual penalty (A04), or suspend with a reason (A10), with a mandatory note (ADM-009).
Launch the incentiveA confirmation stating the count and the limit "Launch the incentive for [count] drivers · limit [amount] SAR". It appears immediately to those in the group and stops at its limit or the end of its period (ADM-044).
Save the group with its conditionsSaves the group under a name the manager enters so it appears in "Saved group"; its members are calculated from the conditions at the time of each use.
Stop incentiveA confirmation stating that the incentive disappears from drivers immediately, and what was earned before the stop is paid out.
Copy incentiveCreates a copy for another city or another month without affecting the original.
Performance filtersIt changes only the displayed numbers; the tier score does not change (DRV-017).

Special states for this page

  • New driver: the tier is "New" and no score shows for them in the table (DRV-015, DSP-001).
  • Indicator with no data: "—" (DRV-017).
  • Incentive that reached its budget: "Stopped: budget reached" in gray.
  • Incentive whose date has passed: "Expired".
  • A group with no matches: "No one matches now" and the launch button is disabled.
  • A filter other than "Last 30 days": a bar "View only · the tier does not change".

Validation and error messages

  • Score weights do not equal 100 ← "Total weights [total]; must be 100".
  • Tier thresholds overlap or have a gap ← "Tier thresholds must connect without overlapping".
  • Incentive: budget or cap zero → "Enter a cap greater than zero"; end before start → "End date must be after the start"; amount greater than the cap → "The amount must not exceed the cap".
  • The review decision note is mandatory.

Permissions

  • Driver performance and profile: admin, support supervisor, operations (within their cities).
  • Alerts and review: admin, support supervisor, operations.
  • Incentives and system settings: admin; finance sees the budget and cost.
  • Launch an instant incentive: admin, operations (preferred captain and instant incentive).

Requirements that govern it

  • DRV-015 Driver levels

A18 Accounts

A13 Customers and segmentsRetention, targeting, and the customer profile.

Page elements

  • Tabs: customers, blocklists
  • Segments: ready-made: all, new, active, dormant (60 days), high spenders, exceeded the trust threshold (SUP-007)
  • Segment summary: number of customers, average spend, median last order, share with notifications enabled
  • Customers table: city, orders, spend, last order, rating, refund rate; sortable by last order, orders, spend, rating, and city
  • Customer file: status, registration date, address (by permission), refund rate and a trust-threshold-exceeded badge, tickets and satisfaction, notifications, and block entries against them (drivers blocked from serving them)
  • Wallet: balance types and the expiry date of each type (PAY-002), and the freeze status: "Awaiting second approval" then "Frozen" with the requester's and approver's names
  • Blocklists: customers, merchants, drivers, driver blocked by a store, and driver blocked by a customer; for each block: the party, type, reason, duration (until a date or permanent), actor, date

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
CouponOpens coupon creation (A14) restricted to the customer or segment, with an eligibility preview before saving
AlertOpens a scheduled notification (A17) with the customer or segment as audience, with the audience count and a template preview before sending; it respects the frequency limit
CompensationDialog: the amount, the reason, the related order if any; after confirmation the customer receives a reward notification (PAY-002) and it is logged. Anything above the role limit is escalated to a higher role (ADM-043)
Suspend because ofDialog: reason, duration (until a date or permanent), note; a confirmation stating that the customer will not be able to order, then the account is suspended, appears in the block lists and is logged
Consecutive-orders rewardAmount and reason dialog; added as promotional credit (MKT-002)
Block driver from a customerSelects a driver, the reason and the duration (ADM-013)
Block driver from a storeFrom the block lists: selects a driver and a store, the reason and the duration (ADM-013)
Freeze walletAsks for a reason, then it is sent to a second employee for approval (ADM-013); it is not frozen before that. Unfreezing uses the same dual approval, and the requester and approver are recorded
Lift blockFrom the block lists, with a reason, and it is logged
Send to segmentMoves the current segment with its filters and count to A17 as the audience for a new notification

Special states for this page

  • Address hidden: a lock and the text "Visible to those with permission" appear instead (ADM-008)
  • Awaiting freeze approval: "Awaiting second approval" badge and the requester's name
  • Frozen wallet: the balance is shown with a red badge and is not paid out
  • A customer who exceeded the trust threshold (SUP-007): a red badge and the refund percentage on their reports
  • Expired ban: moves automatically to "Expired" in the ban lists

Validation and error messages

  • Banning and suspension: the reason and duration are mandatory "Choose the duration or "Permanent""; and lifting a ban: the reason is mandatory
  • Freeze wallet: the approver is someone other than the requester, "Another employee approves"
  • Compensation and reward: an amount greater than zero and a mandatory reason

Permissions

  • View customers: support and operations roles within their cities; the address for whoever has the customer address permission (ADM-001)
  • Compensation, consecutive-orders reward, banning and suspending customers, and the second approval for freezing: (ADM-043)
  • Coupon and marketing alert: admin, sales
  • Banning a driver from a store or customer: the "Drivers: approve, suspend, and ban" permission (admin, support supervisor, operations)

UX decisions

  • Restrictive actions (ban, freeze, suspend) are separated by a line and in red from retention actions
  • The wallet is broken down by its types because support is asked about it often

Requirements that govern it

  • ADM-008 Customer analytics
  • ADM-013 Blocking Important

  • SUP-007 Trust thresholds in refunds
  • ADM-002 Audit log and dual approval

A14 Offers and couponsScope, funding, budget, and stacking rule.

Page elements

  • Tabs: all, admin offers, merchant offers (with a badge for the count awaiting review), coupons, Hour Deals
  • Budget or stock: a "Used / total" column, and a "Budget almost used" badge
  • Offer fields (MKT-007): cities and stores, areas, products, duration, stock, minimum order, budget, funding as a percentage or amount for each party, stacking
  • Coupon fields (MKT-001): cities and stores, categories, customers or customer category relative to the store, period, usage limit, budget, funding for each party, stacking
  • Restricting the coupon to an issuing bank: choose the bank and the financier (MKT-001)
  • "First order" line: a fixed line in the form that shows the rule (MKT-001)
  • Setting for combining with wallet credit: read-only under the combining field (MKT-001)
  • Hour schedule (Hour Deal): product, discount, stock, schedule (once or recurring days, start and end hour), and the unified countdown until the end of the period (MKT-017)
  • Eligibility preview: inside the form before saving: the number of eligible customers and stores, and the excluded with their reasons (out of scope, not dormant, device used previously)
  • Merchant deals awaiting review: a list with approve and reject buttons

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
CreateValidates the fields then saves: "Scheduled" if its date is upcoming, otherwise "Active" immediately; an admin offer without review when the merchant participates (MKT-007). Logged in the audit log
ExtendA new end date field, and increasing the budget or stock is optional; after confirmation the offer continues without interruption
SuspendA confirmation stating the number of orders in progress with the offer and that they keep their discount; then it becomes "Suspended" and is not applied to new orders
Eligibility previewCalculates with the current conditions without saving and shows the result in the form
Approve merchant offerPublishes the offer immediately or on its date, and a notification reaches the merchant
Reject merchant offerAsks for a reason that reaches the merchant (MKT-007), and the offer stays unpublished
Create on behalf of a merchantFrom "Merchant offers": creates the offer in the merchant's name (MKT-007), and the performer is logged

Special states for this page

  • Budget exhausted: the offer stops automatically with the status "Budget ended" (MKT-001)
  • Hour Deal out of stock or its period ended: (MKT-017)
  • A merchant deal awaiting review: does not appear to customers
  • A deal outside the store's range: does not appear (MKT-007), and the preview lists the excluded stores

Validation and error messages

  • Funding: "Total [N]%; must not exceed the offer cost (100%)" under the field with the actual total, and the create button is disabled until corrected (MKT-007)
  • Hour Deal discount: "Minimum Hour Deal discount is 30%" (MKT-017)
  • End date after the start, and the budget greater than zero
  • Rejecting a merchant's offer: the reason is mandatory
  • A scope outside the employee's cities cannot be selected

Permissions

  • Creating, extending and pausing offers and coupons and reviewing merchant offers: admin, sales
  • Other roles do not see the page; support sees the coupon's effect in the order file

Requirements that govern it

A15 Loyalty and referralOpenLoyalty rules, rewards, and cost measurement.

Page elements

  • Tabs: points, referral, sync
  • Summary: points granted, pending, redeemed, the points liability in SAR (link to liabilities in A18), completed invites, pending invite rewards in SAR
  • Rules: for each rule: city and period, point value, the funder (the platform, or the merchant for the double points they buy), cap, redemption and expiry (MKT-010), status
  • Points basis card: short sentences under the rules table explaining the basis, the hold, and the redemption (MKT-010), with rounding down
  • Referral: each city's reward, its period, type, and cost (MKT-013)
  • Invitations: a count funnel: awaiting first order, pending, withdrawn, rejected for first-order abuse
  • Sync: OpenLoyalty status and last sync, and the events that were not sent
  • Links: Adjust links awaiting matching
  • "Add with reason" dialog: customer, points or credit, reason, funder

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
EditOpens the rule for editing (value, limit, expiry, cap, city, period); saving creates a version that applies to new events only, and it is recorded
SuspendA confirmation stating that the points already granted remain and that the rule no longer grants points; it becomes "Suspended"
Add because ofAdds points or credit to the customer; it is recorded with the executor and appears in liabilities (PAY-031)
Sync reviewShows the unsent events with their identifiers; "Resend" sends them again without repeating the reward (MKT-010)

Special states for this page

  • OpenLoyalty down: a badge "Down · orders working", and events are saved for resync (MKT-010); sync errors explicitly state that orders were not affected
  • Pending points: shown to the customer as "Pending" (MKT-010)
  • Invite reward withdrawn due to an order refund: it appears in the count and has an entry (MKT-013)
  • A merchant-funded double points rule: a "Funded by merchant" badge

Validation and error messages

  • "Add with reason": the reason is mandatory, and points are greater than zero
  • Cap and expiry are positive numbers, and the rule period's start is before its end

Permissions

  • Rules, referral and pausing them: admin, sales (offers, ads and campaigns)
  • "Add with reason": points for admin (adding points to the customer), and credit for whoever has compensation and credit permission (admin, support supervisor, support agent)
  • Sync review: admin

UX decisions

  • Points liability in SAR in the summary because the program's cost is admin's first question

Page elements

  • Campaigns table: merchant and city, placement, duration, total amount (price × days), status (awaiting approval, active, ended, rejected with reason, paused)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
PricingSaves the placement's price, capacity and pause policy for a city; applies to new campaigns only (MKT-003).
ApproveA confirmation stating the amount that will be deducted from the merchant's dues; after it the campaign is published on schedule and the deduction is recorded in their statement (MKT-003), and the merchant receives a notification
RejectAsks for a reason that reaches the merchant; no deduction and no publishing (MKT-008)
SuspendAsks for the reason: "Platform reason" or "At the merchant's request" (MKT-003); and shows the refunded amount before confirmation

Special states for this page

  • Rejected campaign: the reason is visible in the table and to the merchant

Validation and error messages

  • No approval for a campaign that exceeds the slot's capacity in the period: "Capacity is full in [period]"

Permissions

A17 NotificationsOrder templates, scheduling, and targeting via OneSignal.

Page elements

  • Tabs: order events, scheduled notifications, automatic messages, merchant campaigns, templates and languages
  • Event (order events): for each event: its identifier, the template in each language, the channels, the order link, the status (INT-004)
  • New notification: type (operational or marketing), audience (segment and INT-004 options), city, store (restricts the audience to its scope), time in Riyadh time, template
  • Arabic and English templates: preview of each enabled language side by side
  • Audience preview: adjacent to the form: the final count, and the excluded with their reasons (outside the store's scope, reached the frequency limit (ADM-007), turned off notifications)
  • AI suggestion: a "Review the suggestion" card for the text and audience (INT-004)
  • Automatic messages: a short list of ADM-040 rules, each rule with: event, timeout, template, daily limit, status; with text stating that they run without AI
  • Merchant campaigns: the repetition limits, budget, and templates available to the merchant, and their aggregated results (MKT-005)
  • Templates and languages: each template with its key and translations; adding a language as a data row (SYS-013)
  • Results: sent, opened, resulting orders per notification and for the period

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
ScheduleA confirmation shows the final audience count, then it is saved as "Scheduled" for its time; it can be edited or cancelled before its time
SendConfirm "The notification will reach [count] customers now" then sending via OneSignal (ADM-007), and the results appear progressively
TemplateOpens the template editor: the text in each language, the allowed variables, the link
Trigger eventEnables or disables an order-event notification or an automatic message rule (ADM-040)
Approve AI suggestionShows the proposed text and audience for editing; it does not enter scheduling until "Approve" (INT-004), and the approver is recorded
Set merchant campaign limitsSets the frequency limit, budget and templates available to merchants; applies to new campaigns

Special states for this page

  • Zero audience after exclusion: the send button is disabled "No one in the audience after exclusion"
  • OneSignal down: scheduled notifications wait and an alert appears; orders are not affected
  • AI tool failure: the suggestion card is hidden (ADM-040)
  • A template missing an enabled language: a "Translation incomplete" badge

Validation and error messages

  • Scheduling time in the future: "Choose a time after now"
  • Store view: whoever is outside its delivery range is excluded automatically and the excluded count appears (ADM-007)
  • The text for each enabled language is mandatory, and the template is not saved without it
  • The timeout and the daily limit of automatic messages are positive numbers

Permissions

  • Marketing notifications, automatic messages, and merchant campaigns: admin, sales
  • Order event templates and activating them: admin
  • Approve the AI suggestion: the manager (admin)

UX decisions

  • The send-now button is secondary and scheduling is primary to reduce mistaken sends

A18 AccountsReconciliation, settlements, liabilities, and closing.

Page elements

  • The nine tabs (ADM-036): each tab shows a number for what awaits action (open discrepancies, accounts awaiting approval)
  • Months status bar: the current one is open, the previous one awaits closing, and the oldest is closed; and the result of the daily ledger balance check (PAY-005)
  • "Needs your attention" is the first overview: accounts awaiting approval, failed payouts, reconciliation differences, entries not sent to Odoo, a month ready to close; each item has a button that opens its location
  • Overview: captured and held (with the number of open orders), undistributed dues (with the number of accounts), payouts sent, open discrepancies with their count and amount, negative driver balances and those who stopped receiving tasks (PAY-026), obligations and those ending this month, and held driver deposits separate from wallet balances; each number opens its list
  • Capture and reconciliation: each payment with its status (held, captured, hold released, refunded, failed), its method, the Moyasar reference, and its actual fee (PAY-027)
  • Daily reconciliation (INT-001): a line equation: collected − actual Moyasar fee = expected in bank, versus actually deposited; the difference in red with a hold button; and the payment fee taken from merchants is a separate revenue line (PAY-027)
  • Dues and payouts: the live statement and the dues list (PAY-006) with columns: select, account and its type, due, deductions and fees, net, statement, status, bank reference, payout date
  • Payout states: "Awaiting approval" then the PAY-006 states, and "Failed" with the Moyasar reason
  • Bulk selection: a checkbox per row and "Select all" in the header; on selection a fixed dark bar above the table: the number of accounts, their total net, and an "Approve N payouts" button (not "Confirm")
  • Rows that cannot be approved: visible with a disabled checkbox and a written reason: negative balance (PAY-026), or a transfer prepared by the current user (ADM-002)
  • Driver deposit refund: a row in the payouts list that goes through the same approval (PAY-024)
  • Liabilities: the single table with its items and columns (PAY-031), and a line reconciling the total with wallet and points balances in the ledger
  • Invoices: customer purchase orders, and each merchant's statement and monthly invoice with their lines (PAY-022, PAY-007)
  • Tax: platform fee tax shown separately (PAY-022), the amount deducted from tips (15%), and the rate's effective date
  • Refunds: each refund with its type (full, partial, compensation), source (card, wallet), who executed it, its reason and the bearing party, and a link to the order and the reversal entry
  • Financial reports: the "Finance" reports from the reports center (net revenue with its components, order profitability, capture and reconciliation, dues and payouts, liabilities, refunds, expected balance) with the same filters
  • Closing and controls: each month's status and who closed it and when, a link to the financial audit log (A26), and the roles' financial limits for reading (edited in A22)
  • Entries: a table of the latest entries: entry number, time, description, debit, credit, reference; and the reversing entry with a "Reversal" badge and a link to its original instead of editing the row
  • Odoo: last successful send, number of entries waiting, and a resend button

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
Approve payouts individually or in bulk"Approve" in the row for one account, or the bar "Approve N payouts" for the selection. Both open a confirmation: each account with its masked IBAN and amount, the total, that sending via Moyasar cannot be stopped after approval, and the excluded rows with their reason. After approval (PAY-006) the rows change to "In progress" then "Sent" with the bank reference or "Failed" with the reason, and a notification "N payouts sent for execution" appears
Retry failedOn a payout that "Failed": a confirmation showing the Moyasar reason and the current bank account details (the new IBAN if edited). It resends the payout with the same amount without new approval, unless the IBAN changed, in which case it needs new approval
Reversal entryDialog: the original entry for reading, the amount, the reason. After confirmation the entry is created in the open month linked to its original (PAY-005), and appears in the audit log (ADM-002). If the original is in a closed month the dialog states that the correction will be recorded in the open month
ClosingFor a month "Awaiting close": a confirmation showing the month summary (total entries, open differences, incomplete payouts) and asking to type the month name because it cannot be reversed. After it the month becomes "Closed" with the actor's name and time (ADM-036)
ExportExports the current tab with the same period and filters to Excel or PDF with numbers identical to the screen, and it is recorded in the audit log
Open figure to its listTapping a number in the overview opens the relevant tab, filtered by what it was counted from
Open account statementA side panel with the live statement of the merchant or driver (PAY-006) with penalties, the carried-over previous balance, and the net; and an "Approve" button if the account is due
Select all / deselect"Select all" selects the approvable rows in the filtered page only; "Clear selection" hides the bulk bar
Team commentIn daily reconciliation: a note and classification of differences (late deposit, different fee, missing transaction); the difference stays "Open" until settled by an entry, and the comment is recorded under the employee's name
Retry a failed paymentFor a payment capture or hold cancellation that failed at Moyasar: it retries the same request with its identifier to prevent duplication, and the status updates when Moyasar responds
Resend entriesSends the pending entries to Odoo in order and shows the count that succeeded and failed
Issue the monthly invoiceFor each merchant after the month ends: a preview of the lines, tax, and total; after confirmation it is issued and appears in the merchant statement and is not edited, and correction is by (PAY-007)
Open orderFrom the Refunds tab, opens the order file in A03

Special states for this page

  • Closed month: its entries are read-only (ADM-036)
  • Open reconciliation difference: a red row in daily reconciliation and a number on the Collection and reconciliation tab until it is settled
  • Daily balance check failure (PAY-005): a red alert at the top of the page with the date and the difference
  • Odoo down: a yellow bar "Entries are saved in the ledger and awaiting sending (N)", while orders and payouts keep working
  • Failed payout: stays "Failed" and is not counted among sent payments (PAY-006)
  • A bulk approval that partially succeeded: a notification "N sent and M failed", and the failed ones are shown with a "Retry failed" button
  • Account with a negative balance: no transfer to it (PAY-026); and a suspended driver gets a "Paused from tasks" badge
  • A payout prepared by the current user: its checkbox is disabled with an "Approved by someone else" badge
  • No dues on schedule: "No accounts due in this period" with the next payout date
  • Companies: hidden at launch, and a "Companies" filter appears when they are enabled later

Validation and error messages

  • The approve button in the window is disabled until "I reviewed each account's statement" is checked
  • A row whose balance is negative or zero is not selected, nor is a transfer the user created themself; the reason appears on hovering over the cell
  • A change in an account's due after it is selected (a new order or a penalty): "The amount of [account] changed from [old] to [new]; review before approval", and the new amount is approved after confirming it
  • Reversing entry: reason is required, and the amount is greater than zero and does not exceed the original: "Amount is greater than the original entry ([amount])"
  • Closing: the button is disabled until the month name is typed exactly
  • Difference hold: the note is mandatory

Permissions

  • The page, approving payouts, and financial reports: admin and finance; whoever lacks approval sees the list without checkboxes or approve buttons
  • The creator of a manual payout (deposit refund, early withdrawal) does not approve it, even if an admin (ADM-002)
  • Reversing entry: the "Reverse a financial decision with a reversing entry" permission (admin, support supervisor, finance)
  • Closing: the holder of the closing permission (finance by default) and admin
  • No direct adjustment of any party's balance (PAY-005)

Requirements that govern it

A19 Support and ticketsContext, evidence, decision, satisfaction, and appeal.

Page elements

  • Tickets: a list with chips "Mine" and "Unassigned" first then "All"; and by type: not received, missing and damaged, Mart damage, appeals, financial; and for each ticket: the type, order number, customer or party, age, responsible employee, and a red badge for one exceeding the trust threshold
  • Ticket header: the type, the order number (SUP-001), an "Inside/outside the complaint window" badge, the responsible employee, the open order button, the call button
  • Three cards at the top of the ticket before the decision: evidence, trust, financial authority
  • Trust: refund rate, number of orders and refunds, a badge for exceeding the trust threshold, no automatic refund (SUP-004, SUP-007), and the number of alerts or restrictions
  • Evidence file: its contents (SUP-002) and the delivery photo
  • Damage (reported items): item, quantity, price, reason
  • Financial permission: the staff member's role, what it can execute without approval, the role's amount limit, and that anything above it is escalated (ADM-043)
  • Reply: the ticket conversation, each message with its time and the employee's name
  • Ticket settlements log: reason, bearing party, evidence, amounts per party, executor and time, appeal status
  • Appeal: the appeal text from the charged party and its attachments, and the supervisor's decision
  • Satisfaction: the customer's rating of the resolution after closing
  • Settlement dialog: refunded items, reason, refund to (original payment method or refund credit in the wallet), "Who bears the loss?" with three cards (merchant, driver, no one), the amount charged, evidence, the role limit check result; and a confirm button that writes the full effect, such as "Refund [amount] to the customer and charge it to the merchant"
  • Consecutive-orders reward dialog: the amount and the reason (MKT-002)
  • Calling: masked call buttons and call recording after connecting the call center (INT-013)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
ReplySends the message immediately in the ticket chat, and a notification that opens the ticket reaches the other party
PayoutA list of employees or teams (support supervisor, finance, operations) with a mandatory note; ownership transfers and the recipient's name appears on the ticket, and the transfer is recorded
Refund within permissionsOpens the settlement window. On confirming, it is refunded to the customer and charged to the selected party with a linked entry, and the party receives a notification with the reason and it appears in their statement with an appeal button (SUP-003, PAY-025). Above the role limit the button becomes "Escalate for approval" and is sent to a higher role without execution (ADM-043)
Manual penaltyOpens the penalty window (A04): party, amount, reason, evidence, destination of the amount (PAY-025); a decision independent of loss allocation, and it is recorded (ADM-043)
CloseA confirmation shows a summary of what was executed; a solution-rating request is sent to the customer, and the ticket stays open to appeal during its window (SUP-003)
Claim a ticketThe "Mine" button assigns the unassigned ticket to the current employee and shows their name to the others; if another employee got there first, "[Name] took it moments ago" appears
Open orderOpens the order file in A03; from it the cancellation window after the grace period (reason, bearer, amounts per party) for whoever has the permission
Consecutive-orders rewardOpens its window; on confirming, promotional credit is added to the customer and recorded (MKT-002)
Masked callCalls the party without revealing their number, and the call and its recording are logged on the order and the employee (INT-013). Before linking, the button is disabled with the hint "Call center not linked"
Accept appeal / reject appealAcceptance amends the decision with a reversing entry for the charged amount; rejection requires a reason. Both notify the party and are recorded in the audit log
Reverse the decisionReverses a previous settlement with a reversing entry linked to its original after the reason is written

Special states for this page

  • A ticket another employee is working on: their name is visible, it opens read-only, and a "Request transfer" button replaces the decision buttons (ADM-042)
  • Customer exceeded the trust threshold (SUP-007): red badge "Trust threshold exceeded · support supervisor decision"
  • Repeated violation: a "Customer warned" badge then "Restricted"
  • Mart report outside the window (SUP-009): "Outside complaint window" badge, and the refund button asks to confirm the exception
  • Amount above the role limit: "Awaiting support supervisor approval" and it is not executed before approval
  • An open appeal on a settlement: an "Appeal" badge in the list and the ticket header
  • "Didn't arrive" report: shows delivery evidence instead of the photo (SUP-002)

Validation and error messages

  • The reason and the bearing party are mandatory; the confirm button is disabled until both are complete
  • The charged amount does not exceed the proven damage (SUP-002): "Does not exceed the proven damage ([amount]). For a penalty use "Manual penalty""
  • The returned amount does not exceed the collected (PAY-003): "Greater than the collected ([amount])"
  • Report photo by its type (SUP-002)
  • Consecutive-orders reward: the amount must be greater than zero and the reason is mandatory
  • Transfer always with a mandatory note, and closing with a mandatory note when a decision is pending

Permissions

  • Tickets and chats: admin, support supervisor, support agent; and operations for viewing only without the cancel and refund buttons
  • Refund, compensation, determining who bears it, consecutive-orders reward, and penalty: (ADM-043)
  • Reversing the decision, accepting or rejecting the appeal, and distributing tickets: support supervisor and admin, and finance for reversing the decision

UX decisions

  • One primary button "Refund within authority", and the penalty in a different color away from it, and close at the other end

Requirements that govern it

  • SUP-002 Shortage, damage and non-arrival
  • SUP-004 Small claims

A20 Team and shiftsPickup, handover, and notes without overlap.

Page elements

  • Tabs: current shift, team performance, city and service distribution, handover log
  • "Your shift" card at the top of the page: start time, whom you took over from and the number of confirmed notes, the number of open items in your name, handover time and to whom
  • Shift summary: on shift, open alerts, unowned, average pickup time, pending handover notes
  • Team now table: employee, role, cities and services, current load, resolved today, status (on shift, handed over, starts later)
  • "Unowned" list: short, with unassigned alerts and tickets and a prominent "Mine" button, and text explaining automatic assignment (ADM-042)
  • Takeover dialog: the previous shift's notes item by item with a confirm-read button
  • Notes (handover dialog): the receiving staff member, and every open item under your name with a note field with a hint of three questions: what you did, what is pending, what is needed next
  • Performance (team performance): each employee's metrics and a comparison over the same period (ADM-041)
  • Employee file: their action log (from the audit log) and shifts
  • City and service distribution: an employee × cities and services table edited by the supervisor, and a button to redistribute open alerts
  • Handover log: recorded handovers (ADM-042)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
ClaimOpens the takeover window; after confirming the notes were read, the handed-over items move to them and the takeover is recorded (ADM-042), and alerts start reaching them
DeliveryOpens the handover window; the "Hand over N items to [recipient]" button is disabled until all notes are written. On confirming, the items and their notes move and the handover is recorded (ADM-042), the shift ends and alerts stop reaching them
TransferTransfers an order, alert or ticket to another employee; the recipient's name appears on the item immediately, and the transfer is recorded (ADM-003)
Edit scopeChanges the employee's cities and services; new alerts are assigned accordingly, and open ones stay with their owner until the supervisor reassigns them
MineAssigns the unassigned alert or ticket to the current employee and their name appears on it; if someone else got there first, "[Name] took it moments ago" appears
Redistribute alertsShows the proposed distribution to the available employees by city and load, and applies it after confirmation
Open performance figureOpens the list of orders or alerts that the number represents (ADM-041)

Special states for this page

  • Staff member has not taken over yet: he receives no alerts, and "Take over" is the only action
  • Incomplete handover: the handover button is disabled with the number of items without a note
  • An item being worked on by another employee: their name is visible, the action buttons are hidden, and a "Request transfer" button
  • No employee available in the alert's city: it goes to the supervisor
  • No receiver in the next shift: handover to the supervisor

Validation and error messages

  • A note for each open item: "Write a note for this item before handover"
  • The receiver is required and cannot be the staff member himself
  • Transfer with a mandatory note
  • "Mine" does not work outside the staff member's cities: "This alert is outside your cities"

Permissions

  • Every dashboard employee receives and hands over their shift and transfers their items
  • Editing the scope, redistribution, and transferring an item owned by someone else: the supervisor (support supervisor for the support team, and the admin)
  • Team performance and staff files: the manager (admin, and the support supervisor for their team)

Requirements that govern it

  • ADM-041 Operations team performance Important
  • ADM-042 Shift and handover
  • ADM-003 Unified operations room
  • ADM-002 Audit log and dual approval
  • INT-013 Call center Later

A21 ReportsEvery report with a custom period, comparison, export, and scheduling.

Page elements

  • Groups: the reports list is grouped (orders, cities and coverage, drivers, merchants and stores, customers, marketing and loyalty, finance, support, operations and system), and the selected report is highlighted
  • Filters: period with ready shortcuts (today, last 7 days, last 30 days) and "Custom", and city and section
  • Custom: a start and end date (REP-001), and a single line at the top of the report states the applied period in plain language: "Includes the whole end day · Riyadh time"
  • Comparison: with the equivalent previous period, or the same period last month, or no comparison; with the comparison period's dates
  • Platform revenue: a waterfall of components (service fee, contract fee and Mart and pharmacy percentage, payment fee, platform share of delivery, ads and cashier, penalties that went to the platform, minus platform funding for offers and compensation) then the actual Moyasar fee and platform net (PAY-027), beside total sales separately (ADM-006)
  • Saved view: its name, the period and filters saved with it, and the roles it is shared with
  • Export: Excel and PDF buttons with scheduling and saving in one row under the report
  • Sending (scheduling): the report, frequency, recipients by email, format (Excel or PDF); and the list of schedules
  • MCP: a quiet card at the bottom of the report with a plain-language question field, and text clarifying that it is read-only and that a financial change needs approval inside the dashboard (INT-011)

Actions and what happens on each

ActionWhat happens
ViewCalculates the report with the current period, filters and comparison and shows the numbers, chart and table (ADM-030)
SaveAsks for a name and saves the period, filters and comparison; it appears in "My saved views" and opens in the same state
Share roleSelects one or more roles to whom the view appears; each employee sees only the numbers of their cities and permissions, and financial reports are not shared with a role that lacks them
ScheduleDialog: frequency (ADM-006), recipients, format; sent for the selected rolling period, and appears in the schedules list with a stop button
ExcelDownloads the report with the same period and filters (REP-001)
PDFDownloads a print copy with the period, filters and comparison
Apply custom rangeValidates the two dates then applies the period (REP-001)
Open figureOpens the list the number was calculated from: orders or entries (ADM-030)
Ask the assistantShows an answer or a table via MCP (INT-011); an unauthorized person is rejected with the message "You do not have permission for this data"; a financial change appears as a suggestion with an approve button inside the dashboard

Special states for this page

  • Driver level indicator: last 30 days (REP-001) with a note saying so
  • Financial report for an employee without permission: does not appear in the list
  • Schedule that failed to send: a badge in the schedules list with a retry button
  • Assistant stopped: the card shows "The assistant is unavailable now" and the reports work

Validation and error messages

  • Start after end is not executed (REP-001): "Start date is after end date"
  • The saved view name is mandatory and not duplicated
  • Scheduling: at least one recipient and a valid email "Invalid email"

Permissions

  • Financial reports: admin, finance
  • Other reports: all roles within the role's scope and its cities
  • Assistant: reading for everyone with reports access; and financial suggestions (INT-011)

Requirements that govern it
